na mo gu ru we/ ཿnga bzhi'i gtor ma ga sto bar 'dod pas/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ oX badz+ra amri ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ oX su bha wa shudha sarba dharma su bhā wa shu khro3haX/ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du huX las rang nyid pha dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas seng ldeng gis ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'brol ba/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rten 'brel kyi gi la te 'phrag par bkal ba/ gdams ngag gis mdzode 'dzin pa/ bka' bstan bcos thams cad thugs la tshang ba/ zhal du ā li ka li'i sgra sgrog pa/ sprul pa'i sku mi pham mgon po dam pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e i/ o au/ aX ā/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ta tha da dha na/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ zhes ci mang bzlas la/de nas gtor ma la/ oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ oṃ su bha wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuzlo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya cheb ba'i nang du/ yaX las rlung rdzas sngon po yangs shing g.yo bar 'gyu/ra/ tseX( āXhūX/ lan gsum/ yaX i yī tsa tsha dza dzha nya ya sha /zhes nyer gcig —35—

sogs bzlas/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod nas/ yaX las rlung rdzas sngon po yangs shing g.yo bar gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang / shar rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khore dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba brten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa zhe sdang zhi bar gyur cig /nang rlud nad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon lha'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig /shar phyogs dri za'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/oX badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ //raX la sa me rdzas dmar po tsha zhing bsreg par gyur cig /oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum/ raX ṛ hru ṭa ṭha lha ṇa ra lga nyer gcig bzlas/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ raX las me rdzas dmar po tsha zhing bsreg pa 'di nyid bla ma dang lho'i rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar gyur cig /rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gro don gyis 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna zhi bar gyur cig nad tsha nad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon pho gdon zhi bar gyur cig /lho phyogs gzhin rjes gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig /gong bzhi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/—36—

oṃ badz+ra amri tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du / baX las chu rdzas dkar po grang zhing gshe/ra bar gyur/ oṃ āXskyoX/ lan gsum/ baX u mū pa pha ba bha ma wa k+ṣa/ ar+ghaX:sogs kyis mchod/ baX las chu rdzas dkar po grang zhing gsher bar gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang / nub snang ba mtha' yas kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags zhi bar gyur cig /nad grang nad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon mo gdon zhi bar gyur cig /nub phyogs chu lha'i gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/oX badz+ra a smra tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ paX las sa rdzas ser po sra chi kha mthas par gyur/ oX āXhuX lan gsum/ laX le lī ta tha da dha na las/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ laX las sa rdzas ser po sra zhing 'thas par gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang byang don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba brten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa gti mug zhi bar gyur cig /nad bad kan zhi bar gyur cig /gdon pa gdon zhi bar —37—

gyur cig /byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra amri tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs glud chang bu 'theb skyu dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/lan gsum/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra huX/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mawo brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs glud chang bu 'theb skyu dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du/brgyab pa'i nad mang bsad pa'i tshe thung / 'phrog pa'i sgong bul zas nor srog gi lan chags dang / g.yin yang mtho ba mkhar gyi lan chags dang / dma' ba sa zhing gi lan chags dang / mu tig gser dngul zangs lcags kyi lan chags dang / nor g.yag rta lug gsum gyi lan chags dang / phyugs ba ra bong gsum gyi lan chags dang / yul mi khyim mtshes kyis lan chags dang / pha ma bu tsho'i lan chags la sogs pa lan chags kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la sbyin no/ /tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lan chags thams cad byang sha 'kho ne thams cad zhi/ bu lon thams cad khyer nas phan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /kyai srid gsum 'di na gang yang rung / /'di na gnas pa'i gdon bgegs rnams/ /tshur shog rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon/ /'bru mchog ngar glud ya mtshan can/ /sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin glud/ /da lta yon bdag rgyu 'byor glud/ /glud —38—

bdag thams cad glud bzhes shig /yas kyi bdag por yas bzhes cig /bdag sogs yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ kha yi glud 'di sa la gtong / /sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong / /chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig/drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong / /me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /dbugs kyi glud kyi rlung la gtong / /rlud la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /yid kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong / /mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /sngon tshe bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / /rnal 'byor don gnyis ldan pa yi/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i bsam pa yis/ /mchod sbyin ga|nga ma 'di bzhes la/ khram la bab na khram kha phyes/ khwa la bab na shor rdo dor/ /rtsis la bab na rtsis te phyung / /rgyan la bab na rgyan de spos/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa bkrol/ /bdud kyi thegs pa slar bsgyur cig /gzhan yang bzlog pa'i rigs ci rigs bya'o/ /yang dam pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon po'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma 'di nyid nad pa drag po'i bzlog tu gtong na/ lha bshos dbul zan zla gam brgya dang lnga shar du bltas la btang / gru gsum brgya dang gsum lhor bltas la btang / zlum po brgya dang drug nub tu bltas la btang / gru bzhi brgya dang bzhi byang du bltas la btang / ngar glud brgya/ 'theb skyu brgya/ chang bu brgya/—39—

zan mi'i glud pho mo gang yin gyi skye mched dod par byas la/ de'i phrag pa g.yas pa mi kha'i rdzas bkal/ g.yon la nad pa'i lo grangs kyi khram shing bkal ba gcig /nad pa'i gos kyi thu ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la kha rang la bstan/ de'i mdun du snod zangs chen mo bzhag la/ skyabs sems dang / bdag bskyed/ lha bshos zla gam sogs gong gi rigs 'dre/ ngar glud chang bu sogs kha 'bar ma'i rigs 'dre/ bsngos zin pa dang thebs gang yod du bskyal/ bden pa'i stobs rnams brjod/ rjes bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /lhag chad yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ /gas yang 'di skad do/ /kyai gson cig snang srid lha 'dre rnams/ /glud 'di srid pa gang nas srid/ /dang po bcom ldan shaka thub kyis/ lha dbang brgya byin don du mdzad/ /bar du 'khor lo drug pa'i glud/ /'du ba rnam bzhi nad las grol/ /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud/ /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag gis ni/ /sde brgyad rnams la btang ba yi/ /bar chad ma lus zhi bar byas/ /ngar glud gser gyi a tsa ra/ /zer mos sgros la lung thang mig /spyan mig phrad ngas hrig se hrig /mgron bu'i so ni dkar mdangs can/ /zhal ni 'dzum mdangs mu lu lu/ /phyag g.yas rin chen gser la byas/ /g.yon pa rin chen g.yu la byas/ /phyag gi gar stabs ling se ling / /zhab/sa g.yas thabs chen lcags la byas/ /g.yon pa shes rab zangs la byas/ /zhabs kyi gar 'gros 'du ru sa /rnam shes tshogs drug 'di la tshang / /bkrag mdangs gzi mdangs 'di la tshang / kha khrag rus gsum 'di la tshang / /longs spyod mnga' thang 'di la tshang / /dpa' stsal stobs rgyas 'di la tshang / /'gro na khyu mchog ma he'i 'gros/ /smra na tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar smras/ /rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dar mtshon sna —40—

lnga'i na bza' gsol/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od zer 'phros/ /'di 'dra'i glud mchog ya mtshan can/ /mi las de ni glud dga'o/ /bya las de ni sbu dga'o/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul/ /bzhes nas rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /kyai da ni 'byung ba glud gtong ngo / /gtor glud 'byung ba lnga la gtong / /lam ni bla med gnas su ston/ /'du ba dang po sems kyi glud/ /'byung ba dang po nam mkhar gtong / /nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni dbugs kyi glud/ /'byung ba de ni rlung la gtong / /rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de na drod kyis glud/ /'byung ba de ni me la gtong / /me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni khrag gi glud/ /'byung ba de ni chu la gtong / /chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni sha yi glud/ /'byung ba de ni sa la gtong / /sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni rus pa'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni brag la gtong / /brag la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma —41—

byed cig /'du ba de ni rtsa rgyus glud/ /'byung ba de ni shing la gtong / khreng la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni pags pa'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni thang la gtong / /thang la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs ba bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba ni rgyu ma'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni lam la gtong / /lam la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs ba bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni skra yi glud/ /'byung ba de ni nags la gtong / /nags la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /de nas glud gar ga sto phyogs la kha bstan la 'di skad do/ /kyai da ni glud la lam cig ston/ /yang dag don gyi lam dang gcig /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lam dang gnyis/ /yang dag don gyi lam ston pa/ /chos nyid stong pa'i lam du bstan/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lam bstan pa/ /'gyung ba lnga yi lus stobs kyi/ /ma bsgrod bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ /stong gsum gzhan du sleb par bzhud/ /longs spyod sna tshogs de na che/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po de na bzhugs/ /da ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lam ni dgung sngon mthongs su ston/ /dgung tshig skya mo dung gi lam/ /lam der bzhud la mkha' la gshegs/ /yang ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lam ni chu bo'i gzhung la ston/ /chu gzhung sngon mo chu —42—

yi lam/ /lam 'di bzhud la phyogs der gshegs/ /yang ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams/ /so so'i lam ni bsam mi khyab/ /lam der bzhud la tshur ma log /chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /gsang sngags bka' yi byin rlabs dang / /sngags 'chang bdag gi byin rlabs kyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod ldan par shog /lan chags rgyal po bgegs kyi tshogs/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed par/khyod kyi nad rnams myur du bsdus/ khram la bab na khram kha phyes/ /sho la bab na sho rde'u dor/ /rtsis la bab na rtsis te phyung / /rgyan la bab na rgyan de spos/ /so rbe'i gnas dang rten la gshegs/ /phyin chad 'di la gnod ma byed/ /glud chen dam pa 'di khyer la/ /nad god tsha god khyod kyis chod/ /na ba'i na khur khyod kyis thon/ /tsha ba'i tsha khur khyod kyis thon/ /bsdams pa yod na glod la thongs//bcing ba yod na khrol la thongs/ /chags chen nyams nga bzlog tu gsol/ /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog /mthu gtad rbod gtong thams cad bzlog /bdud kyi zhags pa slar bsgyur cig /de rjes dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /smon lam dang / bkra shis bya'o/ /'byung bzhi'i gtor chog 'di yang gtor chog rnying pa la tā ra na thus zhu dag bgyis pa te byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba nad gdon rab zhi zhes pa'o// //maṅga laX//༈ mi kha'i rdzas la/ re ba nag po'i khug ma'i nang du/ zan dang bra bo sgog pa gsum/ btsong dang yongs ma zhun mkhan gsum/ /skyed drag pha 'ong drag pa bslang / rtag gsum 'gal ba sne nag bya gsob rnams/ mi kha bzlog pa'i rdzas su bsags/ thang dkar gyi pho tang / glang mas mo tang lag pa g.yas g.yon bku/ /—43—

༈ sran ma/ bra bo/ ram pa/ brtsod/ mtshur/ tshwa/ g.yer ma/ sbang ma/ yos tshig /ra bal/ khyi bal/ skra tshal/ sgog pa/rdo nag /g.yag rwa/ ra rmig khyi mgo /ra thod/ bra shing / glang ma/ sgyu mo/ bo to phub chag /mda' chag mdung chag /gzhu chag /gri chag /sder chag /phor chag /gzar chag /stan dum/ lham dum/ de rnams blug /rdzogs so// // bkra shis// gcig zhus//de yang skye 'di nyid nas rab bsags pa/ /bya ba don ldan kho na'i mthu la brten/ /gdos byas rgyu las 'di gang bor ma thag /'khor bar skye gnas dman pa kun las ldog /dge'o// //

'dir brgya bzhi'i cho ga ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /bstan pa'i dam chos rin chen 'di/ /nam zhig nub la nye ba'i dus/ /sngags pa nang dbyen byed pa 'byung / /sngags pa'i nang dgras bstan pa dkrug /de ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin pa/ /thub pa'i bden pa'i dgra bzlog phyir/ /ban bon log lta dam log rnams/ /bdud bzhi sher snying bzlog par gyis /rab tu sngags la spyod par bya/ /oṃ swā sti/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgya bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pa 'di la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / brgya bzhi'i rdzas bsags pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sa phyogs gtsang mar maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nang du thub pa'i phyag g.yas pa gan rkyal gyi phyag rgya phyag mgo yongs rdzogs phyag dar gyi phyed tsam bcas pa bri/ phyag mthil du'ang pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar thub pa'i sku gzugs bshams/ de'i mthar nyer spyod kyis bskor/ gnyis pa rdzas bsags pa ni/ ca rab gnas byas pa brgya/ rtsi mar gyi mar me brgya/ 'bru zan gyi gtor ma brgya/ 'bras zan gyi ngar mi brgya sogs phyag mthil du phyogs bzhir bkod/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ji 'byor dang / mchod pa nyer spyod/ glud rdzongs dang bcas pa thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag nyid lhar gsal ba/ sngon gyi 'byung khungs/ spyan drangs pa/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ brgya bzhi mchod pa/ mchod pa g.yin 'bul ba/ bstod pa/ 'phrin las bcol ba ste brgyad do/ / —45—

dang po ni/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas 'ju chos la: dge 'dun la: lan bdun brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi: sogs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs bya'o/ /rang nyid skad cig gis thub par gsal ba'i snying gar āXlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge huX gser mdog can/de las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ shākya mu ni sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pus āXhūX/ nas shasta āXhuX/ gi bar gyis mchod/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/gi bar lan gsum/ rma su bhā was/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i phyogs bzhir bdud bzhi/ mtshams bzhir seṅge bzhis btegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la huX las rdo rje ser po hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ hūX las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa chen po'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX 〈spro na ma lus sems can sogs/ bcom ldan bskal ba sogs/〉skye( badz+ra aX ku sha dzaX nas oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a/ gnyis su —46—

med par thim/ de dag gi phyag rgya spyi 'gros ltar mdzad de/ yang snying gis hūX las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btangs pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ na mo rat+na tra ya yā/ na mo shākya mu ni ye ta thā ga ta ya/ ar hā te sa myag saX brnya ya/ tu du thā/ oṃ mu ni mahā mu ni shākya mu ni ye swāhā/ oX āXbadz+ra hūX swāhā/ zhes bzlas ci nus bya/༈ skabs 'dir zab mdo ci nus bzlas par bya/ 〈mdun bskyed ni brgya bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus kyi thub sku la dmigs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin de gshegs pa sogs/ zab mdo ci nus bya/ bzlog pa mi rgyab/ mchod bstod/〉 gong bzhin ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs kyis bstod/gnyis pa ni/ de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'i/ mdos 'don pa/ kye sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi yul gyi dbus/ khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nas/ /rin chen khri la lha dbang brgya byin ni/ /dga' mgur 'dod yon dag la spyod pa'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen gyis bskul te/ /glo bur bdud bzhi'i thabs kyis non pa gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba la/ /bcom ldan shākya'i gtso la skyabs song bas/ /de tshe bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ 'gro ba kun la phan phyir ting 'dzin gyis/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs bshams nas/ /mchod sbyin phyag rgyas mthun pa'i rdzas bsags nas/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas nas bdud bzhi rnams/ /thugs rjes lcags kyus bkug —47—

nas phyag sor bzhir/ /bkod nas bdud bzhir mchod sbyin byin pa yis/ /brgya byin nad dang sdug bsngal kun las thar/ /lan gsum/ mthar gsum pa ni/ a mṛ tas sangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng mchod spyin gyi phyag rgya phyag g.yas pa gan rkyal du gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas nas bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ kyi/ nam mkha' mtha' yas lha yi pho brang nas/ /mi gnas myang 'das thob la bar du gcod/ /phung po'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rnam shes mtha' yas lha yi pho brang nas/ /gnas lugs mngon gsum mthong la bar du gcod/ /nyon mongs bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ci yang med pa'i lha yi pho brang nas/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thob la bar du gcod/ /lha bu'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'du shes med min lha yi pho brang nas/ /tshe srog mtha' ru phyin la bar du gcod/ /'chi bdag bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba nas/ kyi phung po'i bdud ni dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /nyon mongs bdud ni ser po nor bu 'dzin/ /lha'i bu bdud ni dmar po pad+ma 'dzin/ /'chi bdag bdud ni nag po ral gri 'dzin/ / rang rang 'khor gyi —48—

tshogs kyi yongs su bskor/ /phyag sor bzhi yi rtse mor bzhugs su gsol/ /rgyas par na 'gugs 'dren sogs yig rnying na gsal/lnga pa brgya bzhi'i mchod pa ni/ rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gi byin rlabs ni/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya thal mo khong stong snying gar sbyar/ oX swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharma swā bhā wa sko tu sdo3haX/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ ma dag pa rnams sbyangs nas stong pa nyid du bsam nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya thal mo sbyor ba las tshig bar pa gsum bcag pa dpral ba ru bya/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta smyoXbi shwa mu khe smyaXsarba thad khaX ut+pa te spa ra ṇa e maX ga gā na khaX swāhā/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyad par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya thal mo phyir bskyed/ mthe bong bsnol ba'i thad du bya/ oX badz+ra amri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya/ g.yon khu tshur steng du bzhag la/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur sdigs mdzub gtor ma la gtad de/ na māXsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ke te oX sam+bha ra sam+bha ra skyoX/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang / sems can rnams kyi spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya/ g.yon snying gar snod 'degs tshul dang / g.yas skyabs spyin gyis phyag rgya bca'/ tseX( dz+nyā na a wā lo ki te/ na ma san+ta spa ra ṇa ra smi bha wa sa mā ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hi da ya dz+wa la ni hūX/ lan gsum zhes pas/ lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing / sems can rnams kyang rang rang gi 'dod yon la rtsod pa med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par bsam/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ ser mo nang du —49—

bsnol ba spyi bor bzhag pa dang / na maXs man+ta budha nai gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na mahā swā ma ye swā hā/ zhes pas/ mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig la gnas shing phan pa dang bde ba'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsam zhing / phyag rgya rnams phyogs bzhir bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ 〈spro na/ bdag gi bsam pa'i 〉 bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum brjod/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan bdun la sogs par bya'o/ /kyai rin chen sna lnga'i rdul tshon las grub pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// /bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur chos sku'i rten/ /ri rab tshar du dngar ba'i mchod rten brgya/ /phung po'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /me long ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje sku thob nas/ /'gro kun phung po'i bdud las thar gyur cig /〈ces 'don mi bzhi yod na nyer lnga'am gang 'os mthar/ de nas gong gi byin rlabs sngags phyag sogs 'og ma gsum la re re bzhi sbyar/〉 kyai stong gsum tshar du dngar ba'i snod nang du/ /'bri mar rtsi mar rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /ri rab lta bu'i mar me'i sdong bu la/ /nyi zla lta bu'i 'od 'bar snang gsal brgya/ /nyon mongs bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan sku thob nas/ /'gro kun nyon mongs bdud las thar gyur cig /〈'don rdung gong bzhi sbyar/〉 kyai rab yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i snod nang du/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bza' dang bca' ba ri rab lta bur skrungs/ /bkod mdzes sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgya/ /lha'i bu'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sor rtog ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan 'od —50—

dpag tu med kyi sku thob nas/ 'gro kun lha bu'i bdud las thar gyur cig/〈'don rdung gong bzhin grangs bsogs/〉 kyai 'bru zan rin chen rnam pa lnga las byung / /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan yid dang dbang po gsal/ /mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa nor mang ldan/ /yon tan brgya phrag ldan pa'i ngar glud brgya//'chi bdag bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bya grub ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa'i sku thob nas/ 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las thar gyur cig /〈brgya phrag gi grangs song mthar/〉 rang bzhin rnam dag ngang du ro gcig kyang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs la/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'di/ /brag cha lta bu'i dbyangs kyis mchod par bgyi/ /sprul pa lta bu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad sku thob nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig /drug pa mchod pa gzhan 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis stsas la/ kyai rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil ba'i mchod yon dang / /sku lus dwangs gsal 'bar ba'i zhabs bsil dang / /lta na shin tu sdug pa'i me tog tshogs/ /dud sprin nam mkha' gang ba'i bdug spos dang / /rab 'bar tshar du dngar ba'i mar me dang / cig car dri bzang 'gyed pa'i dri chang dang / /ro nus phun sum tshogs pa'i zhal zas dang / /sgra snyan rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /mig gi dga' ston sbungs pa'i gzugs mchog dang / /brjod —51—

bral rna bar snyan pa'i sgra snyan dang / /dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i dri mchog dang / kha dog ro mchog ldan pa'i zhal zas dang / /reg 'jam bde ba bskyed pa'i gos mchog sogs/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhis bar chad zhi gyur cig /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang / /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun mchod pa rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /'khor lo gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dung dkar dang / /gser nya dpal be bum pa pad+ma dkar/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhis bar chad zhi gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 〈'di la dmar gtor bzhi bca'i srol yod/〉 yod na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/sam+bha ras bsngags la phud kyis mchod de/ bkod mdzes ri rab lta bu'i gtor ma 'di/ /sha dang khrag gis brgyan cing byin rlabs te/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes la phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi bar mdzod/ /bdun pa bstod pa ni/ kyai nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing / /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs kyi phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan phung po'i bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing / /'gro ba kun gyi tshor ba'i phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan nyon mongs bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal /ci yang —52—

med pa skye mched la gnas pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du shes phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan lta ba'i bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal /yod min med min skye mched la gnas shing / /'gro ba kun gyi 'du byed phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan 'chi bdag bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /bdud bzhi'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod spyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di 'bul bas/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig /brgyad pa 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /mchod sbyin rnam par dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro la bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs nas/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /lo kegs zla keg zhags keg dang / /za keg chags che nyam nga dang / /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ldan pa'i rdzas/ /dbang po drug la rmad byung bde chen bskyed/ /'dod dgu ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams la 'bul/ /lus sems ting 'dzin zas kyis tshims gyur nas/ /zag med ting 'dzin zas la spyod gyur cig /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ glud btang ba dang mjug chog go/dang po ni/ 'bras zan nam/ bag phye la glud skye mched dod pa / glud rdzong rin po che dang / 'bru sna dang / zas sna gos sna/chang phud gser skyems sogs 'du byas la/ myong rdzas kyis bran la/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis —53—

bsas/ sam+bha ras bsngos la/ kyai rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud rgyan ldan 'di/ /'bru zan rin chen lnga yi snying po can/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po'i yon to ldan/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis ngar glud 'di/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar byin rlabs nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob spyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /glud du bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /nor ldan mdzes pa'i ngar glud 'di bzhes shig /mtshar dang mdzes ldan ngar glud 'dis bzhes shig /lta na sdug pa'i ngar glud 'di bzhes shig /yon tan brgya phrag ldan pa 'di bzhes shig /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /kyai rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud rgyan ldan 'di/ /rnam thos sras la 'gran zhing nor mang ldan/ /skabs gsum dbang po'i phun tshogs las 'khrungs shing / / nag po'i sde las rgyal bar byed pa 'di/ /rig 'dzin gsang sngags 'dzin pa bdag cag dang / /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po'i glud du 'bul/mi las glud dga' mdzes pa'i glud bzhes la/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bsgyur/ /bzung ba yod na da lta nyid du thongs/ /bcing ba yod na da lta nyid du khrol/ /bdud kyi khram la btab na khram kha phyes/ /btsan gyi shwa rdo bkye 5 shwa rdo phyung / /klu yis byad du bcug na byad thag chod/ /rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba dgra la bsgyur/ /thes rang sris la rku ba dgra la bsgyur/ /ma mo'i dal yams thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: gdon rigs gsum brgya drug cu: /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: /dus —54—

min 'chi ba bco brgyad /lo dang zla ba'i bgegs rnams dgra la /zhug dang za ma'i bgegs rnams: /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad: /bdud kyi dmag tshogs thams cad: /'byung po'i dal yam thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /zhes brjod cing / glud rnams phyogs bzhir bskyal lo/ /〈de yang phung bdud dkar po bya mgo can lan chags 'bru sna bcas shar du bskyal/ nyon bdud ser po rta mgo can mar me rgya bcas lhor/ lha bdud dmar po khyi mgo can dmar gtor brgya bcas nub/ 'chi bdud nag po sprul mgo can dar mi brgya bcas byang du/ glud dang mi lo bdud steng du bskyal ba bcug tshe/ 'og gi rgyab chog dmar gtor byin gyis rlabs/ mdzod sngags lan bdun gyis bsngos nas/ lcoXdamar gyi gtor ma2 nas ngang du khyoXbar brjod/〉gnyis pa mjug chog ni/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang drang bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ sa tshwa sogs rten la brtan zhugs bya/ sarba bhu ta ga sne ri /zhes brjod la/bdud bzhi 'bor bcas skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su gshegs/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /yang rkyen bzlog gal che ba yin na/ /gong gi rgyab chog tu 'di bya ste/ dang po bca' bshams ni/ gtor ma zur gsum la g.yag rog khyu ba'am/ de ma rnyed na glang nag khyu ba'i khrag byug /pug shud kyi sgro btsug /g.ya' tshal gyi steng du bzhag la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du song bas/ gong bzhin sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sogs kyis bsngos nas/ sbyoX dmar gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'dis/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /yas kyi gnas la phar bltas pa/ /nyi zla shi ba'i ltas ngan mthong / /lha chen khros pa'i than yin pas/ /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /bar snang mkha' la phar bltas pas/ /bya —55—

rgod sder mos 'dzing ba mthong / /srog bdag rgyal po'i than yin pas/ /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /nags la 'brong rgod rwa 'dzing mthong / /bdud kyis g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor: /spang la sha ba rwa 'dzing mthong / /gnyan chen khros pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor: /g.ya' la rna ba rwa 'dzing mthong / /gza' rgod khros pa'i ltas ngan yin / /dmar gtor /brag la gong lhag sder 'dzing mthong / /sman mo khros pa'i: /dmar gtor /ri rtse 'ug pa sder 'dzing mthong / /gza' bdud khros pa'i: /dmar gtor /nags la dom dred sder 'dzing mthong / /ma bdud khros pa'i: /dmar gtor /brag dmar g.yag rgod rwa 'dzing mthong / /bdud nag btang ba'i: /dmar gtor: /nam langs dmar mal mthong ba de/ /dal bdag khros pa'i /dmar gtor /sbrul nag lam du 'khyil ba de/ /klu bdud khros pa'i dmar gtor /ri dwags grong du byung ba de/ /yul 'dres gnod pa'i: /dmar gtor /bya rgod khyim du byung ba de/ /rgyal 'gong bdud du 'bab pa'i /dmar gtor /pho rog sder 'dzing sgrog skad 'don/ /ya bdud srog la gnod pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor: /shing chen rlung gi bcag pa de/ /skye rgyud chad pa'i /dmar gtor /mo dang rmi lam ngan pa de/ /dal rim 'ong ba'i: /dmar gtor: /bud med khrag ral byed pa de/ /rabs chad yongs ba'i /dmar gtor sha ba grong yul 'grims pa de/ /gcer bu sbun dgu'i gnod pa'i: /dmar gtor /sprul dang sbal ljong rmi ba de/ /gnyan nad char du 'bab pa'i ltas dmar gtor: /mun pa nag po 'dzus pa rmi/ /nad rims rnam bzhi yong ba'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar —56—

gtor zhing la bra ba byung ba de/ /lo than 'ong ba'i /dmar gtor: /mi la sha ro skyes pa de /gnam thil 'ong ba'i dmar: phyugs la rigs min skyes pa de/ /nor kong 'ong ba'i ltas: /dmar gtor /lug khyur 'phar spyang zhugs pa de/ /gza' rgod khros pa'i— /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /khang khyim gdung ma chags pa de/ /mgon po khros pa'i /dmar gtor /krung krung nang du 'beb pa de/ /tri mo nor la gnod pa'i: /dmar gtor: khra dang bya rgod 'thab pa mthong / /mthu kha zug pa'i /dmar gtor khyi dang spyang ki 'thab pa de/ /phur kha zug pa'i: /dmar gtor: /mun pa nag po g.yos pa de/ /bdud kyi bar chad yong ba'i ltas/ /dmar gtor /'tshub ma chen pos 'khyer ba de/ /gri kha dar ba'i /dmar gtorྈ bya nag sprin ltar 'thibs pa de/ /lha 'dres srog la brngo ba'i /dmar gtor: /srod la rta pho 'tsher ba de/ /rgyal po'i gnod pa'i /dmar gtor: /'og rta sga 'gros byed pa de/ /mi kha bdud kyis khyer ba'i /dmar gtor /tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba de/ /'gong po srid la zhugs pa'i: /dmar gtor pha gu khu mtshan bu chung nang 'dzing de/ /pho lha khros pa'i ltas ngan yin /dmar gtor: /phugs su bu tshangs byas pa de/ /yul bud 'ong ba'i /dmar gtor khyim la pu shud tshang byas te/ /sang phod kong kha 'ong pa'i /dmar gtor /mi nag 'jigs su rmi ba de/ /mgon po nag po'i cho 'phrul yin/ /dmar gtor /chu chen zhabru/gas pa rmi ba de/ /sa bdag nag pos ltas yin pas/ /dmar gtor /srin bya ku ku nam gong 'tsher/ /'dre mo btang ba'i /dmar gtor— /phugs/ su me che shor ba de/ kha mchu 'ong ba'i /dmar —57—

gtor: /rta dri rta sgrog bcad pa de/ /dgra sri langs pa'i: /dmar gtor: khyi yi sgo phug 'drad pa de/ /gri rgod 'gyed pa'i: /dmar gtor /drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis/ /mi sdug ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /yas kyi bdud g.yos thams cad bzlog gyur cig /mas kyi sri kha langs pa thams cad bzlog /pha tshan dgra ru langs pa thams cad bzlog /lha 'dre'i dmag dpung 'a/ngas pa thams cad bzlog /sde brgyad dal kha 'dren pa thams cad bzlog /dus min 'chi ba'i bka' bab thams cad: sgra skad ngan pa thos pa thams cad /mo dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad: /thum thum rmi lam ngan pa thams cad: /sa 'og mi chung mthong ba thams cad tsha /za kha tshong kha log pa thams cad: /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog gyur cig /ma bu'i byur 'dre brgyad cu bzlog gyur cig /sngags bon phur kha zug pa /snga dgra las la dar pa bzlog gyur cig /phyi dgra yid las sems pa: /mthong ba'i dug langs ngan pa: /thos pa dgra yi ltas ngan la sogs pa/ /drag po dmar gyi gtor mas bzlog gyur cig /bal nag g.yang bzhi 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /than bya pu shud sgro yis sna drongs la/ /dgra bgegs mi mthun yul du da songs shig /sbyoXspyoXspyoXkhyoX stong pa mi dmigs ngang du sbyoX zhes rol chen drag po'i sgra dang bcas la dgra yul du dmigs te phyir bskyal lo/ /slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i bdud bzhi brgya bzhis bzlog pa'i cho ga bsdus pa rdzogs so// //'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam mgon bla ma tā ra nā thas zhus dag gnang ba yin pas byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan zhing gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad nges par bzlog par 'gyur ro// //sarba maṅga lam// shu bhaX//—58—

༈ dmar gtor bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir zor du 'phang / de nas phyogs bzhin mdo bzlog bzhi brgyab/ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad zab mo stong pa nyid nas gyur cig /ces brjod/ /de nas gong gi mjug chos bdag mdun gnyis la dmigs te/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX: sogs dang / khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun: sogs kyis mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya bzod gsol/ sāts+tsha dang thub pa'i sku gzugs sogs la brtan bzhugs bya/ sarba bhu ta/ sogs kyi khri'i phyogs bzhi'i bdud bzhi gshegs la/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rnams byas pas legs par grub pa yin no/ /gong 'og gi mchan bu 'di rnams rang bzo min/rnga ba'i se dgon pa'i bla ma dam pa gsang mtha' sogs kyi phyag len zhal rgyun ltar yin no/ /dge legs 'phel// //

gyi byung tshul bzhugs/oX swā sti/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po lcam dral gyi byung tshul ni/ spyir mgon po bya ba la gsum du yod pa yin/ ye shes kyi mgon po dang chos skyong gi mgon po dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos sku skye ba med pa la skye ba'i cho 'phrul du snang ba ste/ sangs rgyas rigs gsum mam rigs lngar snang ba thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po yin/chos skyong gi mgon po ni byang chub sems dpa' sa la gnas pa rnams dang /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ chos tshul bzhin du byed pa rnams kyi mgon dang grogs byed pa/ dpal mgon po nag po dang dpal lha mo la sogs pa rnams dang / dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam rtsa brgyad lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi mgon po ni/ de dag gi 'khor du gtogs pa dkar po'i chos la dga' ba lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ tha na yi dwags mkha' la rgyu ba'i mthu bo che chos la dga' ba thams cad kyang chos byed pa'i mgon dang grogs byed pas na/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po bya bar 'ong ba yin/ de la 'di ni sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yin pas chos skyong mgon po yin no/ /de ji ltar byung zhe na/ sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi bstan pa la dge slong —60—

legs ldan nag po zhes bya ba/ kha dog nag cing yid gtum pa bden pa bzhi'i bslab pa la gnas shing / lhag par rtag par zhen pa gcig gi sangs rgyas kyi nye 'khor du byung ste/ zag bcas kyi mngon par shes pa cung zad dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i nye 'khor na nga ni mngon par shes pa dang ldan no snyam du nga rgyal byed do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong khyod log pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan te/ dper na/ 'dod pa'i khams na lha dbang phyug chen po bas stobs che ba med mod kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba sbu'i bu ga'am yon tan gyi cha tsam yang mi chog pa yin gyi dge slong khyod de ltar nga rgyal ma byed cig /ces gsungs pas de'i sems dman par gyur te/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du gyur pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam nas/ lho phyogs kyi nags tshal gcig tu song nas gnas pa'i tshe/de na dbang phyug chen po'i rten gcig gnas pa la/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dge slong des gsol ba btab pa las/ rmi lam du dbang phyug chen pos dge slong khyed bdag gi sras su gyur te 'jig rten 'di na stobs che ba'i dngos grub sbyin no zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pas dge slong de log par skyabs su song b.radagongs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dge slong gcig tu sprul pa mdzad nas/de'i drung du phyin nas 'dir ci byed byas pas/ des smras pas bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor du ma tshud nas/ dbang phyug chen po la skyabs su song ba yin zhes smras so/ /sprul pas smras pa/ yang dag lam ni rnyed gyur nas/ /'khrul ba'i —61—

lam la 'jug byed pa/ /dper na gsal ba'i mig bton nas/ /rab rib skyon gyis gos pa bzhin/ /dge slong khyed ni de lta bu'o/ /zhes smras pas/ dge slong des smras pa/ da 'o na bdag gis ji ltar bgyi/ sprul pas gsungs pa/ dge slong khyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar bshags pa dang / gso sbyong bya bar gnang ngo / /zhes gsungs nas/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin nas bshags pa dang gso sbyong byas so/ /de nas des sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab nas bdag tshe 'di nyid du 'bras bu mthar phyin par thob pa'i lung bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang / de bzhin gshe/gas pas gsungs pa/ khyed rten log pa la skyabs su song ba'i mthus skye ba mang po brgyud pa'i mthar dbang phyug chen po'i bu nag po drag po zhes bya ba skye ba len nas/ de'i mthar las kyi srin po nag por skye ba len nas bskal pa bzang po 'di la rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis btul ste mthar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' nag po chen po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ba rdzogs pa'i 'og tu rdo rjes brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas dge slong skye ba mang po brgyud nas 'dzam bu'i gling rgya gar gyi yul phyogs gcig na grong khyer gsum brtsegs zhes bya ba'i rgyal po/'i pho brang gcig yod pas de dang nye ba'i byang phyogs nyi ma phyed kyis na/ dur khrod chen po so so'i —62—

gling zhes bya ba yod pa de na ro zas dang ro gos thams cad lce spyang gi za ba yod pa la/ dur khrod der re zhig gi tshe dge slong de pha ma med pa'i khye'u mdog nag po gcig tu 'gyur to/ /des dge slong dka' thub kyi bya ba byas nas dur khrod der bsgoms pas/dur khrod kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad mos nas ro sha bstab pa gsol/ der ro sha ro gos ro zas thams cad la longs spyod cing bsgoms pas/ grong khyer gsum brtsegs pa'i mi thams cad na re/ dur khrod na srin phrug ro zan gcig 'dug pas des mi thams cad za bas de bsad dgos zer nas thams cad la bsgrags so/ /der dpung gi tshogs dang bcas te dur khrod der phyin pa dang /dge slong gis gsod par shes nas nga srin po min chos rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa'i dur khrod du sgom pa yin byas kyang ma phan par mtshon bsnun no/ /de nas dge slong de zhe sdang gis mtshams sbyar nas 'chi ba'i tshe dmod par bor te/ ngas tshul khrims dang dka' thub lo dgu byas nas sems can gyi don byed par sems bskyed pa la/ khyed rnams kyi sgom du ma ster bar bsad pas/nga shi ma thag tu gnod sbyin ma rung pa gcig tu gyur nas/ spyir sems can thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud cing khyad par du grong khyer gsum brtsegs kyi rgyal po rgyal srid 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de nas dge slong nag po de sngon dbang phyug chen po la skyabs su song zhing des dngos grub byin pa'i stobs kyis dang sngar sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa bzhin du/ khong shi ma thag tu ri rab kyi zom la lha dbang phyug —63—

chen po dang lha mo u ma gnyis kyi bur skyes te/ de'ang ji ltar byung zhe na/ ri rab kyi byang shar mtshams na shing yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba rtsa ba lha ma yin gyi yul du skyes shing / rtse mo la bya khyung gnas pas lo ma la 'dod yon lnga rang byung du 'byung ba 'bras bu la rin po che sna bdun lo tog lta bur smin pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhig lha dang lha ma yin gyi thun mong gi bsod nams las skyes so/ khreng de'i rtse mo lha rnams kyi gnas na yod pas lo ma dang 'bras bu lha rnams kyi dbang byas pa'i tshe ri rab kyi rked par lha ma yin gyi grong khyer gsum brtsegs zhes bya ba nas/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po he rang na pag shu zhes bya ba dang /ri rab kyi rtsa ba nas 'od mi snang ba zhes bya ba'i gnas na lha ma yin gyi rgyal po sum brtsegs dang / thags bzang ris dang / rnam par snang byed dang / rab bsil dang sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa dmag bye ba dung phyur tsam mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin nas/ ri rab kyi steng chos bzang zhes bya bar lhag nas ri rab kyi steng na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / bha su khyu ba dang / ma ha de ba sogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la lha ma yin rnams kyis shing 'di rtsa ba nged kyi yul nas skyes kyang lha rnams kyi dbang du byas pas/ de ni lha dang lha ma yin thun mong bya bar rigs so/ /zhes smras pas/ lha rnams na re/ shing la dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba lha rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa yin/ lha'i yul du 'bras bu'i smin pa yin pas khyed la mi ster zhes smras pas/ lha ma yin rnas khros te de lta na g.yul 'gyed par bya'o/ /zhes smras nas song ste/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris gnod sbyin sum cu rtsa gnyis dang lha ma yin gyi dmag bye ba dung phyur —64—

dang bcas pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te ri rab kyi steng du lhags pa na/ chos bzang zhes bya ba'i mdun sar lha rnams tshogs te 'thab par brtsams nas lha rnams khro ma shes nas/ rtsub 'gyur gyi khang pa na khro bo ka ta nag po khros pa'i kha chu khro chu'i rdzing bu bdun 'khyil ba la btungs pas lha rnams zhe sdang skyes te/lha'i dbang po brgya byin nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis lha dmag bye ba dung phyur dang bcas te go mtshon sna tshogs thogs nas/ lha dang lha ma yin g.yul 'gyed cing phan tshun mtshon brgyab pas/ lha ma yin gyi khrag 'ong ba rnams la dmag mang du 'phel/ lha rnams kyi khrag la dmag ma 'phel bar shi ste lha rnams ni pham/ lha ma yin rnams ni rgyal bas/ lha rnams rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka na hūX gcig spros pas lha byi snu ra tsa'i dpral bar thim pa la lcags kyi mdzer ba gcig tu gyur nas/ de rtol ba'i nang nas bud med sngo bsangs ma mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa gcig byung / de la lha rnams kyis u ma de ba bya bar ming btags/ lha rnams kyi chung mar bya ba 'dod pas na nam mkha' nas phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pas smras pa/ lha rnams rgyal srid 'thor zhing brtan pa dang / /rigs drug sems can bde la bkod pa dang / /lha min bdud kyi g.yul chen bzlog pa'i phyir/ /dbang phyug lha la u ma chung mar byin/ /zhes gsungs pas/mahā de ba la lha dpal chang gir ti ka'i bu mo u ma chung mar byin te 'khrig pa spyad pas u ma la sras ming sring gnyis skyes te/ ming po la gshin rje mahā kā la zhes btags/ mdog nag cing thung la gtum pas/ mahā de wa'i sras po drag shul che/ mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ nag po che zhes grags so/ /—65—

sring mo la mahā kā li zhes pa dang dpal lha mo dang lha mo tsa mun dri zhes bya bar yang grags/ nag po chen po la phas lag char gri gug byin/ mas 'thung snod du thod pa byin/ lha rnams kyis mdangs las grub pa'i lha mo mdangs ldan chung mar byin te/ ming sring gnyis chos bzang lha'i mdun sar spyan drangs nas lha mang pos phyag byas/ lha'i dbang pos rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du mchod par byas/ lha'i dmag dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis tshal chen po bzhir mchod pa byas/yongs 'du sa brtol du lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrigs gis mchod pa byas/ rdo ar mo li ka'i khar yang lha yi bu bye ba khrag khrig gis mchod pa byas/ chos bzang lha'i 'dun sar lha rnams kyi dmag dpon du mnga' gsol/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang bskur te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgo zhing dam la btags so/ /de nas skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par nyi ma byang shar gyi gnod sbyin brgyad ni khyong khyung chen dang lcags kyi bya khrar sprul/lho'i gshin rje brgyad ni khyi nag dang lcags spyang dang stag gzigs dang dom dred du sprul/ srid pa'i ma mo bcu drug ni bud med nag mor sprul/ btsan dang dri za'i tshogs ni skyes pa stag chas can du sprul/ srog bdag dang rgyal po'i dmag tshogs ni sngags chen dang dgra bcom du sprul/ pho bdud dang mo bdud kyi sprul pa bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong dang / lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bye ba dung phyur dang bcas par sprul nas ming sring gnyis kyi lha rnams kyi mgon byas te/ lha ma yin dang g.yul 'khyed nas 'thab pas/ mahā kā la'i lag na gsal shing bing dang lhan sbo ri rab tsam gcig gis lha min g.yul ngor dril nas —66—

bcom/ grong khyer gsum brtsegs bzhig /lha ma yin gyi ske gri gug gis bcad de thod pa'i nang du khrag zed cing btungs pas lha'i rnam pa las 'gyur te/gnod byin gyi gzugs nag cing shin tu 'jigs par gyur to/ /tsa mun dris ral gri me lce'i phreng ba zhes bya bas lha ma yin he ra na/ pag shu'i mgo bcad/ lha dmag mang po rnams kyis lha ma yin la mtshon gyi char phab nas dmag rnams bsad/ tsa mu dris he ra na pag shu thod pas khrag bcus shing rol pas/ lha min gyi khrag dmag mir sprul pa dang 'phen mi nus par byas shing /tsa mun tri'i lto ba la lha dmag bye ba'i rdzong byas nas 'thab pas lha dmag dkar po rgyal de dpag bsam shing gi mnga' bdag tu gyur te lha ma yin pham par byas so/ /de nas yul lang ka pu ri na srin po'i grong khyer bdun 'bum yod pa la lha rnams kyis skyog gis phab nas brlag par byas pas/ srin po dha sha gh+ri bas lha dang mi rnams sdom pa'i don du de'i sring po rna la tsidha ma ha khyo ba la btsun mor phul/ de gnyis tshogs pa las bu mo ya mtshan che ba gcig skyes te/ de cher skyes pa dang rna la tsis bu mo khrid nas tsa mun tri la g.yog tu phul/ des lha mo'i g.yog byas shing glo bar nye bar byas nas lha mo shin tu mnyes shing rab tu dga' nas/ lha mo na re khyed kyis nga la mgu bar byas pas ngas kyang khyod kyis ci 'dod par bya'o zhes tshig shor bas/ khol mos glags rnyed de zhung po dha sha gh+ri ba la sbran nas 'ongs pa la/ 'di dang gtan gyi grogs zla mdzad par zhu zhes brid cing bslus nas zhus pas/ sngar gyi khas blang shor ba dang / lha la dag mi 'gyur ba'i sdom pa yod pas mi bya ba'i dbang med par lha mo de srin po'i chung mar song der —67—

lha mo u ma khros te dmod pa phyin ci log par/ ming po ma hā kā las sring mo ster bas 'tshol du song ba dang / sring mo'i rkang pa la lcags sgrog bcug pa mthong /der ma hā kā la yang khros nas srin po 'khor dang bcas pa bsad nas sha zos khrag 'thung yul lang ka pu ri gtan nas brlags par byas so/ /de'i rgyu brtags pas lha rnams lan par shes nas/ mahā kā la lha rnams la yang khros pas/ sngar lha dang lha mi 'thab pa na lha'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'phangs pas lha ma yin rnams bcom nas pham par byed pa la/ dus der mahā ka las 'khor lo'i nang du 'khor lo phyir bzlog pa'i sbyor ba byas nas bcug pas lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe lhas 'khor lo 'phangs pas phyir log nas slar lha rnams pham par byas so/ /der pha dbang phyug chen po khros nas dus der bu nag po ri rab kyi steng nas bskrad pas nag po cher khros te/ tshams rngam gyi gad mo bsgrags/ khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi thams cad g.yos shing ri rab kyang 'gul ldeg 'gyel la khad pa tsam du byung nas mar 'bab te ri rab bang rim gsum gyi kha khyer la gnod byin 'od zer can zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen pos 'jig rten na dbang che ba'i thun mong gi dngos grub byin pa zhig yod pa de'i rtsar bab ste/ nag pos 'od zer can bsad sha zos khrag btungs nas phas byin pa'i dngos grub nyams par byas/ nag po yang gnod byin gyi gzugs 'jigs su rung ba mche ba bzhi dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur to/ /de nas 'od zer can 'dzam bu'i gling du nya ba'i rigs su skyes so/ /des —68—

kyang sngar gyi smon lam dang las kyi dbang gis rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer gsum brtsegs dang nye bar/ ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs la lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'i grong khyer gsum brtsegs dang 'dra ba'i khang pa gsum brtsegs byas nas der gnas te/ dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub thun mong ba zhig thob nas byas so/ /der nag po drag po yang las kyi stobs kyi 'dzam bu'i gling gi grong khyer sum brtsegs su bab nas/ spyir sems can mang po'i gshed mar gyur/khyad par du grong khyer sum brtsegs kyi rgyal blon dang bcas pa thams cad bsad/ sha zos khrag 'thung grong khyer gsum brtsegs kyi grong khyer thams cad bshig bcom brlag par byas/ sngar gyi byed pa rgyu mthun pa'i las kyi dbang gis/ 'od zer can nya bar skyes pa de yang bsad/ sha zos khrag 'thung mgo bcad nas/ mas byin pa'i g.yon gyi thod par khrag blugs te 'thung phas byin pa'i gri gug g.yas su phyar/ gsal shing grub mor bcug ste dur khrod so gling du song nas dur khrod kyi 'jigs byed pho mo thams cad dang / sha za dang srin po dang gnod sbyin dang ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te/ de rnams kyi phyag byas 'khor du 'dus te grong khyer sum brtsegs pa thams cad bsad cing za bar byed de/ der sum brtsegs pa rnams skrag nas kho dug gi bsad par 'dod nas kho 'ong ba'i lam srang thams cad dug sbyar nas bzhag pas khos zos pas kho la ma gnod par/ slar mthun rdzas su gyur nas nus pa dang ldan par gyur to/ kho bskrad par 'dod pas grong khyer gyi shar sgor yungs kar/ lho sgor sgog pa/ nub tu rang byung me tog /byang du btsan dug /byang shar sha r+sā/ shar lho dri wo/ lho —69—

nub tu tsha ba gsum/ nub byang du klad pa 'dres pa'i bdud po btang bas kho'i mthun pa'i dam rdzas su gyur nas slar mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas srid pa gsum la dbang che ba'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pas kyang ma thul bas/ nang sems can brgya zos/ nub sems can brgya zos shing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad brlag la khad par gyur pa dang/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can rnams la thugs rjes dgongs nas nag po drag po de 'dul ba'i don du khro bo chen po dpal rta mgrin sprul nas dbu'i gtsug nas rta mgo ljang zhur byung ste rta skad lan gsum bsgrags pas nag po na re nga 'dul ba'i gnyen po med kyi khyed rang nags su song la rtsa zo zer nas ma grul lo/ /de lta bur mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i gdug pa can des sems can mang po la gnod par gzigs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu mdzad nas/ nag po drag po de gzhan gyi mi 'dul zhing phyag na rdo rjes 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen te phyag na rdo rje la zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang bcas pas 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing gsung gi nga ro drag tu rngam pa'i huX sgra sgrog ste/ nag po 'khor bcas thams cad la gzir zhing tshar bcad nas rang gi skur snang bar byas te sa brgyad pa zag med kyi lam la bkod/ nag po 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar 'khod de gsol ba/ kyai thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa lags/ /bdag ni khyed gzir mi bzod do/ /dam la btags 'tshal ci gsungs bsgrub/ khyed kyi —70—

bstan pa bsrung bar bgyid/ /ces brjod cing srog snying phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad der 'dus pa nas gdan tshom bu ltar byas te/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ nag po'i lag tu rdo rje gtad lce la dam mchu blud cing dam la bzhag nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos pas/ khyed ni gsang ba gsum gyi bdag /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar byin gyis brlabs/ khyod ni dpal ldan nag po che/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pas/ shwakya seṅge'i bstan pa la/ /dam tshig chen por gnas par gyis/ /zhes bsgo zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar gnyen du gtad pas/ bcom ldan 'das la dga' zhing bka' nyan pa dang / thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa rdzogs te sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis gyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ba byed cing /sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul pa'i mgon po lnga/ gzhan yang las kyi mgon po du ma bcas pa'i tshogs rnams rang rang gi 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa can rnams dang thabs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa la zhugs pa dang bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i/ sgrub pa po rnams kyi bsrung ma byed par khas blangs so/ /de la sku'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i sku'i mgon —71—

po'i bka' non du rnam par snang mdzad/ 'jam dpal gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i gsung gi mgon po'i bka' non du pad+ma dbang chen/ thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i thugs kyi mgon po'i bka' non du phyag na rdo rje/ 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mgon po'i bka' non du khro bo ku ru ku le 'byung ba yin/ yon to gyi lha tshogs ni gong ma rnams kyi thun mong yin no/ /de la 'di ni thugs kyi mgon po yin pas de'i bka' non du phyag na rdo rje'am kyai rdo rje la sogs pa thugs kyi khro bo 'byung ba yin no/ /thugs kyi mgon po 'di la yang bing can dang gri gug can gnyis/ bing can la bzhi/ bing skor sku phyi sgrub kyi lugs/ stag bzhon nang gsung sgrub/ trag shad gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub pa/ de dag gi bka' sdod las kyi mgon po rnams drag po 'phrin las kyi sgrub lugs so/ /gri gug can la yang snyan khyu yod pa dang med pa gnyis las rdo med pa ni gri thod 'dzin pa ste/ de la sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig byung yang /gtso bo ni bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che 'bring chung gsum yod de/ mgon po gri gug can zhes yongs su grags so/ /ga rnye can gyi bsgrub thabs ni mang mod kyi/ bram ze mchog sred la/ mgon pos zhal gzigs nas de la mgon po nyid kyis sgrub thabs 'di gnang ba/ rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs te/ bram ze mchog sred phe dha na gyi yul nas bde mchog la sogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su re ma tis la lag mthil du —72—

bzhag nas sgong rtse dang / dre'u rta la bskyon nas gling bzhi lan cig bskor/ rna ba gnyis nas bzung nas lan cig bskor/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bar chad yang yang byas nas myos par byas pa la/ mgon po nyid kyis re ma ti thal lcag gis bsnun te/ 'di lta bu'i bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i dam nyams sha za'am zhes zer nas re ma ti myos su bcug /nga'i sring mo 'dis da rung khyod la bar chad byed do/ /'di sgrubs shig gsungs nas mgon po'i sgrub thabs byin pa yin no/ /de la rkyang du sgrub pa dang sbrags su sgrub pa'o/ /rkyang du sgrub pa'i lugs la yang pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang / mo rkyang du sgrub pa gnyis/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa la tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa dang / bka' bsgo'i tshul du sgrub pa gnyis so/ /mo rkyang du sgrub pa la e ka tsa ti'i chul du sgrub pa dang / re ma ti'i tshul du sgrub pa dang / 'bal mo'i tshul du sgrub pa dang / mon mo'i tshul du sgrub pa dang lha mo mu stegs lugs kyi tshul du sgrub pa dang lnga'o/ /sbrags sgrub la yang yab yum gyi tshul du sgrub pa dang / lcam dral gyi tshul du sgrub pa dang gnyis gsungs/ de gnyis gang rung la 'khor mon pa dang dril te sgrub pa dang / sbrags su sgrub pa dang bzhi'o/ /'khor la yang las kyi mgon po zangs gri can dang / mon pa ming sring lnga dang / dur khrod bdag po dang / sde brgyad dang / pho nya'i sgrub thabs/ mon pa'i sgrub thabs/ mon pa'i byung tshul ci rigs pa bstan to/ /nag po chen po lcam dral gyi/ /ji ltar byung ba'i tshul 'di ni/ /dad brtson —73—

slob ma la bskul ba'i ngor/ /'jam dbyangs ma tis bsdebs pa'o// //dpal ldan nag po chen po lcam dral gyi byung tshul ci rigs pa 'di ni bu slob ma mang pos yang yang bskul ngor/ 'jam dbyangs ma ti paṇa chen gyis dge ldan sa bzang du sbyar ba'o// // maṅga laX// bha skyi// shubhaX// legs bzhengs dge bas bdag cag gis/ /'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rgyal bstan rin chen gus bkur te/ /sgo gang thad nas rtag 'dzin shog/ //

lcam dral 'khe7ra bcas kye bsnyen thabs bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang ni he ru ka /mchog tu gus par rab btud de/ /nag po chen po lcam dral gyi/ /bsnyen pa'i man ngag mdo tsam bshad/ /de la spyir rkyang sgrub dang / sbrags sgrub gnyis/ dang po la/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang / mo rkyang du sgrub pa dang / 'khor rkyang du sgrub pa dang gsum mo/ dang po ni/ gur mgon yab rkyang du sgrub pa ste/ 'di la bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa dang / tshogs bdag ltar sgrub pa dang / gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa dang / skyon rje ltar sgrub pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du mgon po bka' gnyan gyi tshul du byas nas sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rang nyid mgon por byas te sgrub bo/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub lugs gnyis po gang rung ste rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa la shin tu bsngags so/ /bzhi pa ni/ lugs gnyis po gang rung ste drag po'i las sgrub pa la shin tu bsngags pa'i de ltar du sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gur mgon bka' gnon du yod pa la yang ma ltos/ bka' nyan gyi 'khor yod pa la yang ma ltos par lha mo rkyang par sgrub pa'o/ /'di la yang 'jam lugs su sgrub pa dang / rtsub lugs sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni e ka dza ṭi bka' gnon byas te sgrub pa'o/ /'di la yang —75—

yum chen e ka tsa ti'i lto bar bskyed pa shin tu 'jam lugs dang / snying khar bskyed pa cung zad rtsub lugs su sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni yum chen e ka dza ṭi bka' gnon yod pa la ma ltos par dpal ldan lha mo sgrub pa'o/ /gsum pa 'khor rkyang du bsgrub pa ni/ lcam dral bka' gnon du yod pa la ma ltos par 'khor rkyang du sgrub pa'o/ /de yang lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ gshan rje brgyad/ 'jig byed brgyad/ ma mo brgyad po/ mdor na snang srid lha srin sde brgyad mtha' dag rkyang pa sgrub pa ste/ de ni thun mong ba'i 'khor rkyang sgrub pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor rkyang bsgrub pa ni/ lcam dral bka' gnon du yod pa la ma ltos pa/phyi'i las mgon gcer bu zangs gri can/ nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can/ gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring rnams rkyang par sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbrags sgrub la yab yum sbrags sgrub ming sring sbrags sgrub lcam dral sbrags sgrub gtso 'khor sbrags sgrub dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni mgon po lha mo gnyis 'jig rten gyi gza' mi lta bu'i tshul gyi sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni mgon po dang lha mo gnyis 'jig rten gyi ming sring ltar sgrub pa'o/ /gsum pa ni lha mo shin tu rtsub pa'i mgon po bka' gnon du byas te sgrub pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni lcam dral lha gsum la thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor rnams kyi bskor te sgrub pa ste/ 'di la thun mong gi gtso 'khor sbrags sgrub dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gtso bor sbrags sgrub bo/ /de yang rkyang sgrub las sbrags sgrub zab sbrags sgrub la yang phyi ma phyi ma rim pas zab pas —76—

lcam dral lha gsum las gnod sbyin yab yum dang pu tra ming sring gsum gyi bskor ba ni ches shin tu zab par grags so/ /de ltar na lha brgyad sbrags sgrub kyi sgo nas/ bsnyen pa las 'jug par bya ste/ 'tshams la 'jug pa'i snga rol tu nag po chen po la bskangs bshags rgyas par phul la/ gza' skar/ dga' ba'i dgong mo'i cha bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad cing / mtshams tho rnams btsugs shing / shes shing nus na tho bzhi rgyal chen bzhir bskyed pa dang / gtor ma phul te bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ sgrub khang gi nang gi rang gi mdun phyogs su yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku bkram zhing lag len bzhin mchod gtor bshams la/ bdun phrag gcig gam gnyis sam ji ltar rig par yi dam gyi bsnyen pa kha gsos/ de mtshams ni mgon po'i bsnyen pa dngos gzhi la 'jug te/ re re'i mgor yi dam gyi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rig pa bzlas pa cung zad re dang bcas pa sngon du btang la/ mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad yongs rdzogs gtor chog bzhin bskyed la dam bzhag gyi bar bya/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/mgon po'i bzlas pa la 'jug /thun 'jog khar gtor ma kha gsos la gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol ba dkyus bzhin byas la yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba'i bzod par gsol/ gshegs su mi gsol bar su pra ti khri'i brtan zhugs phul la/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo thun mtshams la 'jug go /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun du —77—

mdun bskyed mgon po gtso 'khor brgyad bka' sdod kyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa/ dbus rwa sbubs can du yod pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūX sngon po/ de'i mtha' skor du mgon po'i snying po dang rtsa sngags gnyis kyis bskor/ de'i phyi rol tu las mgon gyi sngags kyi bskor ba ste/ de rnams thams cad g.yas bskor/ de'i phyi rol tu yi dam gyi sngags kyis kyang bskor bar bsam mo/ /mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du gri gug sngo nag yu ba'i rwa sbubs stong du yod pa'i lte bar nyi ma la huX nag po/lha mo thugs kar ral gri yu ba sbubs stong du yod pa'i nye bar nyi ma la smyoXlas mgon rnams la yang rang rang gi thugs kar phyag mtshan so so'i lte bar huX re re bsgom/ de ni rang gi thugs ka'i huX las snying po yi ge bcu pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rtse mo la dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa spros/ rang gi zhal nas thon mgon po'i zhal du zhugs gri gug gi dbus su rwa'i sbubs nas mar song nas/ lte bar huX yig la g.yas skor byas sib sib thim pas/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyi gang bas/nang spang rtogs dang nus mthu rgyas/ phyi dam rdzas kyi sku lus rgyas te/ gzi brjid bkrag mdangs phun sum tshogs par bsam/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i huX las snying po'i 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros/ mgon po'i lte ba nas thon bdag gi lte ba zhugs te/ snying kha'i huX gi zhabs kyu la thim pas/ bdag la srog snying phul bar bsam zhing / ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad myur ba nyid du sgrub par —78—

bsam la/ mgon po'i snying po stong phrag gnyis tsam bzlas/ de ni lha mo'i bsnyen pa ni/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs gdugs pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag gi nus mthu thams cad 'od zer nag po rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūX la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs thams cad spyan drangs/ hūX la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros rang lus 'od kyi phungapo chen po gyur par bsam te hūX la thim/ hūX yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du nag po chen po yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ bdag nyid nag po r+ṣa por thugs kar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du gri gug gi lte bar huX yig nag po de'i mthar lha mo'i snying po/ de'i mtha' skor du las mkhan pho mo'i sngags de'i phyi rol tu mgon po snying po dang rtsa sngags/ de'i phyi rol tu yi dam sngags kyi bskor bar bsam la/bdag nyid nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i huX las sngags kyi spros bsdus bya tshul yang de'i rigs 'gre'o/ /lha mo la mgon po'i phyed de stong phrag gcig /las mgon la yang phyed de lnga sogs grangs de'i rigs 'gre nga/gos la/ mdor na mgon po'i snying po 'bum phrag bcu drug /lha mo'i bsnyen sngags su 'bum phrag brgyad/ las mgon la yang 'bum phrag bzhi ste/ de'i mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi bdag dang lha nye ba'i bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ sha sa nas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi/ rdo rje brag rdzong ma la brten par bla ma gong ma rnams kyi legs par bshad pa'i —79—
mgon po kun dga' snying po'i gsungs las byung ba rnams las mdor bsdus te shākya'i dge slong kun dga' ye shes rgya mtshos don gnyer 'ga' res bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o// // sarba maṅga laX//

pa bsdo/gas/oṃ swā sti/ dpal nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus pa ni/ thab blo bslangs su byed na stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi la dpangs mtho gang tsam bya/ de'i dbus su thab rtsig pa'am/ brus pa'i sor bzhi tsam brus/ sor brgyad tsam brtsigs nas rtsig pa'i srab mthug sor bzhi yod par bya/de'i phyi kha khyer so sor dbyibs gru gsum nyid kyi chog /ngos re gru gang ba yong bar bya/ drag po kho na la sor nyi shu ba yin te/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ phyi nang thams cad tshon nag po'am/ ro sol gyis byugs/ de'i steng du las dang mthun pa'i kha dog gzhan gyis bsgyur te/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ bris thabs su byed na thig chen brgyad gtab pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ kha khyer la khro ba'i rdo rje bri/ thab kyis nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad dam/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ lte ba la gri gug cig 'bri'o/ /zur gsum rtse mo phar bstan par bya/ thab kyi g.yon du mchod rdzas dang / rang gi g.yon du bsreg rdzas bshams/ gtor ma ji ltar bde ba la bsgrig zhi ba rkyang pa la mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bsham tshul te go ldog yin/ thab zhal byang du phyogs/rang nyid kha lhor lta/ shing tsher ma can gtsor byed gzhan yang skam yang dang mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs pa'i bud shing dang /'bul rgyu'i yam shing sha khrag rus gsum skra shad snum nag /sran ma/ bra bo/ yungs dkar/ yungs nag /ske tshe sogs 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa dang / dug khrag dang / bung bu'i sbangs dang / lan tsha sogs bsham/ bzlog pa gal che ba dang / drag las dmigs bsal can yin na/ ling ga che bar grags pa brub khung gcig gi nang du rdzas dang bcas pa'i ling ga dang ling —81 —

chung gnyis ka bsham/ bzlog pa tsam dang / bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs dngos grub kyi don yin na/snod gcig tu phye mar liṅga byas pa dang / khrag byugs pa'i ling chung 'ga' shas bshams pas chog /phud dang rak+ta yang bshams dgos/cho ga dngos ni sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang / gnas yo byad byin rlabs/ yi dam gang byed kyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa'i bar bya/ thab khung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las byung ba'i thab khung gru gsum pa las thams cad sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod/ bsreg rdzas rnams la rak+ta dang nang mchod gtor/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ skye( āXswāhā/ tso tshe shri swāhā/ skyesh+lau rdza swāhā/ tseX( ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyisabarlabs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la huX/ zhes thab khung du me sbar/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab khung gi me ltar gyur pa ni sku mdog nag po bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa srin po'i lus can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/skye( asne ye hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis dgang blugs phul/ tso( asne ye gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ zhes brjod/ a rgyuX sogs/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+ki dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces bstod/ yang blugs gzar gcig phul/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/—82—

a mṛ tas bsangs dang / stong par sbyangs pa nas bzung dam la bzhag pa'i bar mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i bar gtor chog bzhi du bya/ yang mchod bstod bskul bar bya ste/ brub khung du liṅga che ba bcas yod pa'i rigs yin nam/ bden bdar dgug gzhugs sogs spyi dang 'dra ba'i mthar shā sa na bzlas bzhin du thun gyis brab/ oX mahā kā la gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces ral gri'am gri gug gis dum bu mang por btubs/ ling chung rnams kyang yid kyis dgra bgegs dngos su bskyed cing / dgug gzhugs yang yang bya/ oṃ mahā ka la sogs gong bzhin dang / shā sa na'i sngags bzlasapas blugs gzar gyis blangs nas/ khrag gi ar+ghaX lan gsum phul/ de nas mar nag gi dgang blugs lan bdun tsam phul nas/ sngags de dag nyid tsher ma can gyi yam shing nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'bul/ liṅga bsgral ba yin na/ de nas ling ro rnams sngags de nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa gcig phul/ ling chung rnams ma gtub par dgra bgegs dngos su bsam la 'bul/ de'i rjes su bsreg rdzas gzhan thams cad bsregs nas gong du bstan pa'i sngags de nyid kyi 'bul te/ mthar chang blugs gzar gsum 'bul bar bya'o/ /yam shing mar nag bar skabs de dag tu gang babs babs su 'bul dgos/dmigs pa ni/ dkyus kyi nyams len lam dam rdzas sha khrag gi rgya mtsho dang / mchod rdzas bzang dgur mos nas 'bul/ drag las kyi skabs yin na dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa zhag sogs kyi dbyibs mthun sbyar nas 'bul/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad skad cig gis bkug nas de nyid du dum bu brgya stong du brlags nas sha mchod rus mchod du chem chem gsol ba dang / mes bsregs nas thal ba yang sbur sbur 'gro ba dang / skad cig la myags pa sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs par bsam mo/ /—83—

mthar gtor bsngo'i bzhin du gtor ma 'bul ba dang / mchod bstod bskul ba yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bya ste/ thal ba nas cung zad rang gi snying gar byugs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim mo/ /yang blugs gzar gcig phul bas/ me dpung me lha'i rnam par 'gyu/ra/ bsregs rdzas lhag ma rnams gong bzhin du brtan pa'i gsang sngags dang bcas pas lan bdun 'bul/ mthar gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ 'a ye swāhā/ a kā ro btags pa'i mthar/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces btags te lan gsum phul nas/ yang gong bzhin dgang blugs bdun 'bul/ mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol/ gyi mthar/ oṃ asne ye rte zhes me lha gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bsrung ba dang / smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ / —las bzhi so so'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa byed na/ yi dam gyi sbyin sreg gi 'don pa spo bas cho ga la/'dir bzlog pa cung zad drag po dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i dbang du byas so/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po la sogs pa'i chos skyong gi rigs phal che ba'i sbyin sreg mdo tsam 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // bkra shis par gyur cig/rab dkar 'dis mtsho ni skye 'phags dge chen gyis/ /dus mthar rgyal bstan dbu 'phang mtho ba dang / /chabs cig 'gro la phan bde yongs spel zhing / /bstan 'gro'i gsungs rim rlabs chen spyod gyur cig /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i/ /rnam sprul rje btsun yon tan bzang po yis/ /spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya go lnga lor/ /rgyal bstan mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ /—84—

brgyud 'debs bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /zung 'jug ye shes mchog mnga' rdo rje'i gur/ /grub pa mchog gi sa brnyes mchog sred la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /paṇa chen grub pa'i rtser son nor gling pa/ /mkhas pa'i phul phyin dad byed go che'i zhabs/ /'jig rten mig gcig rin chen bzang po la/ /gsol ba: /rig sngags nus pa mthar phyin brag steng pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa chen la/ gsol ba: /mkhas dbang rig 'dzin mnga' brnyes bsod nams rtse/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son rje btsun pa/ /lnga rigs mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa paṇa la/ /gsol ba: dam chos 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /dam/ can bran du 'khol ba kun dga' grags/ /mkhas btsun bzang po dpal 'dzin kun bsod la/ /gsol ba /gsang chen gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rin chen rgyal/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje/ /ngur smrig 'dzin dbang dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ /gsol ba: /dbang lung gdams pa'i gter mdzod ngor chen la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros dbang phyug zhabs/ /smra ba zla med paṇa chen chos rje la/ /gsol ba: /rin chen byang chub thugs mnga' gzhon nu'i mtshan/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs/ /rab zhi dul ba'i dpal 'dzin rje ring —86—

dbon/ /gsol ba /ma lus rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bshes gnyen dam par snang ba sgrol ba'i mgon/ /zab don smra ba'i khyu mchog ye shes zhabs/ /gsol ba: /nus mthu'i rlabs mnga' kun dga' don yod dang / /mtshan legs dar rgyas kun dga' don grub dang / /yon tan lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba: /yon tan gter mdzod rin chen mnyam bzhag dang / /gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin ngas/ dbang yon tan dang / /zab lam mthar thug kun dga' dar rgyas zhabs/ /gsol ba: khyab bdag bla ma kun dga' blo bzang dang / /zab don spel mdzad ngag dbang bsam gtan sogs/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba: /rdo rje brag rdzong dmar nag 'jigs rung bar/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan bzhugs pa'i/ /rab 'jigs khro chen rnam bcu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis ye shes las/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i rigs sngags sgra brgya pa/ /grags stong brjod bral rnam mang bzlas brjod kyis/ /gsang sngags nus pa brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i mngon spyod kyis/ /'phrin las thogs pa med par kun 'grub nas / /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don spyod cing / /thub bstan nyin mor byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje nag po chen por gur gyis mgon po'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang dge slong brtan pa'i rdo rje bas bskul ba'i ngor/ dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos thun gcig la bris pa dge'o// // dge legs 'phel//brgyud 'di'i kha skong ni yang na/ lung rig smra ba'i khyu mchog sgrol ba'i mgon/ /—87—

mthu stobs 'gran zla med par don yod zhabs/ /ngag nus mthar phyin mtshan legs sangs rgyas la/ /gsol ba: /mthu stobs mkhyen pa'i byin rlabs rnam par rgyal/ /gnas lugs mthar phyin yon tan lhun grub zhabs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /gsol ba: /dam pas rjes gzung kun dga' dar rgyal mtshan/ /rdo rje 'dzin dngos 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag lhun grub rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba /

'dus gsal tshang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje he ru ka /rab khros mgon la btud byas nas/ /mchog tu zab par grags pa yi/ /bsrung bzlog bsad gsum mdo tsam bri/ /mgon po khro bcu'i sgrub thabs las brtsams nas/ bsnyen pa'i man ngag bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong mar grags pa'i rgyun khyer gyi ngag 'don dang / las tshogs bsrung bzlog bsad pa'i man ngag nyer mkho cung zad bri bar bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la bya'o/ /swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sum las rdo rje brag rdzong dmar nag zur gsum stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag rab tu yangs pa/ de'i nang du paX las pad+ma/ raX las nyi ma/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la gnas pa'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje sa gzhir ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du/hūX bhuX hūX/ sngon po zhu ba las byung ba'i gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ go skabs med par gyur/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du huX mthing nag re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid rdo rje nag po chen po dus kyi mun —89—

pa lta bu'i sku mdog can che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/phyag gnyis can gyi dbus na rnam sprul gyi ga rnye bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung 'gyel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro yi steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na lcags spyang / mdun na mi nag /steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor las byed sprul pa yang sprul/ sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /phyogs bcu'i mgon po rnams ni gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing / zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/phyag mtshan ga rnye spangs pa/ pho nya drag gtum gyi rnam pa can no/ /bsrung ba'i snyen ra lo'i phyi rol na/ dur khrod wo po brgyad du phyogs skyong ba rnams dang / pho nya sde brgyad kyis bskor bar gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga'i hūX las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad/ dpal mgon po bcu gcig /bsrung ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa la rdo rje khro bo dam can bsrung —90—

ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol bar btang pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a nyi khiñtsa huX/zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pā ri wā ra/ zhes re re sbyar nas/ ar+ghaX: nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ huX/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi rnam 'phrul las/ ye shes gcig nyid mgon po nag po'i tshul/ /gang 'dul rnam 'phrul mtha' yas ston pa'i sku/ /de la bstod byed gus pas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas bar 'dir 'og nas 'chad pa'i gnad lnga po gsal btab/oX badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūX bhuX hūX phaṭa/ ces brjod/ oṃ mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya huX huX phaṭa swahā/ zhes pa dang / sham bu can sogs mang du bzla zhing / mjug tu dgra bgegs bsad bcad kyis las mdzad par bsam ste/ shā sa na spel tshig med pa'am/spel tshig can skabs su gang bab nyer gcig nas brgya rtsa'i bar bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka': dge 'dun gyi: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi: dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bka': bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin dang /—91—
