phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rigs sngags kyi gzhi 'di 'grub par gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /phyir la bzlog par gyur cig /bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs dang / byad ma thams cad kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad dbyings su zhi bar gyur cig /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar: /yid bcing bar: /mthu brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par rdzu 'phrul brlag par des sgrub pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig /des sgrub pa'i srung ma dang lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha la za bar gyur cig /de'i ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya dang /sngags dang / rdzas dang / 'khor lo thams cad kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cigabyad mar rang gshed rang la 'bab par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag gi rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / lo skeg dang / zla skeg dang / zhag skeg dang / nad chags dang gdon chags dang bdud g.yos dang sri langs pa la sogs chags che nyam nga dang /mdor na bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir la bzlog par gyur cig /ces sogs dmod pa dang bcas te thal mo brdabs/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa —92—

rnams/ /'dul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ khren tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rung se pa rnams tshar gcod shog /slar yang sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i gzer bu'i dmigs pa tshar gcig yid la bsgom/ mchod bstod byas nas 'od gsal du bsdus la/cung zad mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyis sngon bzhin grub par 'gyur/ ces brjod/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ sngags gsum po tshar gcig brjod/ gnas lus longs spyod snang ba thams cad byin gyis brlabs so/ / rdzodage ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam dang / sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das/ sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyang brjod do/ /de dag ni ngag 'don gyi rim pa'o/ /tshul 'di'i bsnyen pa bskyal nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i las tshogs bsgrub par bya'o/ /da ni dkyus dang khyad par gyi man ngag rnams mdo tsam bshad par bya ste/de la dkyus kyi man ngag ni gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bzlas pa'i skabs su gnad lnga dang ldan par bya ba yin te/ de dag rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mchod bstod dang bcas pa grub/ mtshams su/ thog mar dmigs pa 'di rnams legs par gsal btang nas/ de rjes dmigs pa de'i rgyun la gnas pas bzlas par bya'o/ /de la gnad lnga'i dang po sgrub bya'i lus sba ba'i gnad ni/rang nyid mgon po'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar gri gug gi yu ba rdo rje'i rnam par gnas pa lte bar sbubs stong gi nang du/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sems huX yig nag por bsgom/ bsrung bya de rang gi bla ma yin na huX gi klad kor gyi nang du bsgom/ de bzhin du/ pha ma la sogs pa bkur bar 'os pa yin na huX gi mdun du bsgom/ pho nyid g.yas dang / mo nyid g.yon dang / slob ma dang g.yog 'khor —93—ri

rgyab dang / nor rdzas 'og tu bsam mo/ /yul khams sogs te sde chen po bsrung ba la hūX gi 'og tu sgom pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ 'khor lo'i nang du tshud par sgom pa tsam gyis chog go /bsrung bya phyi nang gang du bkod kyang / de dag gi mtha' skor du rtsa sngags dang snying po dang nye snying gi yig 'bru 'od zer 'bar bas bskor bar bsgom/gnad gnyis pa ming sba ba ni/ bsrung bya de bla ma yin na de nyid kyi thugs kar mtshan gyis yi ge dang po bsam/ zhes pa dang / bsrung bya gzhan la hūX gi zhabs kyu'i nang du de nyid kyi ming yig dang po bsam/ zhes 'byung yang / man ngag lag len du ming yongs rdzogs rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX gis mtha' brten pas/ oṃ gyis mgo 'dren dang bcas pa bsgom na legs par bzhed de/ oṃ che ge mor rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnad gsum pa yid sba ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i huX de nyid bsrung bya rnams kyi yid kyi ngo bor mos par bya'o/ /oṃ las rdo rje'i phra mo dpag tu med pa spros nas/ rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus la go mtshams med par gtams par bsam mo/ /gnad bzhi pa sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i gnad ni/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma/ lha dang drang srong la sogs pa thams cad kyi sku byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas/ rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las 'od 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/—94—

lus kyi sdig sgrib nga/ga /lha 'dres lus byad du bcug pa sogs nyes skyon rnams dbyings su yal/ rdo rje'i sku mi 'gyur ba tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos de bzhin du rigs 'gres te/ mgrin par āXlas pad+ma dmar pos āXs mtshan pa dang / gsung gi byin rlabs bsdu ba dang / 'od kyi rang gi lus la khyab pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /ngag mnan pa la sogs sbyangs/ rdo rje'i gsung gi nus mthu thogs pa med par grub par mos/ de bzhin du/ snying gar hūX las rdo rje sngon po huX gis mtshan pa dang / thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdu ba dang / 'od kyis lus nang gang bas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /rdzas sngags sogs kyis mnan zhing gzir ba'i rten 'brel las rmongs shing 'khrul ba la sogs pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i thugs mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par mos/ rang gi lce hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan par bsam mo/ /gnad lnga pa 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnad ni/ rang gis bsgom pa'i 'khor lo las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad hūX dang huX yig bhuX yig gi rnam par spyan drangs te 'khor lo la thim pas nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur par bsam la/ badz+ra tsakra'i sngags lan gsum brjod pa/ bsrung pa'i 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor bas nad gdon dgra bgegs byad ma la sogs pa rnams 'khor lo dang me 'od kyis thal bar brlag par bsam mo/ dmigs bsal gyi bzlog pa dang bsad pa dgos pa med kyang sha sa na bzla ba'i skabs su rang gi thugs ka nas pho nya dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs sogs/mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad me rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhags pa —95—

lcags kyu'i spyor bas drangs shig bkug nas/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi bar du bzhag pas/ 'khor los gtubs/ mes bsregs/ rlud gis gtor/ rnam par shes pa dbyings su spar bar bsgom ste/ 'di ni bsrung ba'i zhor la 'ong ba'i bsad dmigs tsam yin no/ /dmigs bsal yod na/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar 'brub khung gi nang du bsgrub bya lces brang khebs pa'i steng du 'khor los mnan par bsgom/ 'khor lo bskor bas phye mar brlag par bsam/ de bzhin du dmod pa brjod pa'i skabs/lag mthil g.yas su nyi ma dang / g.yon du zla ba la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rab tu yangs pa re bsam nas/ de'i bar du dgra bgegs log 'dren bdud dang byad ma/ mtshan ltas ngan pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dir skad cig gis bkug nas/ phye mar btags shing rjes med du 'gyur bar bsam la thal mo brdab/ 'di yang bsrung ba'i zhor las 'ongs pa'i bzlog dmigs tsam yin te/ de yan chad ni/ bsrung bzlog gzhan dang yang phal cher mthun mod kyi/ 'on kyang gzhan nas kha bskang ba ma yin par 'di'i rang lugs kyi man ngag tu gsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi man ngag zhes grags pa ni/ u zhin rā lugs kyi man ngag 'gar mo logs su sbyar ba yin kyang / 'di bzhin lag len du mdzad pas byin rlabs dang nus mthu tshan che la rno zhing myur bar 'byung / zhes grags so/ /de yang mdo tsam brjod na/ btsan po mkhar du bzhugs pa/ khams gsum g.yul du bcad pa/ rno gsum mtshon du brdung ba/ 'khor los jag pa 'gyed pa —96—

ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ gong gi gnad lnga song nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam la sogs pa spyan drangs nas/ lha bcu gcig la thim pas so/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sku 'od zer me dpung mtha' med du 'bar bas gnod byed 'joms pa'i nus pa can du mos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor lo je cher song nas stong gsum khyab pa dang / sra brtan rno ngar shugs drag dang ldan pas myur du 'khor zhing / sgra dang me 'od kyi phyogs mtshams thams cad la khyab pas srid gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad cher sngangs te/ bdag la mgon skyabs su zhu bar bsam/ de rjes rang dang gnod byed lha dang 'khor lo/ mdor na khams gsum 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba snang stong sgyu ma tsam du thag bcad de khyab brdal gyi dbyings der bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ yang mgon po bcu gcig gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nus mthu thams cad bkug nas rang dang 'khor lo la bstims/ 'khor lo 'bar ba las mtshon cha dang me'i bu yug chen po 'tshubs te/ sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu grags pa ltar bsgrags pas/ gnod byed thams cad rdul bzhin brlag par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ bsrung ba dang / bzlog pa/ bsad pa dang gsum las dang po ni/ gro ga la sogs pa'i gzhi la 'gi haX dang gur gum bsres pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs su bcu/nang du mu khyud cig /phyi ma la mu khyud gnyis/ de'i phyi rol rdo rje rwa ba dang me ris bskor/ dbus dang rtsibs bcu la hūX re re/ de rnams kyi mthar oX mahā kā la huX —97—

phaṭa che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa dang / mu khyud nang ma la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya che ge mo dang byad ma gdon bgegs sogs las srungs shig hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu'i spel tshig skabs su gang babs sbyar/ rtsibs mchan rnams la'ang yi ge bdun pa las bcol dang bcas pa gong bzhin bri/ mu khyud nang ma la sha sa na dang gong bzhin gnod byed byad kha sogs/ mu khyud phyi ma la rten 'brel snying po 'bri/ de la rab gnas bya ba ni/ bdag bskyed la 'don pa spo/ mthar gtor 'bul rgyas par bya/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i yig 'brur gyur/ ces brjod/ sngags rnams brgya rtsas byin gyis brlabs la/ ye dharma nyer gcig gis brtan zhugs byas la shis pa brjod/ de nas lag len bzhin lte ba la tshon skud kyis dkris nas/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gang rung la 'dogs/ gnad snga ma rnams song mtshams su/ 'khor lo de la lag pas reg pas 'khor lo las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad sgom pa'i bsrung 'khor dang 'dra ba spyan drangs/ bris pa'i 'khor lo la thim pas nus mthu dang gzi brjid dpag tu med par 'gyur/ snying po bdun rtsa sngags bdun/ rten 'brel snying po gsum bzlas pas bdag la bsrung bar bsam/ bsrung ba la de tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa bzlog pa ni/ 'khor lo snga ma'i steng nas mdzad pa'i lag len 'dug kyang / bzlog pa'i 'khor lo logs su bris na legs pas dug khrag dang 'gi haX bsres pa nas/ yig 'bru rnams mgo nang du bstan pa dang / bsrung ba'i spel tshig gi tshab tu/ 'di zhes bya ba la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad —98—

ma thams cad mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ yan+t+ra mas karma pra tuX gi ra hri stuX bha ya laX/ byad ma 'di gī li ki la ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa dri ba ni khyad par ro/ /gong du bshad pa'i bsrung ba de song ba'i rjes la byin rlabs bsdu tshul dang / brtan byed kyi sngags sngar bsrung ba'i skabs bzhin byed/ mgon po bcu gcig po cher khros/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po'i zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du zhal phyir gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor/ rtsibs rnams kyi bar mtshams su me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ ṇi las dgra dang byad ma/ dri las pho gdon/ srin las mo gdon rnams lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ skyabs dang bral ba/ yan lag bcings pa/ gcer bu 'dar ba/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'dug par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs mtshone cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros/ zhags pa dang / lcags kyus dgra bgegs bkug /mtsho ni chas bsdigs te sngar bsgoms pa'i gzugs brnyan la yang yang bstims/ 'khor lo bskor bas rkang pa nas spyi bo'i bar du nyi ma nyil gtubs/ mes bsregs/ thal ba rlud gis gtor/ slar yang dgra dang byad ma'i lha dang srung ma dang dpung gnyen rnams tshur 'ongs pas 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas/ nang du 'ong sa ma rnyed cing / rwa ba dang me'i 'og la thogs te pha rol tu'ang 'gro sa ma rnyed nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya drag gtum mi bzad pa rnams kyis skad cig la bzung zhing mtshon chas brdegasha khrag rus gsum zhal du gsol ba/ lhag ma tsam yang med par byas/ pho nya rnams rang la thim pas dgra bgegs byad ma lha bsrung dpung gnyen dang bcas —99—

pa'i lus srog tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs dang bcud thams cad rang la byung bar bsams la/ shā sa na'i mjug gi rbad bsad la ming yig spel nas bzlas te/ de yang dmigs bsal yod na ming dngos su gzhug la/ spyi bzlog la byed na/ e dam du niX/ dgra bgegs dang byad ma kha kha/ dgra bgegs dang byad ma sku hi 'a hi/ dgra bgegs dang byad ma mā ra mā ra/ de bzhin du sbyar te/dgra bgegs dang byad ma 'di na mi ge na mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces drag tu 'don no/ /yang rgyal 'gong dang btsan dang / bdud lta bu'i gnod pa yod na spyir dmigs pa gong dang 'dra zhing nyam sa dang rmi lam du cho 'phrul nges pa can 'ongs na dri las rnam pa cho 'phrul de nyid 'dra ba bskyed cing dgug /sha sa na'i mjug tu/ oX shrī mahā kā la ya/ sarba ro myag kha thim/ srog gzer phur nan/ drig phyung /hri tri shag rbad/ ces btags pa bzlas/ pho gdon mo gdon thams cad la 'di kho na sbyar ro/ /klu la gtad khram byas pa sogs yod na/ dmigs pa snga ma bzhin bsgoms pa'i rjes su/ sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams las rdo rje rgya gram dang ri rab lhun po dpag tu med pa spros nas/ gnod byed klu gnyan rnams dang /de'i dpung gnyen gtad khram gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru la sogs pa thams cad dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par mnan par bsam/ sngags ni shā sana'i mjug tu/ oX shrī mahā kā la ya/ na ga sha ri raX bi spo ṭa ya/ tshin+ta tshin+ta/ bin+ta bin+ta/ na ga naX hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /༈ yang dmigs gsal can gyi rbod gtong drag po yod na/ spyi 'gro'i man ngag gis bzlog ma thub na/ dmigs gzhi snga ma bzhin du bsgoms nas/ dgug —100—

gzhug gi sngon la byad ma de'i yi dam chos skyong sogs ngo shes na de nyid de'i rnam pa sngags kyi yig 'brus bskor bar bsgom gang yin mi shes na khro bo kha dog mi gcig pa lnga ā li kā lis bskor ba 'od dang ldan par bsgom/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros/ byad ma'i bsrung 'khor la reg pas lci bas dngul chu sdud pa ltar tshur bsdus te/ rang gi bsgom pa'i bsrung 'khor la thim/ yang 'od 'phros byad ma'i yi dam chos skyong / lha sgom sngags bzlas/ rdzas dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar tshur bsdus te/ bdag nyid gtso 'khor bcu gcig la thim/ nus mthu dang gzi brjed dpag tu med par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros byad ma'i bsrung ma rnams kyi snying gar phog /de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dwangs ma rnams huX gi rnam par bsdus nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i huX gi zhabs kyu'i 'og tu 'gyel stabs su mnan par bsgom/ de ni byad ma'i lha bsrung btson du bzung zhes bya ba yin no/ /yang 'od 'phros byad ma'i mdangs lha stobs dang bral ba de pho nya rnams kyi bkug pa yan chad sngar bzhin bsgoms pa las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa de rnams lan gsum lnga/ bdun sogs bskyar gyin bsgom pa gal che/sngags ni shā sa na'i mjug tu/ oṃ shrī ma mahā kā la ya gī li gī li la ya che ge mo ma ra ya dzaXgī li gī la ya sbyoXbazlog rbad/ ces drag tu bzlas shing / shin tu rtsub na dgra dang byad ma'i bsrung ma tshur rnams 'ongs pa la/ pho nya drag gtum mi bzad pa rnams kyis brdeg pas de rnams phar log nas dgra dang byad ma de nyid —101—

thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byas par bsam/ gzhan yang skabs su pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te byad ma'i yul dang lha bsrung thams cad bcom bsrung ba dang mtshon cha rnams bdag nyid kyi bsrung ba dang / lag char yang byas par bsam/gong du bshad pa'i dmod pa yang yang gdab bo/ /'di rnams gtso bor bzlog pa yin yang bsad pa'ang zhor la yod pas bzlog bsad stabs gcig pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa bsad pa ni/ 'khor lo ni gong du bshad pa'i bzlog 'khor de nyid bzlog bsad stabs gcig pa yin pas/ de ka 'dra ba gcig gis kyang rung tsam yin la/ bsad 'khor dngos ni/ 'khor lo'i lte bar byad ma'i liṅga lce snying gar slebs pa'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram nye ba la huX sngags kyis bskor/ 'grub na rtsibs bcu la'ang de bzhin du 'bri/ lid+ma'i mthar byad ma mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces spel ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ rang gi lag mgo dang / gtor ma'i 'og tu yang lid+ma'i mthar bsad sngags kyis bskor ba'i lce'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bzlog 'khor bsdus pa dang phal cher 'dra bas mnan pa re re bri/ de bzhin du g.yul 'thab pa'i sa'am/ mi ro bsregs pa'i shul gyi sa zhag ma lon pa la sogs pa ji ltar rnyed pa blangs te/ dug khrag la sogs pa bsres pa la 'brub khung gru gsum tshad ji ltar rigs pa zhig rang gi mdun gyi phyogs/ rang gi phyogs su logs bstan pa stan las dma' ba zhig tu yod par bya/ de'i nang ro sol gyis byugs/ dug khrag byugs pa'i rtsang nyer gcig gis kha khyer la bskor de'i nang du gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bsad pa'i 'khor lo de gzhug dgos pa —102—

yin la/ de yang 'di ltar bya ste/ shog bu la khrag chen gyis cung zad byugs la/slar dug dang / khrag dang / ske tshe dang / lan tshwa rnams bsres pa'i snag tshas/'khor lo kha sbyor ram rkyang ba gang rung zhig 'dri ba yin pa la/ kha sbyor ltar na steng 'khor g.yas bskor dang / 'og 'khor g.yon bskor du bri bar byed la/ de gnyis snyoms shing 'grigs pa zhig dgos pas/ btsag bar gyi 'khor lo zhig logs su btsos nas des 'debs pa'am/ 'khor lo gcig bris zin pa'i steng du sol ba'i ri mo btab ste/ cig shos la bzha' 'phab par byas kyang rung ngo / /de'i dbus su bris pa'i liṅga sngags can zhig kyang gzhug /'khor lo chig rkyang byed na'ang bris pa'i liṅga zhig 'khor lo'i lte ba'i thad du sbyar dgos/ gang ltar yang lag len bzhin btab/ ro skras bcings/ rnyed na thod pa gling brgyad dgu bcu pa gsum gang rnyed/ pho thod mo thod kha sbyor du byas/ ma rnyed na de 'dra ba pho thod kha sbyor ram/ mo thod kha sbyor gyis kyang yong / de yang ma rnyed na thod pa de 'dra ba gcig nyid la dum bu gnyis su byed pa'i thod tshal kha sbyor ram/ thod pa gcig nyid kyi nang du bzhag kyang rung bar mngon/ gang ltar yang 'khor lo de dgra bo'i dri ma drug po gang rnyed dam/ rkang rjes kyi sa dang zos lhag la sogs rnyed nas bsres pa'i phung shul gyi sa la liṅga byas pa'i de'i snying gar gzhugade la dgug gzhug yang yang byas te/ bsad 'khor lhag pa kha sbyor gyi lugs gcig bris nas liṅga de'i steng 'og nas g.yogs pa'i lag len yang yod pa ltar ram/ de ma byas kyang rung ste skud pa sngo dmar gyis bcings/ thod pa'i nang du dug dang ro thal sogs kyis bkang ba la gzhug /thod pa steng ma la thun khung —103—

bzhag /phyi nas skras bcings par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i thod pa 'brub khung der bcug /ro g.yam la nang du bsad pa'i 'khor lo dang / phyi ma rdo rje rgya gram ri rab dang bcas pa bris pas kha bcad/ skam thun rlon thun dang / lcags sam seng lding dam/ mi rus kyi phur bu'ang phur gdan dang bcas pa bshams/phyogs gzhan zhig tu nyin re bzhin du bya ba'i 'brub khung dang / zan ling yang bshams dgos shing / 'brub khung gi rgyab phyogs su rten dang mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ thun bzhi la sogs par 'di nyid kyi thun gyi mgo zhabs gang yang rung ba/ de gtor 'bul dang bskang bshags gnad du 'gro ba re re byed pa gal che/ gtor ma ni thun gtor re re ma chags par 'bul zhing phyir btang /rgyun gtor thun bzhir gsos la 'bul/ gta' gtor thun bzhir gso zhing byin gyis brlabs la mi 'bul bar dar gyis bkab la/ las 'di grub na 'bul lo/ /zhes bya/dngos gzhi phal cher gong gi bzlog pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bsrung 'khor gyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye bar 'brub khung gi nang du dgra bo'i byad ma gan rkyal du gnas pa lces brang khebs pa'i steng du 'khor lo'i mar rtse bcugs pa'i lce dang snying phug cing de'i thog tu 'khor lo bskor bar bsam/ rtsibs kyi bar du byad ma bsad bcad gtub pa sogs bzlog pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba/ khyad par skabs 'dir bzlas pa mang du song mtshams nas mdun gyi zan ling la dmigs nas/ dgug gzhug lan gsum sogs song mtshams su shā sa na bzla bzhin du liṅga dum bur gtub la gtor ma la btab/ bdag bskyed mdun —104—

bskyed 'khor lo'i lha gsum char la dmigs nas gtor ma 'bul/ 'phrin las drag tu bskul/ 'brub khung kha phyes nas thod pa'i nang gi liṅga la dgug gzhug drag tu bya zhing / mthar yi dam chos skyong gi rtsa sngags sbrel ba'i mjug la/ dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba'i bla srog a r+ṣa ya dza dzaX che ge mo a ni shag phye shag phye khug ling a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaX zhes btags pa ci mang du bzlas nas/ mthar dzaXhuX baX hoX lan mang pos bcing bar mos la 'brub khung kha bkab bo/ /thun dang phur ba'i lha la dmigs te 'og tu 'chad pa'i thun sngags dang phur ba'i sngags kyang drag tu bzla/ thun mtshams su bsrung ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas phyi phreng dang nam phyed la sogs pa'i dus su sgrub khang gi phyi rol du gtor ma zhig khyer la/ 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis bsas/dgra bo'i lha la dmigs nas bden pa bdar de dgug /a kā ro lan mang pos 'bul/ dpang gzung bcol zhing shags mang du btab/ dgra dang byad ma'i dpung gnyen ma byed pa bdag gi grogs gyis la gnod byed 'di rdul du rlog cig /ces sogs brjod/ ga smo zhes rang gnas su btang la/ sngags kyi mthar dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba 'go ba'i lha dang phrol/ zhig bi de sha ya phaṭaX aṇ+ḍi shag phye shag phye/ zhes btags pa lan nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa dang / de'i lha rnams ma he dang 'ug pa bzhon pa dang / de rnams nyid du rta dang bya rog la bzhon pa phan tshun sdang sems drag pos 'thab pas dgra bo rnams rdul du brlag par bsam/ yang gtor ma gcig yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad spyi la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma'i cho gas phul/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzu shag —105—

'debs/ 'phrin las bcol nas/ de bzhin du byed par bsam/ bsrung ba dang bcas pas nang du 'ongs/ tshul de lta bu'i khug pa'i rtags byung ngam/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gam gnyis sam/ gsum gyi bar bgrub bo/ /༈de nas bsad pa dngos ni/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ thod pa'i nang gi liṅga la dgug gzhug song mtshams su de dgra bo dngos su bsam zhing / de'i snying gar yang 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i dbus na khro bo bcu gcig dngos su yod par mos/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar nas mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spros/ de'i lus la gnas pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la mchod par bsam la/ ar+ghaX sogs brjod/ 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams rang la bstim pa'am/ dbyings su gshegs/ 'jig rten pa rnams ring du bskrad par bsam/ sgrub bya'i sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i kha rje dbang thang /tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad snying gar hūX gi rnam par 'dus/ spyi gtsug nas phyung ste bdag la bstim pa'i mos pa bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dgra bo'i snying ga'i 'khor lo la phog snyen ra lo g.yon 'khor du drag tu 'khor bar srog rtsa don snying nang khrol thams cad nang nas gtubs/bdag bskyed kyi 'khor lo g.yas su bskor bas phyi nas gtubs te sngar spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / gzhan yang pho nya srin po gdug pa can dpag tu med pa sprul nas sha chom rus chom du zos par bsam la/ sngags bdun tsam bzla/ yang dmigs pa de ka 'dra ba las/ 'khor lo gnyis kyis dum bur gtub pa mes bsreg /rlung gis gtor bar bsam ste sngags bdun tsam bzla/—106—

yang dmigs pa de ka 'dra ba las/ dum bur gtubs zin pa'i mtshams su slar yang lhag ma de nyid dang / dgra bo'i yul khams la dmigs nas dug dang me dang ma rdzo cha'i char chen po spros te/ de'i gnas lus longs spyod 'khor g.yog nye ba'i lha dang rgyab bsten thams cad ming tsam yang med par brlag par bsam la/ sngags bdun tsam bzla ba'o/ /de la sngags ni sha sa na'i mjug tu/ sarba sha truX ma ra ya phaṭaX tshin+ta tshin+ta oṃ mahā ka la ya/ sarba sha truX mā ra ya rbad/ man+t+ra tsakra rbad/ ya ma tsakra rbad/ dgra bo'i dbugs la thum ril hri la/ snying la chum chum srog la bam ril li li rdza rdzaX zhes btags pa'o/ /las mgon rnams kyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum yang ci rigs bzlas na shin tu legs so/ /de dag ni bsgom bzlas kyis bsad pa'o/ /de nas skam thun rlon thun ni/ thun khung du gdab cing / gong gi sngags kyi mthar su mi tra ga rak+ṣa spyoX thibs thibs tsakra spyoX snying ga rag bdun dri sbyoXrbad rbad dri na shig shig se na gtub gtub/ kha rag rbad dum bu smyoX badz+ra tsi tri rak+ṣa tsa tri ya mā ra ya spyo lcoX zhes drag tu brjod de/ thun gyis bsad pa'o/ /phur bu skad cig gis gur gyi mgon po nye ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can bsgom ste/ shā sa na'i mjug tu/ mahā gī la badz+ra gī lī gī la ya sarba sha truX mā ra ya phaṭa/ces lan bdun tsam bzlas pa'i rjes la/ phur bu de nyid lag tu blangs zhing /lid+ma'i steng du drag tu bsgril la/ sngags de nyid drag tu bzla/ dmigs pa ni gnas lngar phur bus btab pas sha khrag tu mer gyis song ba mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gsol bar bsam/ yang 'brub khung kha bcad pa sogs sngar bzhin —107—

no/ /de ltar zhag bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs par bsgrubs pas bsad ba'i las 'grub tu nye rtags byung na/ gta' gtor de 'bul/ 'brub khung de nyid du ro'i 'gal dum dang / tsher ma'i shing la dug khrag byugs pa'i bud shing brtsegs/ drag po'i mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ khrag dang snum nag bsres pa dang / bra bo dang sran nag dang / yungs dkar nag dang / sha rus skra shad/ rnga mong dang bong ba'i sbangs dang / tsher ma'i yam shing la sogs pa 'du byas/dmigs pa gong bzhin las thab khung du mgon po bcu gcig phyogs skyong las mkhan dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed/ snying po bzla bzhin me spar/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas mchod bstod dam bzhag rnams gtor bsngo ltar byas/ zan ling bsgral ba de mi dgos/ de rjes thod pa kha phyes nas/ liṅga dgug gzhug bya ba nas bzung / phur bas bsad pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ gnas lngar phur bus dngos su btab/ shā sa na bzla bzhin mtshon chas gtub/ 'khor lo la mi gnod par bya'o/ /shā sa na spel tshig sham bu dang bcas pa kho na bzla zhing zhal du bstab par mos la bsregs/ de bzhin du bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyang bsregs mthar 'khor lo yang bsregs te/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ bzod gsol gshegs gsol bkra shis kyi bar du byas te/ gtor chog dang bskang ba'i yi ger bshad pa bzhin no/ /'di las mtha' bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg yin pas 'di kho na'i chog te/ spyin sreg spyi 'gro'i lugs kyi cho ga lhag ma rnams kyang mi dgos so /—108—

de nas mnan pa la/ lid+ma'i phyi dril gyi de yod na de las bya ste/ de med na bsad 'khor snga ma dang 'dra ba bris te/ kha sbyor gyi bar ram rkyang ba'i nang du liṅga bcu/ga /dgug gzhug drag tu byas nas blteb ste/ sbyin bsreg thal ba dang bcas pa sngar gyi thod pa kha sbyor ba de'i nang du bcug /re bas dril/ mi shi ba'i skras bcings/ lam rgya gram mam mchod rten la sogs pa'i sar song la/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma dang / klu dang gshin rje la'ang ming nas smos pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ de nas badz+ra tra tha zhes brjod cing dang po blus la klu dang shin rje ral pa tshar dgu'i lto ba rim gyis dral te gshin rje'i lto bar bcug par mos la dong gi nang du sbas/ sa dang chus cung zad mnan la/ e la tsakra kha thim mā ra ya tsakra kha thim/ zhes brjod/ gshin rje'i lto ba srub par bsam/yang de bzhin du byas pas klu'i lto ba srub par bsam/ sbyin sreg thal ba'i ‘lhag ma dang / gtor ma rnying pa'ang de ru thug la/ slar yang sa chu rim pa bdun gyis bkab/ de'i steng du 'brub khung gi kha bcod des mnan/ de nas sas g.yogs te mi mngon par bya'o/ /de'i steng du bdag nyid 'dug nas mgon po 'khor bcas dang / klu dang gshin rje dang gzhi bdag rnams la dmod bcol drag tu bya/phyi mig mi ltar bar logs la gtad lam bcad de sgrub khung du 'jugatshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /mnan pas bsad pa'o/ /༈ zor gyis bsad pa ni/ de nas las la grub kyi bar du drag tu bskul/mgon po khro bcu'i gtor ma zor ram/ dmar chen gtor chog ltar zor yang —109—

yang 'phang bar bya ste/ zor gyis bsad pa'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje brag rdzong ma 'di nyid las 'phros pa'i bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag gnad che ba rnams gsal bar brjod zin to/ /bsrung ba las 'phros pa'i nad yams bsrung ba dang / dmag bzlog pa la sogs pa dang / bzlog pa'i skabs na'ang sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi ming btags pa rnam grangs mang po dang / las sbyor gyi skabs na'ang / thun gyis bzlog pa/zor gyis bzlog pa/ gtor mas bzlog pa/ mnan pas bzlog pa la sogs pa'i rnam grangs du ma dang / sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag dang / gtor ma la brten te dgra bo la rang gshed rang la dbab pa sogs rnam grangs du ma zhig yod par 'dug na'ang / nyer mkho chung zhing gnad kyang chung bar mthong nas 'dir ma bris la/ nang gi man ngag yin zer bas/ rang gi snying gar dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kyi ngo bo rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma bsgom pa sogs kyang snyen rwa lugs kyi man ngag las/ bsrung bya sba ba'i skabs snying gar 'khor lo bsgom pa la 'dra min gyi man ngag byas par zin cing / gnad kyang shin tu chung bar mthong ngo / /'phros don rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni 'di yin te/ rang gi lto bar gshin rje dmar nag ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ kha gdangs pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba g.yon du 'khor ba'i steng du nyi ma g.yas su 'khor ba cig gsal gdab/ rang gi mdun du dgra dang gdon dang byad ma dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa gang byung ba de nyid gsal gdab/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la shā sa na/ sogs/ i daX du tsho/ gyi bar da/ga tu brjod/ rna rtse las 'od —110—

zer nag po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can mang du spros/ gnod byed dang mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug ste/ rang nyid mgon po'i skur gsal ba'i zhal du bcug /mtshon gyi bcom zhing phye mar btang / lto ba'i gshin rje'i zhal du gsol/ de'i lto bar nyi zla gnyis kyi bar du btags/ steng gi nyi mas bsregs/ 'og gi zla ba 'gyur byed kyi chu byung ste sbyangs/ mi dmigs par gyur par bsam/ 'di'i skabs steng rlung bzung la yid kyis/ kha kha khwa hi ji hi/man chad bzla/ mjug tu stong pas rgyas gdab/ de lta bu'i lan bdun nas nyer gcig gi bar skabs dang sbyar zhing bsgom/ sgom pa'i dus ni srod dang tho rangs la bsngags par byed/ de ltar zhag bdun byas pas/ rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad bzlog par gsungs te/ shin tu zab par yang 'khum mo/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i man ngag las/ /bsrung bzlog bsad gsum tshang ba yi/ /las tshogs mdo tsam bris pas kyang / /gdul dka' thams cad 'dul bar shog /ces pa 'di yang mdo stod pa dge bshes blo gros dpal bzang dang /mdo smad pa dbon po lhun grub rgyal mtshan sogs don gnyer mang pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // sarba maṅga lam// dge legs 'phel// //—111—

grub kun rdzo/ zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ mgon dkar yid bzhi nor bu'i mchod bskang dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba/bla ma rnams pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod rdzas rnams bshams shing / sngon 'gro btang / bdag mdun gtor 'bul sogs kyi rjes su/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du lha dang mi las khyad par 'phags pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs/ bskang rdzas sna tshogs/ grub rdzas sna tshogs/ 'dod yon sna tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang thugs rje las grub pa dang / khyad par du yang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su gang ba/ bla ma dang mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ 'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro grangs med/ las mdzad gnod spyin bzhi/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā warta ya a warta ho/oṃ badz+ra sa spa ra ṇa khaX swāhā/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med mchog /mgon dkar —112—

yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro grangs med dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang / /gnod spyin bzhi dang bka' nyan rnams/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu tshogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mnyes gyur nas/ /'gro kun dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /chos 'byor dge legs 'phel ba dang / /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma kā ma la stuX/ kun bzang mchong sprin rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rab dkar 'o ma'i mtsho/ /dwangs shing dri med rab dkar zhabs bsil dang / /ut+pal pad+ma u tam wā ra'i tshogs/ /sbyar dang lhan skyes dri zhim sbos kyi tshogs/ /nyi zla nor bu snang byed 'od gsal dang / /kur gum ga bur la sogs dri bzang tshogs/ /sman rnams 'bras dang sman mchog ro brgya'i zas/ /rab snyan sgra dbyangs mchod sprin dpag med kyis/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs dam bskang / /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med 'bum gyi: /las mdzad gnod spyin bzhi'i /'khor tshogs dam can rgyal po'i: /'khor dang bcas pa mchod pas dgyes gyur nas/ bdag cag 'khor bcas chos 'byor gong 'phel zhing / /byang chub bar gyi srung ma khyod kyis mdzod/ /bkra shis rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod sprin sogs/ /bkra shis phun tshogs mchod rdzas bkra shis kyis/ /bla ma —113—

mgon po /mgon dkar /mkha' 'gro /las mdzad : /'khor tshogs: /'khor dang bcas /bdag cag: /byang chub: /rab dkar mtshan ldan kun bzang ka pa lar/ /rab dkar ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /rab dkar phyag rgya yid kyis byin rlabs pa'i: /rab dkar ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'dis/ /bla ma mgon po: /mgon dkar /mkha' 'gro: /las mdzad /'khor tshogs: /'khor dang bcas /bdag cag /byang chub /rab mdzes lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /dkyus rings zur mig 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen zhing / /bde chen chags pas myos pa'i rnam 'gyu/ra mkhas/ /rab mdzes gsang yum lha mo 'bum phrag gis/ /bla ma mgon po: /mgon dkar /mkha' 'gro /las mdzad: /'khor tshogs /'khor dang bcas: /bdag cag: /byang chub: /rnam dag sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dang / /bdag gzhan sngags sogs ting 'dzin ye shes las/ /grub pas bdag po'i yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung rab dkar thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mgon po: /mgon dkar /mkha' 'gro: /las mdzad: /'khor tshogs: /'khor dang bcas: /bdag cag: /byang chub bar gyis: /nas 'bras gro sran til sogs 'bras bu'i tshogs/ khreng tog ka ra bu ram rgun 'brum dang / lga mar thud sogs zas mchog stong phrag dang / /ja chang 'o ma bdud rtsi sbrang gi bcud/ /sbyar dang rang byung bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser dngul mu tig rin chen bī skrurla/ /mar gad byu ru g.yu dang spol shel dang / /sra brtan mdzes pas go mtshon sna tshogs dang / /snam bu dar zab srab 'jam lha rdzas kyis/ /bla ma mgon po /—114—

mgon dkar: /mkha' 'gro /las mdzad /'khor tshogs: /'khor dang bcas: /bdag cag: /byang chub: /cang shes rta dang g.yang chags lug gi khyu/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang khyu mchog g.yang gi tshogs/ /seṅge stag dom dred sogs rkang bzhi dang / /gter bum dpag bsam shing dang g.yas 'khyil dung / /rin chen ri bo yid 'ong khang bzang dang / /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri zhim ro mchog gos/ /bsam kun rdzogs byed dgos 'dod nor bu yis/ /bla ma mgon tho /mgon dkar: /mkha' 'go las mdzad: /'khor tshogs: /'khor dang bcas /bdag cag /byang chub: /ri rgyal gling bzhi nyi zla gling phran bcas/ /stong gsum bgrang yas gzhi dang me tog gis/ /rgyan pa'i gangs can mtsho'i zhing khams kun/ /rang bzhin gyis grub mchod rdzas rgya mtsho dang / /dngos bshams yid sprul chod sprin mtha' yas pas/ /bla ma mgon po: /mgon dkar: /mkha' 'gro /las mdzad /'khor tshogs /'khor dang bcas: /bdag cag /byang chub bar gyi bsrung ma khyod kyis mdzod/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ lhun sdug gī la sha'i ri bo ltar/ /'od zer bye bas 'byud pa'i dpal 'phreng can/ /dbang sdud mkha' 'gro stong gi bdag po ni/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dzum bag brjid pas zhal ras yid tsam khro/ /'dod dgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal po khyod/ /chos nyid thig le sgong nga 'dod pa'i sems/ /dngos su gyur pa'i sku la /dngul chus mdangs gsal hūX yig las 'khrungs pa/ /skye 'gro re skong dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dbu skra gyen brjes sbyi bo mi bskyod rgyal/ /rgyas gdab chen po'i —115—

dbang bskur khyod la bstod/ kha ba ri la 'char kha gsar ba ltar/ khyod zhal smin mtshams si rgyur thig le 'dzes/ /rin chen gdu'u 'brol ba'i khyag drug pa/ /bla med pha rol phyin pa'i ngo bor bstod/ /gri gug yid bzhin nor bu ḍā ma sa /nor bus gtams pa'i thod pa bum par bcas/ /rtse gsum dngos grub 'gugs pas lcags kyu bsnams/ /phyag drug mgon po khyod la gus pas bstod/ /lhab lhub dar dang stag lbags na bza' can/ /'od 'bar rin chen brgyan kyis sil khrol dang / /nor bus chun 'phyang du mas rab brjid pa'i/ /gzi byin lhang nge 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod char chen 'beb byed pa/ /bi na ya ka'i steng na rol pas bzhugs/ /rab sngon tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshal na dgyes/ /gnas gsum zhaba' 'gro'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ /thugs kar dbang gi lha mo lang tsho ma/ /'char kha'i 'od ris gsal ba klog 'phran ltar/ /mdzes shing dngos grub g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'dzin/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / /snying nas lha mchog khyod la gdung ba yis/ /mchod gtor 'bul gyis bdag la mchog bstsal nas / /dpal dang 'dod pa'i don kun grub par mdzod/ /thugs rje'i sprin kyis dpal 'byor rgya mtsho rnams/ /gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /ces pa mgon dkar yid bzhi nor bu'i bstod bskang 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bcu dgu pa la'o// // maṅga laX// bkra shis//—116—

'a/ga stun ma bsdo/gas/yā man ta ka'i las byed snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/na mo badz+ra bhe ra bā ya/ rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa'i man ngag mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs ni 'di yin te/ bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa dang / las la sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bris sku'i mdun du rdo leb nag po'i maṇ+ḍal/ rang byung gis sbags pa'i tshom bu nag po can bshams pa'am/yang na bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal gang rung des kyang chog /mchod pa/ gtor ma/ nang mchod rak+ta rnams kyang bshams/ 'jigs mdzad chen po'i bdag bskyed gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la rdo rje brag ri gru gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du ṇi las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen gyi steng du gtso bo'i thugs ga nas hūX yig nag po me 'bar ba rab spros te 'khod/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ byin rlabs nus mthu rnams tshur 'dus huX la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā ka la sku mjo/ga dus kyi mun pa ltar ches gnag pa/ sbom zhing thung ba/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ gtum zhig khros pa/ 'tshams pa las 'das pa'i khro gtum drag shul can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin —117—

pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing 'dzings pa/ stag lpags dang / sbrul dang / mi mgos brgyan pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyis nang nas mgon po ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas pa oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX lan gsum/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blang dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la sbyan 'dren gyi/ /gnyis su med par gshegs su gsol/ /e hre hi mahā kā la ye/ huX dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dam tshig nyer 'ongs pa/ /bskyed pa'i dam tshig byin rlabs phyir/ /thugs rjes byon la brtan par bzhugs/ /sa ma ya ta snyi dzaXhūX baX hoX rang gi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rnams spros/ dam rdzas dang mchod pa'i sprin phung bstibs te/ cha byad sna tshogs dang bcas pas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'am gshin rje gshed pos dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ya ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma/ nang mchod/ rak+ta gsum yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar phyogs gcig tu byin gyis brlabs/ shā sa na lan gsum sogs kyis/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i bcu— mchog 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par mos te phul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod cing / nang mchod nas gtor ma la lan gsum bzlas/ shā sa na tshar gcig brjod de/ btung ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho gsol bar bsam/ oṃ mahā kā la ya sarba sdo zhin mā ra ya ma hā maX sa kha hi/ mahā rak+ta ji hi/ zhes lan gsum/ rak+ta lan gsum bran la/ shā san —118—

tshar gcig brjod de/ sha khrag rus pa gnam sa gang ba zhal du btab par mos/rab tu dgyes pas ha ha ho ho huX hūX zhes gsung bar gyur/ de nas thod pa'i phyag rgya byasal/ shā sa na'i mthar/ sa mā ya stuX/ sa ma yā ho/ lan gsum/ dpal nag po chen po khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod cig /bdud rtsi dang rak+ta bsres pa/ gtor ma la blugs/ huX ring po bdun/oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūX/ lan gsum/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' yi/ /khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig /rdo rje thugs kar gtugs la phyag tu gtad par bsam/bdud rtsi rang gi lce thog du'ang cung zad bzhag /bstod pa/ srin gzugs ma sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ dpal ldan nag po chen po yis/ /bdag la dgos pa'i don thams cad/ /bsam pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzodi// /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra bar gsal btab la/ skye( mahā kā la ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ci 'grub pa zla ste/ 'bum phrag bcu gnyis grangs bsnyen chung ngu dang /sum cu 'bring po dang / zhe brgyad chen por bzhed do/ /thun gyi gzhug tu/ ye shes mgon po'i thugs ka nas/ las mgon g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa mang por byon par bsam/ yid kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la/ oX mahā ka la gu ṇa hri da dzaXdzaX zhesapa bdun dang nyer gcig sogs cung zad bzla/ yang mgon po'i thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros nas mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ma mo nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa bkug /yid kyi mchod/ gtor ma'i lhag ma la dmigs nas/ oṃ mahā kā li raka mo ba —119—

ling ta pū dza grihā ho/ kha kha ji hi ji hi ma mo srog ji hi huX/ lan gsum oṃ mahā kā la ro dri du ma mo sha sha /dza dza hūX spyoXsbyoXzhes cung zad bzlas/ las mgon thugs kar thim/ma mor gnas su gshegs par sam/ oṃ mahā kā la dgra bo ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa'i rtsa ba'i bsad sngags dang / 'bod rbad bsad gsum gcig tu dril ba sha sa na dang / tseX( mahā kā la yak+ṣa mahā kā la shun thum dzaX dgra bo dam nyams kyi mgo lus pri pri phrol phrol dra ka rak+tas phyes phyes/ dum bu dum bu/ he lam 'a hi/ zhes pa drag po spu gri'i sngags rnams cung zad bzla'o/ shwa sa na la 'bum nas bzhi 'bum gyi bar song na legs/ sngags 'thor bu gzhan bzhi po rnams bzhi khri re bzlas nas so so'i bsnyen pa song ba'o/ /de yang 'di'i sgos kyi las sbyor byed na gal che ba yin/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i zhor la zor 'phen pa tsam byed pa la ni yi dam gyi bsnyen pa thems nas/ mgon po la yi ge bcu gnyis pa bzhi 'bum song rung ba tsam yin no/ /thun 'jog khar slar yang mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya bzod gsol rten la brtan bzhugs/ /mgron gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rwa lugs yin la/dus rgyun gyi gtor bsngo la ni gong bzhin rdzogs pas 'grub na'ang legs mod kyi/ ma grub na bris sku dang / maṇ+ḍal/ sman dang / rak+ta rnams med kyang chog /bzlas pa yang yi ge bcu gnyis cung zad tsam bzlas pa kho nas chog cing / mchod yon sogs kyang dngos su bsham ma thub na ting nge 'dzin gyis chog pas/ de'i tshe mchod pa byin rlabs kyang mi dgos shing / gtor chog gzhan dang sbrel nas byed na rjes chog la sogs pa mi dgos so/ /rwa ba'i mgon nag bya ba'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs lhad med rang de yin cing / sham bu can gyi sngags bzhi po de shin tu rno zhing myur ba'i phyir/ rgyud rkyang gi sgrub thabs man ngag med pa'i gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'ang yin la/ spyir ni mahā ka la 'dir ro langs chen po brgyad kyi spyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ dpal rdo rje — 120—

'jigs mdzad chen po'i bka' nyan thun mong ma yin pa'i gcig tu 'byung bas/ 'jigs mdzad chen po'i las tshogs sgrub pa la gal chen po'i zhu ba yin par go bar bya'o/ /'dir thog mar nye bar mkho ba la/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog chen mo gtong dus mgon po nag po'i gtor zor sde'i thung cha lag tu sbyor na/ dkyil 'khor chen mo'i phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu/ chos 'byung nag po mchu la gri gug gi 'phreng ba dang / phyi rol me ris bskor ba zhig bya/ dbus su nyi gdan la gri gug gam tshom bu nag po bkod/ de'i steng du stegs bu la lcags snod du 'bru nag dang / drag rdzas bsres pa'i gtor ma gru gsum/ khrag dang / ro sol gyi byug pa/ rtsa ba'i zur gsum du mi mgos mtshan pa/yungs kar dang / ke che'i gong bu dug shing gi tsher ma rnams dug khrag gis bkrus pa ci rigs pa btsug /mtha' la drag po'i mchod gtor gyis gru gsum du bskor/ 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi bsdebs la dpal gtor dang dar nag bi ba dan btsugs pa gcig kyang bshams/ mchod gtor rnams byin rlabs chen po'i skabs su yang dmigs pa gtad/ drug cu rtsa bzhi song mtshams su slar yang byin rlabs kha gso ba'i tshul gyis mchod pa byin rlabs shig bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong du bshad pa bzhin du bya/ yig brgya lan gsum sogs bzlas nas/sku'i dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lor bshags/ gsung gi: thugs kyi: rtsa ba'ijeyan lag sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal 'khrul thams cad so sor bshags/ 'thol bshags phul nas tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la dngos grub kyi sdong grogs dang / mthu stobs thog pa med par stsal nas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / bsrung ba nga/nga / bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ sngon gyi las — 121 —

las byung ba dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad gdon byur chag la sogs pa rkyen ngan thams cad bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad skad cig nyid la 'joms shing rdul du brlag par mdzad du gsol/ sarba u pa dra ba ni ba rā ya phaṭa/ ces las la bskul ba'i gsol ba btab/ 'di'i sgos kyi gtor chog yin na bar 'dir bskang ba rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa re byed dgos la/ sde thung sbyor ba'i skabs mchod 'phreng tsam gyi go chod pas/ ling ga sgrol chog grub pa'i rjes su gtor ma la ling du ma sgron zhing rak+ta gsar ba'ang blug nas/ dgra bgegs zhal du 'debs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ shā sa na bdun nas nyer gcig gi bar ji ltar 'os pa bzla zhing / gtor sngags thung ba dang / ma mo'i gtor sngags kyang lan bdun bdun brjod/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da gnod byed ma rā ya hūX phaṭa/ces dang / oX badz+ra kro dha mahā ka la yaX sha chun tsit+ta kro ti dun dzaX zhes pa dang / sbu gri'i sngags dang / kā la ro dre sngags rnams kyang drug cu re'am ji ltar 'os pa drag tu bzla'o/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ las gshin gyi skabs kyis bstod gsum ma la/ 'don pa bsgyur te phul/ de rjes bstod bskul ni/ hūX dpal ldan nag po chen po ni/ /bskal ba'i me dpung nang na bzhugs/ /mi ro'i steng nas sku byung ba/ /mdog nag thung la gsus pa che/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa myur du sgrol/ /g.yas kyi byeg gi gri gug gis/ /bstan la gnod pa'i snying rtsa mchod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa yis/ /dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag gsol/ /mche ba'i zla tshes rab gtsigs pa/ /'jig rten ma lus za bar byed/ /spyan gsum me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /gdug pa can rnams sreg par byed/ /rnal — 122—

'byor yongs kyi dgra lha khyod/ /bdud kun 'dul ba'i dmag dpon yin/ /dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma mdzod/ /mna' zan rnams kyi srog dbugs len/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma ste/ /nag po gtum po las la gshegs/ /bla ma la 'khu sems can 'tshe/ /chos 'khor 'di la sdang ba rnams/ /ma lus skad cig tsam gyis kyang / /'di nyid du ni rings par khug sha khrag nang khrol ma lus pa/ /dpa' bo chen pos myur du zo/ /de lus til tsam gtubs nas kyang / khyod kyi zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gal te de ltar ma byas na/ khyod nyid dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'das pas/ /snying khrag sa la lhung bar 'gyur/ /de bas dam tshig ma 'da' bar/ /gdug pa'i dgra 'di myur du sgrol/ /mahā kā la dgra bo'i srol la breng breng / rgyug rgyug /ya ya/ zhes lan gsum bskul/de nas zor 'phen pa'i skabs/ rdo zor/ yungs zor la sogs pa'i spyi dang mthun par 'phangs nas/gtor ma zhal bsgyur te/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sngon la 'phen dgos/ spro na spyi dang mthun par 'das dang ma byon ma'i bskul nas/ mthar rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas nas shā sa na bzla bzhin du 'phangs/de yang dgra bgegs byad ma kha kha/ dgra bgegs byad ma ji hi ji hi/ zhes pa lta bu ming spel sbyar nas so/ /tshogs dang rjes chog sogs la cho ga tshar gcig gis 'grub kyang dmigs pa'i skabs nag po chen po la 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ma chad pa gal che'o/ /bzlas pa'i rman ngag ni/ lce rdo rje rtse mo gsum pa/ yas rkan zla ba ā lis mtshan pa/ mas rkan nyi ma kā lis mtshan pas/ lce'i rtsa ba'i nang du sngags sgom/rang gi thugs ka nas snying po sogs bzlas sngags dang / ā li kā li dpag tu med pa byung / lce'i rtsa ba dang / ā li ka li la thim/ yang ā li kwa li 'od du zhu —123—

ste lce nang gi sngags la thim pas kha dog dang 'od rgyas shing nus pa brgya 'gyur du gyur/ de nas sngags bzlas pas snying ga dang lce'i 'od kyis bskul nas/ mgon po rang dbang med par las la 'khol bar bsam/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa song nas las kyi bsnyen pa ni dur khrod dang / phung shul dang / grog mkhar bdun gyis bsres pa'i maṇ+ḍal sa ste gru bzhir rgyar khru do/ /dpangs su khru gang yan chad ji ltar 'os pa/ de'i steng du dpangs sor bzhi tsam zlum por bskor ba/ dbus su gru gsum brnga rim sum brtsegs/ ngos re la khru gang sor nyi shu pa/ srab 'thug sor gnyis pa bya/ bang rim gnyis kyang zhing sor gnyis re byed/ 'brub khung gi nang yongs su mtho gang ngo / /yang mthun du bskos pa kho na byed na zlum pa'i kha mtshams nas sor gnyis mar gzhal ba na/ las kyi kha khyer zhing sor gnyis/de bzhin du kha khyer dang mchu yang mthur du je dma' je dma' 'khrus/ mchu'i nang 'brub khung dngos rgyar khru gang / dpangs su khru phyed yin/ gang ltar yang rung ste 'brub khung gi nang dug dang / khrag dang / ro sol sogs sbyor bas dmar nag tu byug /rim par dang po dmar po la pad+ma/ bar ba dkar po la 'khor lo/'og ma sngo skya la gri gug /zla gam gsum pa la dmar po/ phyi skor zlum po la thod 'phreng dang / rdo ra me ri byed/ 'brub khung nang gi gzhi la 'khor sngon po rtsibs brgyad lte ba la/ huX ngam spi gug /rtsibs brgyad la mahā kā la gu ṭa hri da bkod/gri snying bca' thabs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rtsa lags g.yon du dgra ling gzhug /dbus mar lcags phur chung ngu mtshon gang ba gcig zhugs pa lhag po yin/ gri snying ma rnyed na nag po bzhi mtshon gyis bsad pa'i snying gis kyang rung / ro ras — 124—

la mgon po'i sku 'ol tsam bris pa cig gis snying ga de la dril nas thod par bcug /zla gam mdun ma la bzhag /dar nag gi mda' dar la phur bu btags pa g.yas su btsugs/ dgra bo'i dri ma byug pa'i gzhi las ling ga sngags kyi mtha' skor ba gcig bris la/ dgug gzhug drag tu byas la thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang du bcug 'brub khung du bzhag /de'i steng du dam rdzas bsres shing / dug khrag gis byug pa'i gtor ma mtho gang ba zhig lcags snod du bcug cing stegs bu la bzhag /yang na thod pa mi 'gyur bar byas te/ shing gi grab byas pa'i steng du gtor ma bzhag /liṅga la gtor ma ma reg tsam bzhag /'khrub khung gi khar dar nag ras nag sogs kyis bcad do/ /mtha' drag po'i mchod pas rgya cher bskor/ rtsa gtor rang gi sngas mgor bzhag /'dzin gtor dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jog /'phral gtor ci bde ba shin tu bzhag nas phul zin pa na spyi btab dang bcas te/ rang nyal sa'i steng thog tu 'bul ba yin/ nyams len cho ga'i rim pa ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ni bzlas pa'i skabs su/drag po sngags kyi 'od zer gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog ser/ dug nad me gsum dgra bo'i yul khams su 'debs pa dang / gtor ma'i skabs su/ dgra bgegs rnams gtor ma la thim pa yang yang bsgom/ than gzhug tu 'phral gtong / de ma thag bskul bya zhing dgra la rbad/ shā sa na drag tu bzla'o/ /de ltar byas pas bsnyen pa'i grangs nges can byung nas mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/gta' gtor yang 'bul/ 'grub na las thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang gtang rag tu 'phul/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/—125—

gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ las bsnyen gyi 'phro de ka mthud na bzang zhing / bar du mtshams cod kyang mi 'gal mod/ yun ring du 'gyangs nas mi rung ngo / /de nas ling ga bca' ba ni/ dgra bo'i sha nye rus nye'i rus pa sogs rnyed na bzang ste/ mir rnyed pa shas tshe/ tsher ma'i shing la rus shing bya/ ro ras sam/ gri khrag gam/ sha chen gyi khu ba'am/ tshil chen byug pa'i shog bu la sngags 'bri dug sna bsres pa'i snag tshas/ oṃ badz+ra krodha mahā kā la/ che ge mo go ro tsa na ku ma ri tu na dza dza/ zhes bris pa mgo bo'i thad dkar bsdams/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la che ge mo dza ha kro dhi/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mgrin pa'i thad kar bsdams/ khrag sna bsres pa'i snag tshas tsit+ta krodhaX sogs 'don pa spos la snying ga'i thad kar bsdams/ tsha sna bsres pas che ge mo rak+ta kro dhi/ zhes spos pa lte ba'i thad dkar bcings/ gu gul mi zhi/ thug po'i rmang bre rnams bsres pas che ge mo ma ra ya kro ti/ zhes pa 'dom gyi thad kar bcings/ zla'i ru shing yang bsdoms te/ rdzas sngags 'dom gyi de dang 'dra/ de rnams sbyar ba'am/ dkri ba'am/ sdom pa gang byas kyang 'dra/ de la tsha ba gsum dang / zag rdzas grog mkhar bdun rnams 'jims pa la bsres te ru shing la g.yogs/ gzugs brnyan dod pa snying khar bris/ ling ga 'jug pa yod pa bya/ dug dang / ke tshe dang / lan tshwa dang / baX gyis snying khrag dang / srin lag gi khrag rnams bsres pa'i snag tshas bris ling spyi dang mthun pa zhig 'bri/ 'di 'khor lo mi byed pa'i lugs yin 'khor lo byed na rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud bcad/ rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad/ dgra bo 'di zhes pa bya ba 'di na yi ge na mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la che ge —126—

mo kha kha sogs/ mu khyud la sha sa na'i e daX ྅yan ma che ge mo ni mā ra ya phaṭa/dbus su ling ga sngags bcas/ sngags ni snying po gsum char gyis skor/ lce'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan pa cig bya/ ling ga mnan pa dang / spyi bo sogs la 'khor lo gal che/ mes gdung ba dang / thun gyis bsad pa sogs la ling ga rkyang gis cho ga gsung bar 'dug /de yang nyi lhag la g.yengs/ bgegs bskrad/ dgug gzhug /lhar dbye rnams byas/ brang thal gyi stabs tshams byas te ling ga che ge mo'i snying khar bcug /sgo yang bkag 'di dag snga ma snga ma skam gyin byas dgos te/ bsher tshab gyis la ba'am/ yi ge bsubs na nus pa mi ཿnga ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas ling ga la pra tshil byug /tsher ma la dug khrag byug pa/ shā sa nas bsngags pas mang po bcugs dpral ba/ snying ga/ lte ba/ yan lag bzhi rnams la mi rus kyi phur bu chung ngu de yang 'debs/ de la phyi rol tu bskyed chog dgug gzhug /lha dbye drag tu bya/ thod pa'i snod mi dgos/ 'brub khung gi nang sngar gyi bris ling gi steng du 'jog pa ste/ gnas bdun du phur bus ma btab na kha bub tu 'jog zer ba dang / rgyab nas phur bus 'debs zer ba sogs yod kyang /phur bu mdun nas 'debs shing / ling ga'ang gan rkyal du bzhag go /ro skras yan lag dang mgul ba bcings te/ de'i sne phur bas gtod phur byas te bzhag /de ma thag tu dgug gzhug drag po lan mang po dang / snying po'i mthar dgug gzhug gi sngags bcug pa mang du bzlas te/ ro g.yam mam ro gos nag po sogs kyis kha bcad do/ /de'i steng gi nam mkha' la bris sku'am/ gtor ma —127—

bzhugs su gsol/ kha khyer la rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bkod/ mtshan ngan gnyis su skam thun rlon thun bshams/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin mngon rtogs kyi gzhung bsrangs/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bsnyen sngags gnyis la che ge mo mā ra ya spel ba dang / de labs da sngags kyang btags te bzla/ de rjes shā sa na drag tu bzla/ thun gnyis la'ang / de lta bu'i sngags drug cu'am brgya nyi shu bzla/ de nas 'brub khung kha phye la/ dgug gzhug dang lha dbye drag tu bya/ nyin mo skam thun dang / mtshan mo rlon thun nas ling ga la btegs cing / yi dam gyi sngags kyis mgo drangs te bsad sngags dang shā sa na la nan tan bskyed/ thun sngags gzhan btags kyang chog /mi bsad pa'i gri lcags la bcos pa'i phyag mtshan gyis pra tshil la ri mo dod tsam 'debs/ bsad bcad kyi dmigs pa drag po byas te/yang 'khrub khung kha bcad de mnan par bsams/ dmigs pa la mgon po 'khrub khung gi dbus su bzhugs kha khyer la mkha' 'gro srin po dpag tu med pa gnas pas dgra bgegs 'gugs 'dren bsad las byed pa'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa gzhan rnams las bsnyen gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ba gnad yin/ dgra dang dgra'i bla bsad pa dang / nags la me btang ba dang / mkhar bskyel ba sogs bsgrubs pa'i rtag myur du 'ong /gsum pa la las la sbyor ba ni/ zhag shas shig dang 'dra ba las/ thun re bzhin ling ga gsar pa de bsgral gyin zhal du btab/ de nas rtsa ba'i ling ga yang bsgral/ 'brub khung de nyid du bud shing brtsigs te sbyin sreg gi cho gas phul/ de'i thal ba cha gsum du byas/ cha gcig drag sngags bzla bzhin du rlud —128—

so langs pa'i dus su rlung la phyar/ cha gcig chu 'khor ram mtsho gnyan po la blugs/ cha gcig sa dang bsres ling ga byas snying gar 'khor lo bcugadagug gzhug drag po byas mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan/ 'di la 'byung ba bzhi'i las tshang ste lugs gcig yin/ yang na spyin sreg mi byed par mnan pa byed na sngar gyi ling ga de thod ngan kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug /chu mi 'chor bar bya ste sa bdag glu gnyan gyi gnas sam/ 'dre drag po gnas su mnan cing gtad do/ /de nas kyang bskul ba ni skabs der yang gong du gtad pa bzhin du zor 'phen/ las dngos ma grub kyi bar du yang yang bskul bzhin zor 'phen par bya'o/ /yang na sngar ling ga 'khor lo yod med gnyis byas/ 'khor lo yod pa mnan/ med pa bsregs/ zor 'phen pa rnams byas pas/ mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gar tshang ba yin/ rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba drug /tha mas kyang zla ba dgu la 'chug pa med gsung / mgon po nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rkang ni de dag yin no/ /gzhan yang spogs chog ni che ba gsum/ tshwa sna tshogs/ me tog dri mi zhim pa/ khrag rnams bsres pa'i sna tshas mgon po'i sngags dang sku 'ol spyi tsam bris/dur khrod sol ba/ gri khrag /sha chen tshil chen cung zad bsres pa'i bag zan nam/ 'bru nag rjen btags la sku 'ol spyi tsam byas/ bris sku dang / yi dam gyi mgo mnan pa'i sngags kyi shog ril gnyis khung du bcug /'brub khung du bcugagu gul bdug /nang gzhug bcug pa'i bu khar rdo rje gtad de/ bsnyen sngags mgo zhabs slog pas gzir/ des kyang bsad rtags ma byung na/ bsad sngags —129—

mgo zhabs bzlog pas gzir/ bsang rtags byung na bu khar spos blug /spra tshul gyi kha bcad/ khrus gsol/ mchod gtor bskang bshags rgyas pa gal che'o/ /'di go bab tsam yin lag len du mi 'debs/ sbar bu'i las tshogs ni thod pa la gong du 4gad pa'i 'khor lo bri/ lte bar ling gzugs mi dgos/ 'khor lo bsdus pa la dbus su ming rus rtsibs la bsad pa/ mu khyud la bsnyen sngags sham bu can zer ba yod/ de'i nang du tsha ba gsum/ dug sna/ tshwa sna/ tshogs tshad/dgra du yod kyi ming rus can ling ga sngags can bri bcug /thod pa kha sbyor yod na bzang / de 'brub khung du bcug la mgon po 'khor bcas thod pa'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ cho ga sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i sngon du dgug gzhug bya/ thod pa'i steng du mgon po bzhugs par bsam/ sngags kyi bsham du dgra bo che ge mo nor dang bcas pa u tsi ṭa ya shi ra staX bha ya nan/ zhes bzla zhing / nyin mo yang nyung thun dang / mtshan mo dug thun 'debs/ ltas byung na khang sel du byed na khang pa'i rmang ngam grib ma phog sar mnan/ rigs rgyud brlag par byed na so tog sol ba bla ma rnams la sngags khri bzlas/ de dang thal bas thod pa kha sbyor gyi bar mtshams bkang ste/ dur khrod chen po'am/ gzhi bdag gnyan po gnas sar gtad par bya'o/ /gal te thod pa bam ril la sgrub pa yin na thod pa'i nang du rdzas dang 'khor lo ling ga rnams bcug la/ sngar bzhin bsgrubs nas thod pa'i gdong dgra phyogs la bstan te sba'o/ /gzhan yang me la du ba dang / mdzes 'dzin pa dang / ser ba dbab pa/ gdon gyi las te/ de rnams kyi/ rnam bzhag gzhung nas gsal lo/ /zhes pa rje btsun rwa lo'i man —130—

ngag /mgon po mahā kā la'i sgrub thabs 'di yang yi ge rnying pa'i gsal byed du gab 'khrug med cing go bde ba rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bkod pa'o// //maṅga laX// gcig zhus// shubhaX// dge'o//'di bris dge bas skye ba kun tu nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad mngon spyod drag pos bsgral nus par gyur cig /bya ba gang brtsam chos dang mthun nas kyang / /sdig las gang gis nyams pa med bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dri ma med pa'i legs lam la/ /skye 'dir dge rtsa 'bad tshad der 'gyur shog/ //

byung tshul mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs/oX swā sti/ rgyal mchog thugs rje'i 'od dkar phreng ba rgyas/ /skal ldan blo yi ku mud kha phye las/ /legs bshad ge sar rgod pa'i rdul 'phreng dag /blo ldan gtsug gi nor bus ngal gso byos/ /'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byung tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ ye shes kyi mgon po nyid kyis khyad par gyis thugs bskyed tshul/ sgrub thabs kyi chos skor 'phags yul du byung tshul/ de las brgyud de kha ba can gyi ljongs su dar tshul/ da lta grags che ba'i chos skor rnams ji tsam yod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon thus sa rje chen po 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyis dang po thugs bskyed pa nas bzung / bskal ba grangs med mang por tshogs bsags/ sa bcu pa khyad par can brnyes/ 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob/ rgyal sras thu bo rnams kyi gral du tshud pa'i skabs shig thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' 'di lta bu mdzad de/ phyogs bcur rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'khor ba'i gnas 'di dag gi sems can gyi don bya ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bdag gis sgrol ba las/'khor ba'i gnas 'dir sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma 'khod kyi bar du bdag sangs rgyas thob par mi bya/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa sangs rgyas la bkod zin pa na/ de'i rjes su bdag nyid —132—

— sangs rgyas thob lags kyi/ gzhan du na bdag 'khor ba nyid du gnas te sems can gyi don bya'o/ /gal te bdag dam bca' 'di las 'da' bar gyur na lus tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig /ces dbu snyung mdzad do/ /de nas brtsams te ri bo po ṭa lar bzhugs nas sprul pa mtha' yas pas skad cig re re la yang sems can dpag tu med pa cig car smin grol du mdzad na gzhan lta ci smos/ tshul de lta bu'i lo grangs kyi tshad bzung bar ga la nus/bskel ba rang yang ji snyed cig song ba na/ dus lan gcig da ni sems can mang po grol byung bas 'khor ba'i gnas stongs las che dgongs te mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med pas nyung bar ma zad/ yul nye ba na gnas pa'i sems can rnams snyigs ma lnga bdo bas 'dul dka' ba rnams gzigs te/ da ni bdag gis sems can gcig gi don yang byar mi nus zhes sngar gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' de btang ba'i tshul mdzad pas sku lus tshal ba stong du gas skad/ 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po de nyid dang po thugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste rtag tu rjes su bzung ba'i dge ba'i bzhas gnyen ni bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med yin pas/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mngon sum du byon nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi de lta bu'i sems bskyed btang ba de ma legs/ da ni dam bca' btang ba de slar gso ba sogs kyi don du sngar gyi sems bskyed pa de bas rgya che ba'i sems bskyed zhig ri shig ces gsungs shing sku lus tshal pa stong du gas pa de dbu bcu gcig dang phyag stong phrag tu byin gyis brlabs so/ /der dgongs pa la sngar gyi de bas —133—

rgya che ba'i sems bskyed ni nam yang med/ de'i cha shas kyang sgrub par mi nus zhes zhag bdun ci bya rtol med pa las/ de'i tshe da ni snyigs ma lnga bod pa'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams drag pos 'dul ba dang / chos byed rnams kyang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar par gzigs nas bar do las skyob pa dang /snyigs dus skye bo rnams dbul phongs kho na sdug bsngal che bas/ de'i gnyen por bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ste/ 'phrin las rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas thugs bskyed snga ma las lhag pa'i tshul du dgongs te/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas hūX mthing nag gcig byung ste/ de nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon por gyur pa na zhing khams thams cad du sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas mgrin gcig tu rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di lta bu'i sems bskyed pa de legs so/ /myur mdzad mgon po 'di la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di nyid kyis dbang dang ldan par bya'o/ khro bo gshin rje gshed po 'di nyid kyis mthu dang ldan par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang/ gzhin rje dang / bdud dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis sprul pa'i khro bo chen por dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas brtsams te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad du bstan pa bsrung zhing bzhugs pa lags/ gnyis pa ni/—134—

sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du gshegs pa na/ gar mkhan zhig dad pa skyes te glu dang rol mo'i mchod pa rgya cher phul nas smon lam btab/ de nas phyis sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya nye bar lon pa ni mi'i skye ba brnyes shing grub pa thob pa'i ri khrod mgon po shā ba ri pa zhes bya bar gyur/ de lan gcig dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na spros pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i skabs nangs zhig tho rangs nam mkhar ḍā ma dra'i sgra khrol byung ba la gshegs pas ye shes kyi mgon po 'di mngon sum du byon 'dug te/ mgon pos nyid kyi srog sngags dang sgrub thabs thams cad grub thob shā ba ri pa la gnang ngo / /dpal ldan shā ba ri pa de rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ dpal mgon po nyid de/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi 'bral med bya ba yin te/ shā ba ri pa la lha gzhan de rnams kyis kyang rang rang so so'i sgrub thabs gsungs so/ /dus skabs de nas lo stong phrag tsam lon pa'i dus phyis/ mnga' bdag mai tri ba zhes bya ba mtshan dngos mai tri gu bhe bod skad du byams pa sbas pa/ gsang mtshan gnyis med rdo rje ces bya ba de bi kra ma shi lar bzhugs dus bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ nus mthu khyad par can brnyes kyang gnas lugs kyi don ma rtogs nas lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btang pas/ lho phyogs dpal gyi rir songs shig ri khrod mgon pos rjes su 'dzin —135—

par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan thob/ de nas dpal rir byon/ grub thob shā ba ru pa las zab mo'i don gyi phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa mtha' dag gsan/gnas lugs gzigs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'gyur/ zab don gyi gdams pa spel ba'i bka'i gnang ba thob/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs brtsams/ zhag nyer gcig bsgrubs pas chos skyong bran du 'khol bar gyur te/ dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol nas brtan g.yo'i dngos po chen po blang te 'bul ba sogs bzhed don mtha' dag sgrub pa zhig go /yang gtam rgyud kyi rnam grangs gzhan ni/ sngon dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pa de ri po ṭa lar lan gsum byon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su mjal/ snga phyi pho brang gzhal med khang gzhan thams cad la mjal zhing bskor/ rten kun la yang phyag mchod bsgrubs pa las/mtha' gcig na khang bzang shin tu che ba nam yang sgo mi 'byed pa zhig 'dug te/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'di'i sgo 'byed par zhu zhus pas/ 'di'i sgo phye na 'jig rten gsum po thams cad sngangs shing 'chi pa'am 'chi la thug par 'gyur gsungs pas/ yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid la zhus shing gsol ba btab pas sprul pa'i pho nya zhig mngags te/ 'phags pa'i bkas gnang ba'i stobs kyis sems can su la gnod pa med pa'i ngang nas sgo phyes/ der ye shes kyi mgon po 'di dang mjal/ gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba la 'byor bar zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas bzung dur —136—

khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal shing n+ya gro dha'i phug na sprul pa'i sku zhig rtag tu bzhugs pa yin/ sa ra ha dang shā ba ri bas sgrub thabs kyang mdzad ces grags te/ 'di lo ts+tsha ba 'gar chos bzang gi lugs kyi gsung sgros las byung / po ṭa la'i lam yig tu grags pa'i rgyud las kyang po ṭa lar mgon po 'di bzhugs par bshad pa dang mthun no/ /yang 'ga' zhig 'di lta ste/ mgon po 'di dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten na bzhugs pa slob dpon klu sgrub dang / bram ze mchog sred kyis spyan drangs zhes kyang bzhed de/ de thams cad yul dus gnas skabs so so yin pa'i phyir thams cad don la gnas shing bden pa kho na'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spyir mgon po 'di'i chos skor bod du bsgyur ba'i lo smo ba mang du byung ste/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis paṇ+ḍi ta mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol po la gsan nas shā ba ri pa'i gzhung chung bsgyur/ lugs 'di mgon rkyang kho nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi chos skor yin par grags so/ /mnyam sring lo tsā ba gang drang tshul khrims 'byung gnas zhes bya bas paṇ+ḍi ta shan ta a ka ra la brten nas bsgyur zhes grags shing / 'di'i sgrub thabs bod kyi yig rnying ci rigs par mthong te/ mkha' 'gro drug skor du grags pa de yin par 'dug /yang lo ts+tsha ba 'gar chos bzang gis paṇ+ḍi ta a ta ya badz+ra la gsan te sa ra ha dang / shā ba ri'i sgrub thabs bsgyur/ 'gyur 'di la 'byud yum yod med gnyis yod na'ang snyen ra mkha' 'gro bzhi skor kho na yin/ khyung po'i gdams ngag dang mthun shas che ba zhig yod/ kha cig a ta ya zhes pa yi ge nor ba yin/ a ta ya badz+ra zhes —137—

pas gnyis med rdo rje me tri ba dang gcig zer ba ni blos btags pa tsam ste a ta ya zhes kun tu sbyin pa'am mchog tu byams pa'i don yin no/ /yi ge ta dang da nor so tsam byung srid kyang yul skad gyi khyad par dag las 'gal ba yang med cing / spyir yang yig nor dang bsdu yig la dgag sgrub dgos na ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /mi mnyam rdo rje dang a ta ya badz+ra 'di gnyis kar mkhas grub khyung po'i yang bla ma yin no/ /de ltar yang lugs de dag la ni bsnyen bsgrub las gsum cha tshang tsam mdor bsdus te ma gtogs chos skor rgyas pa med/ deng sang chos rgyun yang mi bzhugs so/ /des na mgon po 'di'i chos skor rgyas shing zab pa bcos bslad dang bral ba byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'gran zla med cing sa steng thams cad khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa ni mkhas grub byung po'i rnal 'byor ba 'di'i man ngag kho na yin no/ /de yang mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa de gdung rus khyung po 'khrung yul snye mo ra mang / dang po bon la mkhas par mdzad de tshogs pa bdun brgya tsam 'dus/ de nas rdzogs chen la zhugs te slob ma sum brgya tsam 'dus/ de nas skor de mtshams nas bla ma mang du bsten te/ kye rdor dang gzhan rje gshed dang phyag chen gyi skor mtha' dag gsan/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis tsam bzhes pa la bal yul du phebs te/ de nas kyang mi lo lnga bcu'i skor rgya bal bod gsum du 'byon bzhud mdzad/ bla ma rgya gar ba mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ mdo sngags sgra tshad gzhung man ngag thams cad thugs su chud par mdzad/ thun mong gi bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po bsod —138—

nams 'byung gnas/ mai tri ba/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ ra hu la pa de bzhi dang /thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu dang / su kha sirnyi ste drug po rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma mdzad/ de la rgya gar du lan bar ma phebs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis sogs mkhas grub dpag tu med pa'i thugs bcud longs/ slar bod du ldog tu nye ba'i skabs zhig mnga' bdag mai tri ba la chos rgyag gi lhag ma gser mang du yod pa rnams phul te/ bdag cag bod rnams longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub myur la ltag tshan che ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ mgon po'i 'di'i sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams gsungs te/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ 'di dang po rten pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/bsam pa tsam gyi bar chad thams cad sel ba/ dgra thams cad rdul du rlog par byed pa/ gsol ba btab nas ma bsgrubs par yang zhal ston pa/ bzlog pa dang nang rmes mi tshugs pa/ thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba/yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i chos skyong 'di sbyin pa bya zhes gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zab mo'i sgo phye nas chos skyong 'di'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang zhing mthar 'di skad ces/ spyir dam tshig ma nyams pa/ dgos su 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang thun mong ma yin pa'i spos sbyor sogs dam rdzas rnams tshang zhing ma 'chags pa/ bya nag dang khyi nag la rdos mi rdeg pa dang /yid ches par byed pa sogs mgon po'i dgos kyi dam tshig rnams la'ang gnas par gyis/ de ltar byas na ri la sdod pa sogs gnas skabs thams cad du 'tsho —139—

ba'i rtsol ba mi dgos/ rang la dgos tshad mgon po rang gi skyel/ zhag bcu gsum bsgrubs na khyod nyid 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la'ang zhal mngon sum du ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan mdzad de/ de nas bod du byon yang slad kyi rgya gar du phebs te bla ma rnams kyi sku drin dran pa'i tshogs 'khor zhu ba dang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal bzang pos mnyes par mdzad/ de skabs mnga' bdag mai tri ba ni mi bzhugs/ jo mo rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma gang ga dha ri'i drung du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bas kyang phyag chen dang / mgon po las dngos grub 'grub pa'i ltas khyad par can brnyes/ de rjes slar bod du phebs shing 'gro don kyang cher mdzad/ bar bar du sgom sgrub tshul yang mang du bstan/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' yin nges par dgongs nas dge bzhes po to ba dang /glang ri thang pa la'ang chos gsan/ 'phan yul jog pa'i ri la gcig ril mdzad/ dang po bla ma mai tri pas gsung dus 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba mi dgos mgon pos skyes gsung dgongs te/ 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba yem mdzad pas 'tsho ba chad/nub gcig mgon po'i rgyun gtor yang ma byung bas phug pa'i sgor thon te/ slo tra pā la sogs mgon po'i las mkhan rnams kyi ming nas bos te/ dang po bla ma mi tri bas de skad gsung ba yin te/ da 'di na nga la 'tsho ba nam yang med/ mgon po rang gi rgyun gtor yang chad nas med do/ /zhes gsungs skad chen po btang bas de'i nang bar rang 'bras khongs kyi tshong 'dus nas 'bul skyel ba shin tu tshab che ba byung ste/ mar/ nas dang / ja zas gos sogs shin tu mang po byung ste/de la brten nas slob ma mang du bsdus nas chos gsung / zla gcig tsam song —140—

nas tshogs mang ches te/ jog por ma shong nas lung pa'i mda' chad ka zhes bya bar dgon pa btab/ rim gyis tshogs pa stong tsam 'dus/ de nas lan gcig dgon pa'i nang gi spyil bu zhig tu bzhugs/ zla stod grol mtshams byed kyin chos bshad/ zla smad la mtshams mdzad cing yod pa las mtshams kyi dus zhig nam langs ma thag gzim khang gi sgo rdung ba zhig byung bas/ nye gnas kyis bltas dus a tsa ra zhig byon 'dug nas bla ma dang mjal bar zhu gsung ba na/de nas yar lon mar lon byas te/ mtshams la yod pas mi mjal zhus pas nga thag ring po nas 'ongs pa'i nad pa zhig yin pas cis kyang mjal ba zhu gsung /de nas nang du spyan drangs sman pa bos te blta ru bcug pas/ 'di khrag tu 'dug te gtar kha bya dgos zer ba la/ rnal 'byor pas gtar kha des mi yong gsung te rlung sbyor zhig mdzad pas/ khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'u ru 'u ru bzhunas te ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad nas nad khrag rnams phyir byung / der bser ma langs gsung gin 'dug pas 'bru mar gyi byugs pa 'bul bar brtsams pa na/rnal 'byor pas bsku mnye des mi yong gsung / yang rlung sbyor gzhan zhig mdzad pas/ de sngar bzhin nam mkha' la 'u ru 'u ru 'dug pa las ba sbu'i bu ga nas kun da zhag dang bcas pa snum tshil gyis byung / yang rlung sbyor gzhan zhig mdzad pas ba sbu'i bu gar sib sib thim pas sku bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur te/de ngo mtshar che bar mkhyen nas/ da nang gang nas phebs zhus pas/ nga rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas da nang nyi ma shar ma thag 'ongs pa yin te/ po ta ri rong dog pas 'dir slebs dus nyi ma ma shar bar 'dug gsung / mtshan gang yin dri bas ra —141—

hu la gup+ta badz+ra yin gsungs te gu na pā ka ra dang / rat+na a kā ra dang / yang a bhi dzu ta ka na re/ bod du song dang rnal 'byor pa zhig la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes gsung te 'ong bas khyod dang 'phrad pa yin/ ces sogs bla ma nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas par gsung / de nas mkhas grub khyung po nyid kyis bla ma ra hu la pa de la rgyud man ngag spyi la grags pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ khyad par na mgon po 'di'i chos skor shin tu rgyas pa/ gsan te/ sngar mnga' bdag mai tri ba la mi bzhugs pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa yang mang du byung / gnas der zla ba bdun bzhugs/ de nas klu shod dang / rong dang / 'dam la sogs par yang phebs/de rjes byang rgyab brgyud de gung thang dang / mang yul skyid grong gi bar du phebs pa la/ de'i bar du mkhas grub chen po skyel mar phebs/ gsung las/ rlung shing rta can dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rmi lam du zhal lha ba 'di dang / mgon po shing phung can gyi gdams pa ste/ gdams pa gsum po 'di ster ba'i yul chos kyi snod du gyur pa gzhan ye ma rnyed nas khyed la gtad pa yin gsung nas/ nam mkha' la 'phur te bzhud kyang zer gar gshegs cha med do/ /de ltar mkhas grub khyung po de ru mtshams dang / 'phan yul dang / dbu ru stod sogs yongs sdom la lo nyi shu lhag cig bzhugs/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyis yang yang bskul te g.yas ru shangs kyi phyogs su pheb nas lo sum cu'i bar 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa brgyad cig car ston pa dang / brag ri la thogs pa med par bzhud pa dang sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bkye nas gnod pa med par pha rol gyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang / bum pa'i nang du zhag bdun —142—

bzhugs pa dang / nam mkha' la bzhugs nas tshogs pa khri tshor brgya la byams chos sde lnga gsungs pa sogs rnam par thar pa blos dpog par mi nus so/ /lan gcig khams pa'i grwa ba 'khrug pas dam sel gyis sku grib phog ste bag tsam snyung ba la/ mgon po'i gtor chen gyis zhes lung bstan byung nas dpon slob bzhi bcu tham pas gtor chen bsgrubs te zhag bcu gsum nas nang rtags byung ste/ gtor ma gtong bar phebs pas gtor stegs kyi steng na mgon po bar chad kun sel nyid sku mdog dkar po zhig bzhugs pa dpon slob thams cad kyis gzigs/ de ma thag snyung ba yang dwangs/ sngon mi tri bas 'khor dang bcas pa la mgon po'i zhal ston par lung bstan pa de 'di yin par grags so/ /mkhas grub khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa des mgon po 'di'i gdams ngag gnang ba'i slob ma ni spyir ni shin tu mang bar yod snang te/ slob dpon chos kyi shes rab la gnad bya ba gcig nas phyis zhu ston hrul po bar du brgyud pa'i yig cha yang 'dug pas mtshon/ 'on kyang da lta'i bar du chos rgyun ma chad cing grags che ba ni gsum yin te mkhan chen la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang / mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i zhang sgom chos seng dang / sgyu lus rmi lam gyi mnga' bdag rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus so/ /de las mkhan chen la stod pa ni/ mtshan nyid slob dus 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi slob ma yin pas nyang stod gnas rnying gi gdan sar spyan 'dren nan can mang po byung ba na/ nga mi chos thag ring bas mtshan nyid pa'i sde chen po 'di 'dzin skyong dka'/ 'on kyang bla ma la zhu dgongs te/ khyung po'i rnal 'byor —143—

pa la zhus pas/ khyed rang nyam nga mi dgos pa cig ngas byin gyis brlabs pas dgos don thams cad mgon po 'dis sgrub par 'dug /bla ma'i gdan sa zungs shig gsung / der khong gi zhong nas nyung la phebs pa'i lam shang mdar slebs pa na bla ma'i thugs dam mgon po'i bris sku zhig kyang phyi bzhin 'brang kyin byon/ de la 'phur thang du grags/ bla mas bkas ma gnang bar 'khur du mi rung snyam nas slar yang zhor du log te bla ma la zhus pas de spyan drongs la song /khyod slob dpon shes rab 'bar bas kyang bsod nams che bar 'ongs gsungs te phyis de kha bzhin du byung / mthu stobs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga'/'dis la stod cong chos lding sogs dang / nyer gnyis su dgon gnas mang du btab/ 'di nas brgyud pa mgon po rnying pa'i lugs la mgon po stod lugs par grags so/ /rtogs ldan zhing sgom chos seng ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa yun ring du bsten/ gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag ches zab pa mang po thos/ bla ma'i gsung gis bskul bas gnam mtsho'i ngo la lo bdun/byang ngur dang thang lha'i mgul sbrags pa la lo lnga bzhugs/ de dus gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du rtogs/ rlung sems dbu mar chud/ yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mi lab pa bzhin du gyur/mgon po'i ched du ma bsgrubs par yang 'grub/ gsang spyod rig rba 'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad skabs su mthun rkyen thams cad mgon pos bsgrubs/phyis gnam rtse lding du lo mang du bzhugs te/ gnas de nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /rmog cog pa chen po ni/ khong gi rnam thar nyid na gsal ba ltar —144—

mtha' yas pa'i mdzad pa can yin la/ dam pa 'dis rmog cog gi brag la lo bcu gnyis su mi zas spyan gyis ma gzigs par dka' spyad kyi sgo nas sgrub pa mdzad de/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po gshegs pa yin pa las/ sgrub pa lo bdun brgyad song ba'i skabs lha bzhi dril bsgrub la thugs snang 'gro ba zhig byung nas thun gyi nyin mtshan ma chags par mdzad pas nub gcig brag (yogs la mgon po 'khor bcas mngon sum du byon/ me dpung drag tu 'bar zhing ḍā ma ru khrol khrol 'dug /de gzigs pas thugs nyams 'ur te trag bstod dbyangs su gyer gyin bskor ba mdzad pas mgon po yang shin tu dgyes so/ /de phyin chad chos skyong bran du 'khol zhing / mi dang mi lab pa bzhin du bzhugs/ 'on kyang snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gzigs shing 'gro drug sems can la byams snying rje phyogs med du shar bas drag po mngon spyod kyi las nam yang ma dgongs te/ dam pa 'di'i 'phrin las rgyas pa'i skabs shig 'bul rkyen tshan che ba zhig nye 'khor lha phu yul ba 'gas bcom/ der grwa ba 'gas ser dmag bshom/ mgon g.yag gcig yod pa mi ngan de rnams kyi grong ltag du song nas rwa bdar rmig pa rdeb ngar skad 'byin pa na me bkra lhab lhab byung /der dam pa 'di'i zhal nas/ lam sna bla ma rje la zhus pas lam rgyus mkhas pa'i tshad cig byung / zhes sogs mgur pa zhes te/ nga las su chos byed pa la sdig g.yos kyi dmag mi byed/ bsam ngan gyi mthu yang mi gtong gsung nas/bem bum zhig dang / gsol chas bags khug sku rgyab tu bsnams te dgon gnas bskyur/ ri la bros nas byon pas/ grwa ba rnams kyi ser dmag kyang —145—
