bshol/ dgon g.yag de yang ldog byung skad/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhal bstan nas/ zhe sdang me dpung chen po de/ /byams pa'i myong kyi legs par zhi/ 'an tu legs so rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes ched du brjod pa gsung te/ dpe 'dis mtshon no/ /dam pa 'di'i drung du skyer sgang pa chen pos spyir gdams ngag mtha' dag dang / khyad par mgon po'i chos skor gsan cing / bla mas kyang mgon po bran du 'khol bar lung bstan/ skyer sgang gi gdan sa mdzad nas 'gro don yang 'phel bar mdzad pa'i skabs shig rtogs ldan zhing sgom chos seng mjal bar phebs/mkha' 'gro rnam gsum dang / a ta ya badz+ra/ mi tri ba sogs nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa zab mo mang po dang / mgon po'i skor sngar rje rmog cog pa la ma gsan pa rnams gsan/ des na skyes sgang pa la khyung po'i thugs sras phyi ma gnyis car gyi gdams ngag rnams gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ dam pa 'di yang byang chub kyi sems kyi mnga' bdag yin pas rbad bskul mdzad pa sogs ye med kyang dgon pa la lcags ri brtsegs pa yul bas bkag /de nub rang du yul ba rnams nang 'khrugs shor/ mgo bsdu byed mkhan de gnyis 'thab gral du shi ba sogs phyi rtags mang po byung ba zhig yin par snang / de'i thugs sras gnyan ston chen po ri gong ba yin te/ skye sgar du bzhugs pa'i skabs tho rengs kha zhig bla ma'i drung du shog gsungs pa la byon pas/ skyer sgang pa gzim khang bskor ba mdzad kyin 'dug /ya ga'i ri ngogs de la ltos dang gsung /gzigs pas dgon pa'i ltag gi ri logs la mgon po 'di rngam zhing gzi brjid che bar bzhugs pa la/ gnod sbyin spyo tra pā las mi snying dmar tsa re ba —146—

gnyis 'bul gyin 'dug nas/ 'di ltar gda' zhus pas de tsug yin/ mdang chu skor la ngan byed mkhan zhig byung yod par 'dug te snying ni de'i yin par 'dug gsungs/ nam langs 'phral ltar phyin pas cu skor sgyel 'dug /mi de gnyis kyang 'phra' du shi/ de ltar ma sgrub par zhal gzigs pa yin/ phyis yol du bzhugs pa'i dus su nam mkha' nas 'byung ba 'khrugs pas/ thog mda' bcu tsam sku bangs su rgyab pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang nas sku lus me dpung chen po'i dbus su bzhugs/ thog kho rang yang ma nyams/ skru nyag gcig kyang ma tshig pa la thog sde rnams thu bar bsnams te brag yang la byon/ dus der mgon po 'di yang rogs la slebs 'dug ste/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shar ba'i stobs kyis bya ba gang yang 'chol mi dgos/ nga la ni dgra dang gnyen la khyad par med/chos skyong khyed rnams kyis gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /dgos su mi ma bsad cig /ces gtan du ngar chags pa yin/ de yang ji snyed cig 'ong bar 'dug gsung / 'on kyang bza' mang tshan nyung tshan gyis chu skor gyi tsam pa skyel ba dang / 'tshe bar shom pa'i grwa ba rnams la mi 'tshams pa chen po byung ba dang / chu thags kyi ste sa rku mkhan de ma thag tu ltag pa chag ste shi ba dang / lug rdzas skur ba btab pas khrag bskyugs te shi ba sogs bka' shin tu gnyan pa'i rnam grangs la zad pa med/ skabs shig dpal lha mo re ma ti'i zhal na te/ mgon po'i sku zhig bzhengs shig dang sems can gyi don chen po 'ong gsung la/ nga bya btang zhig gis de 'dra ba bzhengs mi thub las che gsungs pas/ lha mo'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis 'jim pa dam spo tsam zhig mi 'byor par 'dug gam gsung / 'o —147—

na ngas sku bzhengs kyi/ khyed rnams kyis mi ma bsad cig gsungs/ de nas zhag shas song bas lan gcig nye skor gyi grogs po zhig nas 'jim pa'i sa blang te phebs tsa na/ sgo drung na a tsa ra bzo chas khyer ba zhig 'dug /de la gtam byas pas 'jim bzo legs po shes zer bas rten 'brel 'grigs ya mtshan che dgongs te/ nang du spyan drangs/ zhag gnyis gsum rgyu tshogs rnams bsags/tshon rtsi tshun chad 'dzom pa byung nas bzhengs par brtsam pa las nub mo gra bshom byas nas bzhag pas nam langs ma thag sku yongs rdzogs tshon rtsi dang bcas par grub 'dug /de na re da rab gnas kyi grab ran gsung ba la mgon po'i sprul pa yin par mkhyen nas/ rab gnas khyed rang gis mdzod gsung bas a tsar yang sku 'dra la thim/ de ltar na rang byung mgon por grags shing shin tu byin rlabs che ba da lta'i bar du yang bka' gnyan cing rtags mngon gyur du bzhugs/ mgon po byin rlabs che ba gzhan kun lkog tu yin pa'i tshul du bzhugs kyang / 'di ni mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa yin gsungs nas da lta'i bar du skye bo thams cad kyis phyag mchod kyi yul du bzhugs so /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa ni 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa yin/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams dang mtshungs par shes bya thams cad la ni mkhyen pa rgyas/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i phul du gyur/ 'jig rten chos brgyad las ni thugs log 'khor 'das — 148—

thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa ni 'gyur ba med/ byams snying rje ni mkha' ltar khyab/ yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa ni zhal gzigs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad ni bran bzhin 'khol/ gzhan phan 'gro don rang shar lhun gyis grub pa nyid do/ /de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de la ni tshogs pa khri tsho mang po 'dus pas/ nub phyogs dza lan+ta ra dang / u rgyan tshun chad nas shar phyogs rgya nag gi bar du bu slob kyis khyab par mdzad kyang / thugs sras kyis gtso bo gdan sa slob dpon a'i seṅge dang / phyogs mthar 'phrin las skyong ba 'jag bsam gyis rkang bzung ba'i sgrub brgyud dpal ldan shangs pa'i srol ka 'dzin pa rnams kyis mgon po 'di'i chos skor rnams ma nor bar thugs nyams su bzhes pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu'i gdams pa 'chad pa dang nyan pa dang nyams su len mkhan rnams la ma sgrub kyang mgon po 'di rang shugs kyis 'go ba yin/ de ltar gnyan ston nas brgyud pa la mgon po re gong ba'i lugs sam/ smad lugs pa zer te/ ri gong gdan sa las brgyud pa 'di phag mo grub pa sogs dbus su dar rgyas chen po byung 'dug /'jag pa la stod rgyud smad rgyud bar rgyud gsum/bsam ldeng ba'i lugs la lho gtsang rgyud pa gnyis sogs byung / mgon po stod lugs pa'i srol 'dzine rnams la mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum kho na gtso byed cing mthu bo che mang du byung yang byung la mthu chen du rlom pa'i rngams 'jigs byed pa mang du byung zhing / sngon dus lugs 'di dar rgyas che/ deng sang chos rgyun ma chad tsam las med do/ /smad lugs pa shangs pa bka' rgyud pa'i skyes chen —149—

rnams ni chos skyong tshul bzhin du bsten par mdzad/ nges don zab mo'i rgyud grol bas snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang / rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i yo lang tsam nyid brjod ngo tsam ma yin par thugs la rig pa'i phyir/ khug shog rgyob shogasod shog kyi bzlas brjod dang / gzhan la gnod sems kyis dus 'da' bar byed pa'i phyag srol ni med/ sems kyi mdud pa rang grol du shig ge ba'i ngang nas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'bad med du 'grub pa zhig yin par snang ngo / /mgon po ri gong ba'i lugs 'di phyis su shin tu dar rgyas che/ chos brgyud kyi sde gzhan du dar ba la rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po 'dis kyang / 'jag chen byams pa dpal la gsan/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge legs dpal bar 'jag pa'i slob brgyud mos nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa la zhus pa yin/ de dag la brten nas kyang mgon po 'di la mchod mkhan phyogs thams cad du khyab bo/ /ri gong gdan nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol las mkhas grub chos bzang nyi ma byon pa las 'phags chen bsod nams dar dang / 'phags pa rim pa sogs kyis zhus te/ 'phags sde bzhi dar ba sogs thor bu thor bur dar ba ni shin tu mang ste smos kyi mi lang ngo /bzhi pa ni/ mgon po'i 'di'i chos skor la rnam grangs mang yang / rtog mthu ru sgrub pa dang / zhi ba nor sgrub pa gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ mgon po'i sku mdog nag po gtso rkyang / lcam dral dang / lha gsum dang / dregs pa sde lngas bskor ba dang / rgyan can lha lnga dang /lha bcu gsum pa dang / sa ra he'i lugs dang / stod lugs pa'i mgon po lha —150—

dgu la sogs pa yod/ gzhan yang ljang gu drag sgrub/ ser po drag sgrub dang /lha mo sgos sgrub dang / 'khor gyi sgos sgrub dang / rten bzhi gnad gsum la sogs pa mchog sgrub pa dang / las tshogs shin tu mang bar snang ngo / khur dang ldan pa'i rtsod med sha stag yod/ stod lugs kyi mgon po phyag stong spyan stong gi skor mang po dang / dbu zhal nyer gcig pa dang / rgyud le'u brgya ma dang / le'u bcu gnyis ma dang / mdo chog la sogs rnams rgya gar nas bsgyur nges pa dka' yang byin rlabs kyi sgo nas chen po yod par snang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dang / mgon po gzigs ldan dang / mgon po mthing ga dang / mgon po ser po zhal brgyad pa dang /mgon ser nor sgrub dang mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po dang / mgon dmar tshe sgrub dang / mgon ljang tshe bdag sogs mang po yod pa yin no/ /gnyis ka la dgos pa'i man ngag ni/ gnad la dbab pa phyi nang dang / grib sel phyi nang / bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs sogs yin no/ /gzhan yang lha bzhi dril sgrub dang / mkha' spyod gsum sgrub sogs kyang ye shes mgon po 'di dang brel ba'i zab chos khyad par can yin te/ de ltar na 'dir zur tsam smos kyi rgyas par bla ma dam pas ston par 'gyur ro/ /'dir smras pa/ brjod bral ye shes mchog te snying rje che/ /rtag tu shar bas rang rtsal 'gag med las/ /dus gsum chad pa med pa'i 'phrin las can/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi dge legs stsol/ /ces pa phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po'i chos skor byung tshul mdo tsam 'di yang / sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' —151—

ming gzhan kun dga' snying pos bris pa'o// // dge legs 'phel// bkra shis// legs bzhengs de yi mthu las/ /bstan 'gror dge mtshan shar te/ /skal ngan rgud tshogs zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan chos spyod gyur cig/ //

tshigs bcad ma bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ oX su bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /pad nyi gaX las tshogs bdag dkar/ /glang gdong la phug ne'u le bsnams/ kha sbub dar dang nor bus brgyan/ /de steng huX las gri gug las/ /myur mdzad mgon po phyag drug pa/ /nag po sbyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /gri gug mgo 'phreng ḍa ru g.yas/ /thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa g.yon/ /mgo 'phreng si rgyu thig le dang / /stag lpags rgyan drug g.yer kha sbrul/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes mi bskyod brgyan/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can me dpung nang / /dur khrod dbus na shing drung bzhugs/ khrag mtsho sbyoXlas re ma ti/ /sngo nag ral gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /rab khros dre'u rta rkang gsum bcibs/ /k+ṣaX las slo ṭa pa la nag /gri thod 'dzin cing dom nag bzhon/ /hūX las dzi na mi tra sprug /srin po cang te'u thod khrag 'dzin/ /ṭaX las gshin rje 'dod rgyal nag /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /huX las traka da rta nag chibs/ /mdung dmar thod pa 'jol ber can/ /sag lham gyon zhing bdud dmag bcas/ /phyogs skyong lha klu gza' 'jigs byed/ /rgyu skar rgyal chen dam can bcas/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / g.yas na dpa' bo'i ngar bcas —153—

shing / g.yon na dpa' mo'i 'dzus dang bcas pa/ 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wa ra k+ṣi/ dad pa dang ni sogs/ dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma dbang rgyal nor bu dril bu bsnams/ /'od zer snol mas dbyer med byin gyis brlabs/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus la: dbon ston skye sgang pa chen po la: gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa: mkhas grub gtsang ma shing ston: sogs〈spar ma dang 'dra'o/ /〉grub chen lha dbang grags pa la:drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la: bla ma mgon po dbyer med la: mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma grub chen rdo rje thod pa bsnams/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas bkugs shing gnas gsum gyis/ /yig brgyas nyams sel bdag la byin gyis rlabs/ /yig brgya bzla/ na mo budha ya/ sogs/ mi/ kyai/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi:yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis: dpa' po dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sogs/ spar ma 'dra/ khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi bzad pa'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du myur ba nyid 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā ba ri/ /sogs/ rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig /bla ma dbang sdud ḍā dril rdo bskul//—154—

hiXlas yi ge'i lha mo bcu gsum bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ra kri sku hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun/ de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la gī spyo tra bisnan bi na ya ka huX huX phaṭa phaṭaXswāhā/ snying po/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sha sa na: sogs de na mi ke na mā ra ya huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ spyoXm mo nag mo oṃ slo tra pa la oṃ dzi na mi tra: oṃ ṭak+ki ra dza: oṃ du yag dza:gtor ma la/ a mri tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung dang / raX las me/ a las ka pā lar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu bdud rtsir gyur/ ye shes bdud rtsi bkug bstim rgya mtshor gyur/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag ngo bo blta'o/ /oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX.oṃ badz+ra mahā ka la k+ṇi slo tra bisna na bi na ya ka huX huX phaṭa phaṭa i daX ba ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma ha ka la k+ṣ-i slo tra bisni na bi na ya ka dra ka rag mo ba ling ta maX sa rak+ta ru ti ra kha kha 'a hi ji hi huX huX phaṭa/ lan bdun nam lnga/ oṃ āXhūX/ huX/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas/ ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /༈ gnod spyin chen po la gtor bsngo ni/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang la yaX las rlung / raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha hoXhriX oX snye tra pa la bighān huX phaṭa/ e dam ba li ta kha kha sku hi ji hi/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āXhūX/ gnod sbyin chen po slo tra pa la 'khor dang bcas pas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/—155—

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i bka' bsgos dam la bzhag pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ zhes pa'ang tā ra na thas brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du bris pa'o// // sarba maX ga laX// bkra shis// 'di bris dge bas bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

bsdus pa bzhu / gas/ oX swā sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma byin wos yi dam ltar byas la/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi la hūX las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing nag dang po gnyis gri thod/ bar ba gnyis mi mgo'i 'phreng ba dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis ḍa ma ru zhags pa bsnams pa/ stag lbags dang mgo 'phreng rus pa dang sbrul dang phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba'i brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pas tshogs kyi bdag po mnan pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/sin dhu ra'i thig le dpral bar byug pa/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du sgroXlas dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dre'u la bzhon pa khram shing dang nad rkyal thogs pa/ mdun du gnod spyin slo ṭa pa la smug nag gri thod 'dzin pa/ dom nag snyon pa la bzhon pa/ g.yas su dzi na mi tra dmar nag cang te'u dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu ṭak+ki ra dza nag po sbu gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon lha'i da rus mtshon dang thod snying 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang sag lham gsol —157rke

dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod wo po bsil ba'i tshal tsan na gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung na myur mdzad ye shes kyi dmagon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing / g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ o badz+ra mahā kā la sa pā ri wa ra k+ṣ-i nyer gcig /badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣ-i spu ṭa pa la bighān bi ya ka hūX hūX phaṭa/ ces mang du bzla/ sngags de ka'i mthar/ i dam ba li ta kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ lan gsum/ sbyoXm mo nag mo be ta li sirnyi ku lu ku ru huX phaṭa/ e dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ spu ṭa pa la bisnan huX phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ dzi na mi tra ba shing ku ru hūX phaṭa/ i dam sogs gsum/ oṃ ṭak+ki ra dza sa mā ya spyoXdu dza huX phaṭa/ i dam sogs gsum/ oṃ du yag dza mahā kwa la traka da huX phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya shā sa na sogs/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āXhūX/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ huX/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi na ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thams can/ /phyag drug sprul gyis rgyan gyi rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pas gri gug bar bas 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'brol/ /g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po zhal gdang mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum —158—

byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btang brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ khreng las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btabs/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i grib sel la sogs pa'i rjes su 'di rnams byas kyang rung / yig brgya bzod gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa khyer bde 'di ni gangs dkar rdo rje gdan gyi gnyer nyi ma rnam rgyal gyis bskur ngor/ tā ra nā thas pho brang gangs dkar du sbyar ba'o// //bya ba gang brtsam chos dang mthun nas kyang / /sdig las gang gis nyams pa med bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dri ma med pa'i legs lam la/ /skye 'dir dge rtsa 'bad tshad der 'gyur shog/ //—159—

zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bsang rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ mgon po spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūX/ shar lhor dur khrod chen po nas/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i zhing khams su/ /tsan+dan shing gi rtse mo na/ /byin rlabs mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhus/sa su gsol/ /e phya hi ar+ghaX swā hā/ ka ma la ya stum/ huX/ me tog bdug sbos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang / /nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /gsang ba'i mchod pa ma lus sogs/ /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa dang / /sna tshogs mchod pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rgyud par bcas/ /bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa la/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang / /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'di dang bar du skyabs mjodi cig /bde chen mthar lam ston mdzode cig /huX/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po la/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang / /bsang dang phud kyi —160—

mchod pa 'bul/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /gnod spyin slo tra pā la dang / gnod spyin dmag tshogs 'khore bcas la/ /mchod pa'i /bsang dang : /dbang dang je /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /dbang phyug dzi na mi tra dang / /dbang phyug dmag tshogs 'khore bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang dang : /dbang : /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /gshin rje rme / ra dza dang / /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang je /dbang : /ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /bdud mgon traklu da nag po dang / /bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang je /dbang ngu /ye shes mgon po bka' nyan pa'i/ /'jig rten dreg pa la sogs pa/ /mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang / /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /bstan pa srung ba'i las mdzod cig /dpal ldan lha mo la sogs pa'i/ /ma mo bye ba dung phyur la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang : /bstan pa /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang : /bstan /dbang phyug khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang ngu /bstan5 /pa sangs phur bu la sogs pa'i/ /gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang : /bstan: /smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i/ /rgyu skar lha mo nyer brgyad la/ /mchod pa'i /bsang : /bstan / gang ba bzang po nor bzang sogs/ /ded dpon chen po dgu po la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang : /bstan yul 'khor srung ba la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la/ /mchod pa'i / bsang : /—161—

bstan: /mdog nag 'jigs shing rngam pa'i tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang : /bstan: /yul dang gnas dang dur khrod dang / /gnas pa'i dpa' bo'i dpa' mo dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa'i: /bsang ngu /bstan /bsang dang phud kyi mchod pa yi sa/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'bor bcas rnams/ /gar 'gro gar 'dug gar gnas kyang / /chos dang mthun pa'i stong grogs mdzode/ /gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag dang / /dkar phyogs chos skyong thams cad la/ /bsang dang zhi ba dam pa 'bul/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khore bcas la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i bsang mchod bstan pa 'phel byed 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa dge/ //sarba maṅga laX//—162—

bren bris su bkod pa bzhugs/oX swā sti/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bka' nyan bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi srung ma dpag tu med pa zhig bzhugs pa/ bstan srung chos skyong thams cad kyi gtso bo phyogs bcu dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bka'i srung ma ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po lcam dral 'di dag yin la/de la ye shes kyi mgon po zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam sprul rnam pa yang 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa yin/ las kyi mgon po dngos ni ye shes kyi mgon po de'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub sla ba'i don du thugs las sprul pa'i mgon po chung ba rnams yin/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po ni dpal mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga lta bu'ang yin/ yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig tu las mkhan 'jig rten pa 'ga' zhig las mgon du mi btags pa ni che brjod tsam du zad/de dag las 'dir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po traka da zhes bya ba 'di gsang sngags rnying ma rnams ltar na 'phrin las kyi mgon po traka da ces 'byung ba ni las kyi mgon po yin zer ba'i don ma yin/ mgon po 'di nyid mgon chen ye shes kyi mgon po yin zhing / gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rkang tshugs yin kyang mngon sbyod gtso bor gyur pa'i phrin las ye shes mgon po gzhan rnams las kyang myur zhing stobs che ba nyid kyi phyir 'phrin las mgon po zhes bya/ yang gcig tu na ye —163—

shes kyi mgon po gzhan rnams kyi sgrub pa las sbyor gyis ma 'grub cing lus na/ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid bsten pa'am 'di'i rnam sprul mgon po chung ba mgon po mon par grags pa/ 'di la ra mda' spron pa'i tshul gyis las bcol byed dgos pa yang shin tu mang ste/ gur gyi mgon po la las mgon zangs gri can dang / phyag bzhi pa la las mgon bya rog gdong can yod pa yang 'di'i mgon po mon pa dang gcig la/ phyag drus pa la traka da kyi mtshan can rang yang dngos su yod/ dpal chen rga lo'i gsung gi mgon po bya rog mas las grub pa'i 'byams sdug byung na legs ldan bdud kyi rgyal po ra mdar spron dgos gsungs pa'i bdud kyi rgyal po yang mgon po traka da do/ /des mtshon de chos skyong gzhan thams cad la yang 'phrin las rang stobs kyis ma 'grub na mgon po 'di'i dmag dngu/nga phyu ra ba'i tshul gyis 'phrin las sgrub dgos pas 'phrin las mgon po zhes bya'o/ /chos skyong 'di dang por byung tshul ni/ bskal ba chags nas mi ring ba na'ang lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus kyi bskal ba la/ lha min rnams kyi khrag sa la 'thor ba lha min brgya stong du mar song ste/ lha min gyi dmag la zad pa med nas lha rnams pham pa las/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'di mahā de ba'i sras su sku sprul te/ lha min thams cad mdung rtse gsum pas bsnun te tshar bcad/ khrag rnams sa la ma 'bab par bar snang nyid la gsol bas lha min 'gribs te lha rgyal par gyur to/ /gzhan yang lha min dang srin po'i grong khyer sum brtsegs lan gsum du bcom pa sogs lha rnams rgyal bas 'jig rten bde bar mdzad do/ /yang phyi'i dus shig —164—

na sangs rgyas 'od srung la sogs pa snga ma'i bstan pa la/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dang 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs bka' bgros te sbyan ras gzigs dbang gi rtsa ba'i mgon po phyag gnyis pa la bka' bsgos/ sde brgyad dregs pa gzhan thams cad bka'i 'bangs su phab/ bran du dbang bskur ba las byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang / lho phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po brgyad/ dur khrod kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro brgyad rnams gzugs dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas bros shing ma thul ba las/ 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas raX yig spros nas/byang shar u tsa la'i dur khrod kyi byang phyogs dug gi nags tshal chen po/ nag po brtsegs pa dang / ha la ha la la sogs pa dug gi rgyal po bzhi'i me tog kha sbyor du 'das pa'i dbus su thim pa las/ zhag bdun nas mon pa dug gi skyes bu zhes bya ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan traka da bdud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba gyur te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis dregs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag skad cig nyid la zhags pas drangs te bkugs/ bsdigs pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis bsdigs nas phyag na rdo rje'i bka' lung bsgrags/gnod sbyin rnams mdun 'gros dang / gzhin rje rnams phyir 'brang dang / dur khrod ma mo rnams nus ma gsang ba'i yum du mdzad de bran du bkol bas/ chos skyong 'dis ma thul ba su yang med pa'o/ /zhes nag po gcer bu'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi las 'byung ngo / /ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis grong khyer ser skyar 'dus pa chen po zhes —165—

bya bar lha klu gnod sbyin lha ma yin sogs sde brgyad kho na la zhag bdun du chos bstan nas/ 'byung po thams cad 'dus pa'i skabs der 'khor tshogs gzhan thams cad 'dus zin pa'i rjes su nag po sde po che zhes mtshan gsol ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs chen po dang phyag bsdebs pa sogs kyis rnam 'gyur bstan pas 'khor tshogs rnams skrag te/ 'di nyid ci yin zhes zhus pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'di ni mthu bo che thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ zhes lung bstan zhing chos gsungs pas/ bden par gzigs pa 'dus pa chen po mdo nyid nas bshad/ phyis bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten du gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po mtha' dag sprul nas lha chen po thams cad la dbang bskur ba'i tshe dpal mgon po 'di nyid la gsang mtshan rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes bya bar btags shing / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos so/ /de nas phyis rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'khyams phyi ma klu sgrubs kyis bzhengs pa'i skabs su/ nag po chen po 'di'i lha khang chung ngu zhig mdzad/ rab gnas mdzad pa po yang bram ze mchog srid yin par grags/ mgon khang de seng ga gling pa'i dge slong rnams kyis bdag po byed pas chos skyong 'di la yang se d+ma'i gling pa'i mgon po rta bzhon mar grags/༈ bod yul 'dir bstan pa'i srol kha btod pa'i thog ma sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ra sa 'phrul snang nyid kyis yang srung mar bskos pa yin/ sku 'dra phyis bzhengs pa yin kyang 'phrul snang gi sgo khang na mgon po traka da —166—

kyis mgon khang chen po yod pa yang sngon srung mar bskos pa'i 'brel chags la brten nas bzhengs par 'dug /khyad par du yang bsgom gnas yer ba'i brag la mgon po 'di bzhugs pa chos rgyal nyid kyis gzigs pas de dang mthun par rgya nag gi ha shang mahā de bas yer bar mgon po'i mchod pa rtag tu mdzad cing yer ba'i brag lha mgon por mtshan gsol/ rgya nag gi yul du 'og tu shan zer ba'i gtsug lag khang mi ma yin dang mi rdzu 'phrul can gyis bzhengs par grags pa de'i gnas bdag kyang chos skyong 'di yin pas dpe rnying pa rnams na/rgya nag 'go hu de shan yul nas spyan 'dren no/ /zhes 'byung dus der li yul nas kyang mgon po 'di'i chos skor bod du byung bar grags/ de skabs skyid smad kyi brag ngo zhig la/ dpal mgon po traka da rkang thang ma'i sku brnyan gsal bar byon de'i thad kyi chu dang byang ngos kyi ri la me 'bar ba sogs cho 'phrul chen po byung bas de la chos rgyal nyid kyis zhal khebs kyi tshul du brag gcig 'gebs par mdzad skad/ de rjes chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi dus slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mgon po 'di'i sgrub thabs mang po gter du sbas shing dngos su yang gsungs/ sngags 'chang dharma gir tis kyang mang du bshad pa'i rgyun da lta ljang nag khros pa'i rgyud du grags pa tshogs bdag mgon po'i skor 'di rnams yin par snang / chos 'khor bsam yas kyi spyi'i bka' srung kyang dpal mgon bing ma la gtad ces grags pa'i bing ma ni gzungs kyi mgon por grags pa 'di yin zhing / phyag na mdung dang bing bsnams pa rta nag la chibs pa zhig yod/ bing ma gsung gi sgrub pa ru —167—

grags pa de ma yin/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs de lags/gsang sngags rnying ma la gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mgon po 'di'i rgyud mda' nag ral pa can gyis rgyud sogs gter nas spyan drangs ba rgyud chung bdun yod pa gnubs lugs yin/ slob dpon shin+taX gar+bhas gsungs pa rnams da lta dwags po lugs kyi chos skor kyi nang na yod pa mgon po zhal dmar du grags pa'ang 'di nyid yin no/ /bstan pa phyir dar la dang po nyid du lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos mgon po traka da spru gri me dpal gyi rgyud du grags pa rnams kha che'i dharma shrī la gsan zhing bsgyur/ de rjes jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas spyir mgon po'i chos skor rigs mi gcig pa mang du gsungs/ khyad par mgon po seng bzhon gyi skor yang mang du gsungs shing / phyag dar ba bstan pa rin chen la gnang bas 'grub par yang grags/ de la gra glu khu kha ches zhus/ bu do pa'i bstan srung mdzad/ de la bshes gnyen shar ba ra pas zhus/ bzhes gnyen 'chad kha bas 'di zhus te shar ba ra ba'i chos grwa'i srung ma mdzad cing / phyis 'chad kha rnying ba btags/ dbu ru stod phyogs kyi bka' gdams pa'i gnas gzhi thams cad mgon po 'dis skyong ba shin tu mang ngo / /༈ yang mgon po traka da dwags po lugs su grags pa ni/ slob dpon shan+ti gar+bha nas brgyud pa'i rnying ma yang rgya lcags zhing ba la bzhugs/ gsar ma jo bo rjes rong pa 'gar dge wal ba lcags ri ba de la rgya lcags zhing bas gsan no/ /de'i drung du rje dwags po'i mashaṃ nyid sgam po r+ṣa pos gsan/ dang po —168—

mgon po'i gdams ngag rnams ma zhus/ phyi sgom par bzhugs/ 'phrin las dar ba'i dus su dkyer stod smad kyi mi rtsub po mang pos sdig pa bsags pa'i tshe/ bla ma lcag zhing ba la thog mar zhu ru btang ba'i skor las dmar chung mar grags pa dang / phyis mgon po nyid kyis lung bstan te slar yang zhur btang ba la thang sham mar grags pa'i gdams pa'i skor rnams byung / phyis gdams ngag la 'dra min mang po byung nas sun phyung ba'i bar du dpe 'thebs gcig mdzad nas ka la dung mtshor gter du sbas/ de phyis skyes bu ye shes rdo rje'i skye ba dung mtshor ras pas gter nas byung ba'i dwags po'i lugs la yang bka' gter gnyis su grags/ yang shod bu lo tsā ba'i lugs la ye shes kyi mgon po traka da nyid phyag na gri khug thod pa 'dzin pa chibs med pa gtso bo ye shes mgon po'i tshul du mdzad/ rta nag la chibs pa las mkhan du sbyar ba'i lcam dral gnyis 'phrin las kyi mgon po dang gsum 'khor dur khrod ma mo bdun dang bcas pa gcig 'byung / de la shog bu'i mgon po grags yang slob dpon dha na saXskri tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs la gtso bo zhal gcig shā na'i zhal/ 'khor yang shā na mo bdun kho nas bskor ba gcig yod/ 'di ni bla ma skye lo tsā ba ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid chos skyong du mdzad pa'i skyo mgon du grags/ lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis kyang / dang po rgya gar la ma byon gong nyid nas mgon po 'di 'grub pas nus mthu che bar yod/ rgya gar la byon dus lam du gtsang po'i yul du jag pa tshan che ba gcig gis chom por yong ba la zhi ba'i ser sbyangs mang po mdzad cing / khyad par du nga rgya gar du chos slob tu 'gro zhing —169—

sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phyir yin byas kyang ma nyan pa la/ chos skyong dpang por bzhag /sde brgyad thams cad la dmod bcol drag po mdzad cing na bza' brdabs pas de ma thag ngag dpon rta khar las lhung zhing khrag skyugs te shi/gzhan thams cad bros so/ /phyis nag po gcer bu'i rgyud chung ba le'u bcu gsum ma yang 'gos kyis bsgyur bar bshad/ de rjes chos skor 'di la lho rgyud byang rgyud gnyis sogs sna tshogs su byung kyang 'phan yul nyan por byung ba'i grub thob 'tshod chen po nas chos skyong du mdzad pas 'tshod mgon du grags/ de la dri bo rgyal yon gyis zhus/de la mkhas pa dri mgon gyis zhus/ de la gong po pa dar shes kyis zhus nas da lta'i bar du ma chad tsam yod/ 'di mgon po gtso bo zhabs thang lcam dral las mkhan rta bzhon 'khor ma mo bdun shwa na bdun khyi zhal du med par shwa na rang gzugs su yang / yang mgon po traka da ma ning mar grags pa ni gsang sngags rnying ma'i dpal mgon ma ning dang phal cher mthun la 'di la brgyud pa'i rim pa gsum ste/ dang po slob dpon pad+mas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni nag po shan ti bha dra yang zer/ dam tshig rdo rje chung ba yang zer ba don la rje mar pa'i bla ma thar pa'i lam ston yang 'di ka yin/ 'gos lo dang nag tsho ba'i yang bla mar gyur pa mtshan bod skad zhi ba bzang po bla dwags la rgya gar nag po chen po zer ba 'dis bod du gnang ba yin zhing mgul lugs lcags can du grags/gsum pa ni/ bla ma rgya gar nag chung du grags pa dam pa sangs rgyas kyis 'di'i sgrub thabs gsungs nas zhu lo tsā ba la bshad pas zhu'i mgon por yang —170—

grags zer dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gsungs nas kyang mgon po'i 'di'i tshod byas na sgrub thabs gzhan 'di rnams mgon 'dra tsam yin gsungs skad/ de dag mtshon pa ste lugs mi gcig pa mang du byung / de thams cad kyi nang nas chos skor rgyas shing bka' babs kyi byin rlabs dang 'phrin las dpag tu med pa ni dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gnyos lugs 'di yin/ de la gnyos pa rnams dang po gsang sngags rnying ma sgyu 'phrul gtso bor mdzad cing / chos skyong lha mo srog sgrub lcags phur can la byed pa yin/ gnyos lo tsā ba'i yab dang khu bo gnyos mthu rgyal dang gnyos spang la me shor gyi dus la sngar gyi rnying ma'i steng du gsar ma'i yo ga la mkhas par byung / mthu rgyal gyi sras gnyon lo tsā ba yon tan grags yin/ 'khrungs sa dang 'phrin las mdzad sa ni gtso bor kha rag rtsa ru byung / chung ja'i dus nas yab chos rnams mkhas par mkhyen/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan dang rkyang po chos blo la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs sman pa'i zhabs kyi 'grel pa sogs gsan nas rags rims tsam mkhyen pa'i skabs lo tsā slob par thegs te/ bal po spyi ther pa rnam rgyal dbang po de nyid lo gnyis bsten/ de nas rgya gar bi kra ma la shi lar byon/ bod nas der byon pa'i bar la lho brag mar pas phyag g.yog mdzad/ de nas bla mas so sor chos zhu gsungs nas mar pa la chos rgyag gnang sbyin bzang bar mdzad nas so sor gyes/ slob dpon pa ling ar+ya tsar+ya mtshan dngos de ba shra dha ste lha la dad pa zer/bla ma de la thog ma nyid nas gser srang brgyad cu gya bzhi dus gcig tu phul/gsang 'dus dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ye shes zhabs lugs su grags pa lta bu rgyud —171—

zab la byin rlabs dang gzi byin che ba zhig yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ las tshogs cha tshang ba ston pa'i chos skor zhig kyang zhus/ bdag gi bstod pa la 'go gcig na yod/ bod kyi mi rnams phrag dog dang gdug rtsub che bas chos skyong mthu che la myur ba zhu zhes zhu ba gsum mdzad/ dang po gnyis la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dang gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gnang / phyi ma la ngas bi kra ma la shi la'i bstan pa bsrung dgos pas mgon po'i rigs brgya dang drug cu'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las gtor chog las tshogs kun shes kyang thams cad kyi nang nas zab cing byin rlabs che ba myur la tshan che ba gcig yod pa 'di ster zhes gsungs pas/ mgon po'i dbang nangs par gnang rgyu'i do nub lo tsā ba rang gi mnal lam du mi nag po gser gyi ske rags bcings pa zhig byung nas bla ma khyod dang sbrags te bod du gtong bar 'dug gsung / de ni mgon po tsod shin tu 'go ba'i ltas yin par 'dug /de ltar bi kra ma la shi lar gzhi mdzad de rgya gar ma ga dha dang bha ga la kun tu lo skor tsam bzhugs/bla mas lung bstan pa la khyod rang gi yul mnga' skam pa 'dra ba/ bar yogs 'dra ba/ phug slang 'dra ba zhig na brag dmar nag la phug pa byang shar du lta ba zhig 2dug /der sgrub pa byas na myur du zhal ston pa 'dug gsung / lo tsā bas kyang rang yul du phebs pas gnas de ka btsal ba'i bya dkar zhes bya ba'i lung pa'i phug na 'dug pas der sgrub pa mdzad/ zla ba drug nas gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te mgon po bka' nyan du sgrub pa'i sgrub chen zhag bdun mdzad pas mgon po'i zhal gzigs shing bran du 'khor ba'i rtags —172—

rnams byung / rje mar pas kyang dang po chos rgyag gnang ba'i sku drin bsabs thabs su rje nā ro pa'i thugs dam bde mchog gi rdo sku sogs ngo mtshar ba'i byin rlabs rten 'ga' shas phyag tu phul 'dug /gzhan bod nyid du paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po dang gha ya dha ra sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi sngags rgyud mang po mkhyen par mdzad/ gsang 'dus dang gshin rje gshed skor gsum ste/ pha rgyud sde bzhi la bshad sgrub kyi grwa chen po'i rkang btsugs/ bde dgyes ma ya sogs ma rgyud kyang mang du gsungs/ mthu stobs thogs pa med pa mnga'/ sku tshe smad kyi dus shig na kha rag thod bur gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa zhig mdzad dus mnal lam du/ la chen po gcig la tshong pa shin tu tshan che ba gsum snga phyir rim can du sgrol 'don lan gsum du mdzad cing de rjes tshad bzhi pa de la klung thams cad gang pa tsam gyi 'grul ba'i sgrol 'don mdzad cing de nas kyang bar ma chad par mi mang po la de la sgrol bar rmis/ nga yi phyis su rgyud pa gsum du 'gro don chen po cha mnyam pa yong ba 'dug /bzhi pa de thams cad las phul du byung ba'i 'gro don mtha' yas pa zhig yong bar 'dug /de dag gi rjes su yang rang gzhan la phan thogs pa'i 'phrin las can mang du byung bar 'dug ces lung bstan to/ /gter ma'i lo rgyus ni/ gnyos lo chen po dang spyil rab dga' gnyis kyis don sbyod gcig la dbang bskur stong zha lha khang du bzhugs pa'i tshe zhwa'i mgon po gri thod can zhes pa'i mgon khang yod/ der zhag bdun bzhugs pas nub re bzhin cho 'phrul shin tu che ba byung / bdun pa'i nub mgon po sku brnyan gyis gsung 'byon te/ nga'i pus mo'i thad ka'i bar phyogs kyi gyang la sgrub —173—

thabs kyi dpe yod pas longs shig gsung / nangs par gyang rkos pas slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa byung / sngar gyi gter ma dang gnad gcig par dgongs/ bka' gter gcig tu dril nas nyams len mdzad/ sngar gyi lung bstan dang mthun par sras rdo rje bla ma dang dpal seng dang grags pa dpal te bla rabs gsum po de la'ang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa ba mang po 'dus 'phrin las cher byung / bzhi pa rgyal ba lha nang pa sangs rgyas ras chen mtshan dngos chos kyi gzi brjid de 'di yi rje 'bri gung ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo mthar thug mdzad/ gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas sgo phyes 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam/ dgon gnas lha rin chen mthil rang du yang 'dag sbyar ba stong brgyad brgya tsam rgyun tu byung / de'i dbon po lha rin chen dbang gi rgyal pos gter ston chos rgyal rin chen gling pas gter nas sbyan drangs pa'i mgon po 'di'i chos skor gnam lcags spru grir grags pa dang /gter ston rgya grags pa 'od zer gyis chos skyong 'di'i g.yul bzlog gi skor rnams spyan drangs pa'i gter nas bton pa de gnyis rang la gsan te phyag len du 'debs par mdzad pa yin/ sangs rgyas ras chen gyi ring la ro 'bri mtshams phyogs su dar rgyas che bar byung / par ri slo phug sdeng chen la sogs pa'i chos grwa rnams kyi bsrung mar mdzad/ de rjes kun mkhyen sa rgo bha dras gnas bzhi de dag las brgyud pa dang / lha bsod rgyal po'i drung du gnyos lugs kyi chos skor mtha' dag gsan/ mgon po bran bzhin du 'khol/ rin chen sgang gi mgon po mgon po'i bris skus sku gnyer la gsung byon te rgyal pa lha nang pa'i skye ba yin —174—

par lung bstan/ dbus pa chu shod gyi dmag 'khrugs nas grags pa sangs rgyas dpal rin gyis dgon par dmag yong bas 'bri mtshams thams cad bcom dus kyang dmag dpon gcig gis dgon pa mthong ma thag khrag skyug cing brgyal pa dang / dmag mi rnams spyos pa 'bog pa sogs cho 'phrul chen po byung bas/dbus pa'i dmag dpon thams cad kyis zhabs la gshugs/ ting nge 'dzin dang nus mthu dpag tu med nga mnga'/ 'di'i chos skor gnyos kyi gdung brgyud bar ma chad pa'i rim pa byin rlabs kyi bka' babs dang ldan pa lha bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rje grol mchog gi gsan/ sku'i skye ba rim pa gsum gyi chos skyong du gyur pas bzhed dgos kyi 'phrin las thams cad mgon po 'dis sgrub pa yin pa 'dug /yang kun mkhyen sa rgo bha dra nas brgyud pa mkhas grub sangs rgyas bzang po dang kun spang gu ru chos rin/ byang sems bsod rin/ sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams la brgyud/ rje grol mchog dang sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis la rje rdo ring pa phyi mas gsan/ chos skyong 'dis 'phrin las sgrub pa zhig yin par 'dug /de'i drung du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' snying pos gsan no/ /de ltar na dpal mgon traka da kyi chos skor lo rgyus 'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung bzhin kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mos zin bris su bkod pa'i dge ba'i mthu stobs kyis/༷bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i rgyur kyur cig /maṅga la// //

gtor chog sa bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal legs ldan nag po tra'i da lcam dral gyi gtor chog ni/ gtor ma dpal gtor bshos bu zlum po dmar gyi brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas bshams/dus bzang por bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i skabs/ thun gtor gru gsum de yang bshams/ rgyun du thun gtor grub na legs mod ma grub kyang mi 'gal/ de nas yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mchod pa gtor ma byin rlabs yid dam gang byed kyis lugs bzhin byed/ de nas/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang gi mdun du hūX las bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus su zlaX las phyi rin po sna tshogs las grub pa/ gru bzhi pa/ nang thod mkhar 'bar lnge'i gzhal med khang / shar mi'i thod pa'i rtsig pa/ lhor rta'i thod pa/ nub spre'u thod pa/ byang lug gi thod pa'i rtsig pa zlum po/ de'i nang du gru gsum nag po bdun brtsegs/ lcags kyi mkhar zung drug pa dbus su mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa/ gser gyi khri dang /pad nyid brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ raX las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma/ dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing lding pa/ g.yas kyi zhal shwa na mu kha ser po shel mig can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dug gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang / bdud kyi zhags pa nag po/ g.yon gnyis na khram —176—

shing dang thod pa snying bcas 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dred mo'i bcing slag /seng ge'i lpags pa'i go slag can dang / gser gyi ska rags/ sag ti'i lhum/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan dang cha byad rdzogs pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du smyoXlas dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ ma mo yongs kyi gtso mo/nag mo spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang zhing lpags/g.yon gnyis na thod khrag dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ glang chen lpags pa'i stod g.yogs dang / ba glang spags pa'i smad g.yogs can/ re lde'i sham bu dang /sbrul rigs bzhi'i ska rags dang / lte ba nas nyi ma dang / spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ khrag mtsho'i dbus su me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de ltar lcam dral gnyis kyi sku'i 'khor du sprul pa'i mon pa pho bdun mo bdun/ las byed shwa na bdun/ gnod sbyin brgyad lcags kyi bya khra brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa/ gshin rje brgyad/ stagagazigs/ dom/ dred/ 'phar ba/ seng ge spyang khyi brgyad du sprul pa/ bdud rgyal nyi khri chig stong lha dmag 'bum ste lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams sprin dpung 'khrigs pa ltar 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'dod rgyal khang dang / u tsa la'i dur khrod dang mu le steng la sogs pa nas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX sngon tshe sha kya sedha'i spyan snga sa /lha chen khyod kyi ji ltar dam bcas bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las —177—

la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaXhuX baX ho/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūX lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan/ oṃ shrī mahā ka la tra3da mahā ka la sirnyi yaX du dza dzaX wo gtso bo dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru dri tsa pa la a shug me ma huX ma sbyo dza dzaX zhes lha mo'i sngags te mgon po'i phyed lha mo'i grangs su bshad/ de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ oṃ mahā ka la tri yaX dzaX sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun smyo hūX phaṭa/ bā ling e dam grit+na kha kha ji hi 'a hi bhañdza ho/ rak+ta pi ba to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de bi ma hā ka li re ma tri e daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi 'a hi mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha hi/ mahā rak+ta la khya hi/ zhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pas phul/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā ka la/rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug /dug gsum kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing / gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ lha yi ded dpon chen po srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas rnams ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig ji raX sku hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /nag mo dre'u la bzhon pa/ /gcer bu bong bu la bzhon pa/ /mgyogs ma rlung la bzhon pa/ 'khor nag mo 'bum dang bcas pa rnams ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /kha raX ji hi/ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āXhuX/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ huX dad pa dang ni —178—

dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon srog bdud ma rung ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso/ /drag po'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed/ /gtum/ po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sbyoX ma yi nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas srid gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ / bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /ma bcos chos sku bde ba chen po ni/ /srid dang zhi bar mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /yon tan 'phrin las 'tshams pa'i skur ston pa/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i lha mo khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i 'dod don zhu/thun gtor yod na skabs 'dir 'bul te/ huX srid gsum dbang bsgyur mgon po yab yum dang / /stobs ldan pho nya mngags gzhugs 'khor dang bcas/ khren tu 'jigs khros drag la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin mgyogs pa'i shugs can rnams/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud: /dzam bu ṭa ka'i zhal zas /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag: /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang /khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang / /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par ma ljadi/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam tshig bden pa bzhin/ /byang chub —179—

sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrub/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ smon lam rnams gang 'grub bya/ zhes dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skyong gzhon nu dam pa'i mnga' bdag kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i bkas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //sngon tshe bla ma gong ma'i spyan snga sa / chos bzhin sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / mthu ldan tsod chen po'i bkra shis shog /dge'o// //'di bris dge bas nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ shu bhaX// bkra shis//—180—

kyi man ngag gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos zhal rgyun gser gyi thig pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ legs ldan mgon po'i man ngag zhal rgyun gser gyi thig pa 'bri/ bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ rwa lo tsā gsum pa tā ra nā tha'i zhal rgyun bdud 'dul dbang phyug zhes bya ba'i mgon po gzhan las kyang nus mthu che bas mgon po trak+ta da zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa ni/ sngon gyi shākya thub pas/ri rab chen po'i rtse ru ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kyi bcom ldan 'das lags/ nag po chen po gdug pa can ni/ rgyud gang las sgrub/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ji ltar gtad/ ma 'ongs pas rnal 'byor pas ji ltar sgrub/ sgrub pa'i yon tan ji ltar yod lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' bstsal pa/ bstan pa snyigs dus gtad pa'i rab lo rgyus rtsa ba zugad/ 'dir 'dus kyi 'khor tshogs rnams nyon cig /nag po chen po gcig la sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du bshad/ de la lha traka da dang / gnod byin trak+ta da 'di rgyal po mya ngan med kyis nub gcig la mchod rten bye ba sgrub pa'i 'phrin las sgrub mkhan te mgon po 'di yin/ gsang ba bdud du sgrub pa 'di la yang nang gses su dbye na/ phyi'i srol bdag dkar po'i tshul du sgrub pa zhal lnga phyag —181—

bzhi pa mgon dkar tshul du yod/ nang gi mgon po sgrub pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gsang ba bdud du sgrub pa zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa 'di la/ bco rdo pa ldan 'das kyi dregs pa 'dur byed kyi rgyud le'u sum cu pa gsungs/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes nag po gcer bu'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa gsungs pa/'di kha'i nang nas rtsa ba'i mgon po gri thod can dang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs 'byung / rgyud spyan 'dren mkhan rgya lcags dam khang pa yin/ rgya lugs su grags/ yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nag po gcer bu'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum ma gsungs/ mgon po seng bzhon ma byung / jo bo lugs su grags/ rgyud 'phrin las man ngag gi snying po gsal ba zhes pa yod/ de'i nang du mgon po gri thod can dang / mgon po'i mi nag rta nag la bzhon pa/bzlog pa'i mgon po yin par bzhed/ nag po bdun pa'i rgyud dang / dur khrod nag po'i rgyud du zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ 'khor skyon rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi bskor bar gsungs/ 'di la brten nas mgon po drug cu pa yongs/sgrub pa la lag len skabs yin na/ 'di la phyi'i dkyil 'khor/ nang gi dkyil 'khor/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gsum/ phyir gzhi'i dam rdzas kyi gnad/'gyur ba ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad/ kyer sgom 'phrin las kyi gnad/ myur ba gas re sngags kyi gnad/ sa bcad 'di rnams las bzhi char la 'jug /dang po/sa gzhi la dug dang khrag gis chag chag btab/ sa yi las bdun tshang bar bya/gzhan lag len rnams zur na yod/ zor sna 'dren na 'di ru chang dang / khrag sna tshogs tshad dang / phur bu yungs dkar yungs nag dang / til dang ske tshe dang /—182—

shing dang zi ra dkar nag /rdo nag thun dang lcags phye zangs phye dang / kong zor rwa zor mda' zor dang / dam nyams dgra bo'i mkhar la rdobs/ nyin gsum thun rnams ni/ dgra bo gnod byed lus la rdobs/ dam rdzas legs pa'i le'u ste gsungs/ de rnams bsgrub dus su/ skam thun thams cad yaX dang hūX las bskyed/rlon thun thams cad ma dang smyo las bskyed/ sgrub dus bsad sngags la thun sngags btags la bzlas/ nyin mo pho thun brdebs/ mtshan mo mo thun brdebs/de rnams bka' bzhi'i lag len gyi rim pa'o/ /sgrub pa lag len la 'jug ste/ mgon po zhal gnyis phyag gnyis phyag bzhi sgrub pa la/ yi dam stobs che la 'a tun che ba gcig dgos/ de'i lo rgyus ni gnyos lo tsā ba'i bha ling a tsa bya'i sku mdun du gser srang stong phrag gcig dus gcig tu phul nas chos zhu ba gsum byas/ khyad par nga yi khang pa la tshug cig tsam na yod pa'i/ de la chags pa bzhin du sdang ba yod pas/ chos skyong mthu rtsal can gcig dgos zhus pas/ mgon po 'di kho na gnang ba yin/ de'i rgyab rten du yi dam gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa gnang / da lta'i bar du yang rdo rje 'jigs byed dag tu mdzad pa 'di yin 'jigs byed gnyos lugs su grags pa yin/ khyad par mkhas btsun thams cad kyi 'jigs byed rwa la thug zer bar gsungs pa dang / khyad par rwa lo gsum pa'i zhal rgyun la/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bum pa gcig nas gcig tu blugs pa lta bu yod/ nyi ma de ring yan chad la sgrub thabs kyis brgyud pa'i bar ma chad pa yin gsungs/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba yod gsungs/ sgrub thabs nyams len nyams su longs/—183—

'dir bsad bzlog gnyis dang / 'brel ba'i sngags 'di ltar bzla/ ral gri 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor bskor/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya huX raX che/ ya me du ru ṇa yo da ya phaṭa ke /ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣi ya rbad mo/ yak+ṣi ya tsā ni ra ma ya dgra bo mar ya phaṭa/ bsad pa dbye bskrad rmongs rengs la/ ming gi yi ge'i 'bar bar du/ sngags kyi yi ge spel ba ste/ snying po nye snying steng du sngags de ltar bzla/tshogs pa yongs rdzogs rnams gtso bo'i zhal phyag yongs rdzogs bskyed nas rgyun du bzla/ las byed slob dpon gyi drag cing zer nas nges par bzla/ de nas mdun bskyed bzlas pa man chad btang bas/ lha'i gtso mdzad lha traka da/ gnod sbyin gtso mdzad gnod sbyin tra'i da/ bdud kyi gtso mdzad bdud traka da rnams sgrub thabs tha dad yod pa 'dra yang sgrub thabs tha dad du mi byed/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs 'di kha la rang rang sa bon byas pa'i mthus/ traka da la 'bod sngags yig 'bru bcu bdun pa yin/ rwa lugs ni dam can chos rgyal la las kyi gshin rje mgon po nag po'i sgrub pa dang / lha mgon du sgrub pa dang /sgrub pa'i sngags de ltar byas pas lha gnyis gsum gyi nus pa yod bla ma'i zhal rgyun yin/ tsod la yang de'i rigs 'gre ba go bar bya'o/ /de nas smad las bsad pa ni/ oṃ sla na ni byin no/ /snying la ya ya/ bzhi tsi ta rbad/ mahā ka la huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la tri yaX sbyo/ ṇi tshal ba dri dza yaX spyo ṇi tshal pa/ che ge mo ma ra ya dzaX srog thig dbab pa'i drag sngags phyin rmi/srid gsum sgrol zhing phung bar byed/ /gzhu dang mda' dang mde'u tshul gsung /ni nyin mo yab kyis 'dod pa la/ /rbad bsad gnyis po btags nas bzlas/ /yum la —184—

mtshan mo de bzhin no/ /rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing / bran mo bran pho thams cad yang mig rtsa rig cing bka' la nyan nas las byed par bsgom/ bsnyen pa'i sngags rnams bzlas pa'i tshe/ mu tig bstar la brgyus bzhin bzla/ /sgrub pa'i sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe/ /bar snang dgong gi thog bzhin bzla/ /las sbyor sngags rnams bzla ba'i tshe/ /hor ba gzan la 'dzum bzhin bzla/ /de rnams lag len song nas bskang ba 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrings/ btab gtor gyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ btab gtor bca' lugs kyi khyad par ni/ gtor ma gru gsum du byed pa dang / gru gsum chos 'byung bzo rgyu byed pa dang / mi gzugs brgya rtsa ru byed pa dang / mtheb skyu ru byed pa ni mgyogs chos yin/ 'di skabs su 'thor ba bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang dgos/ de la sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'gugs par bya/ gtor chung 'bul ba'i sngags gtor sgrub nang na yod do/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ gtor chung de dgra bgegs dngos su bsam nas mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du sha chom rus chom la rkan sgra dang bcas pas dgra bgegs gsol bar mdzad par bsam/ mdun bskyed kyi lha de yang / rnying ma ba la las lugs la gtor ma thog mar lhar gsal ba dang / bar du gtor ma gsal ba dang / mthar zol du gsal bar byed de/ gzhan dag de lta bu mi byed par mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma de nyid dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dmigs nas mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul/—185—

rang nyid dper na yi dam ri rab tsam du bsgom/ de'i bka' nyan chos skyong mdun bskyed kyi sked pa tsam du sleb par bsgoms nas/ las bcol ba'i dmigs pa byed pa yin/ bstod bskul rnams kyi gzhung bsrangs/ bskul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ mgon po dug kug kug zhing dgra la phyogs/ lha mo yang dgra bo khram la 'debs par bsam zhing nad sna drongs/ mtshon gyi gru gu'i 'gyed cing shwa khye'u dkar nag 'dril/ mon mo rnams ni/ la la ngu zhing la la khro/ dgra la g.yab mo 'debs shing ngu / la la lag pa 'brel zhing ngu / la la gri thod la la ngu / dgra la ngu zug rtag tu byed/ khyi mo ral pa'i sbu gseb nas/ dug dang mtshon cha lta bur 'phro/ dgra yi yul du yang yang song bar bsam/ drag tu rgyug cing drag tu mchod/ de ltar bsgom par bya/ mtshams 'di ru stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang / smad las drag las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi las la 'jug par bya ste/mdun du 'brub khung dngos sam bris pa'i nang du ling ga skye mched dod par bya/rang gi lag pa'i phur ba bsgril shing / hūX las byung ba'i nag po che/ /phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pa'i thod khrag zhal du gsol/ /sku smad dpal gyi dbyis chen ste/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i gī la ya/ /dam nyams snying la gī la ya/ /lag pa thabs shes sbyar ba las/ /sras mchog de ltar 'gyung bar mos/ bden bdar lha'i gdangs dang ldan pa mang du bya/ 'di ru bsgral ba'i phan yon dang / ma bsgral ba'i nyes dmigs dang / tshangs pa rnam gsum dang /kha sbyor dbye ba dang / tshe lung dang / khrus lung dang / dgra bgegs kyi tshe lung dang / rnal 'byor ba'i tshe lung dang / dgra bgegs kyi khrus lung / khams gsum —186—

sems can khrus lung dang / rdo rje phur ba'i khrus lung ngo / /kha sbyor dbye ba'i lha la mchod pa 'di snga ba yin/ drug cu pa'i nang gi kha sbyor bzhi'i dbang du btang na/ gnas kyi kha sbyor dang / ye shes kyi kha sbyor dang / 'jig rten pa'i kha sbyor dang / go cha'i kha sbyor ro/ /gsang sde brgyad po yang kha sbyor yin te/ mi'i kha sbyor bzhi dang / lha'i kha sbyor bzhi ste/ lha'i kha sbyor bzhi ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gsang sde/ tshe lha'i gsang sde/ yul lha'i gsang sde/ zhing lha'i gsang sde de bzhi'o/ /mi'i gsang sde bzhi ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gsang sde/ rje dpon gyi gsang sde/ grogs kyi gsang sde/ 'khor g.yog gi gsang sde/ gsang sde'i 'di'i rnams la mchod pa 'bul mi dgos pa'ang yod/ gsang sde brgyad po 'di rnams rgyud rtog pa gsum pa nas gsungs/ gzhan rje gshed skor rnams 'di kha phyag len du mdzad/ la lar zhig gi chos skad la/ kha sbyor bzhi shes na shes dang ma shes na smra shes sam u tshugs byas yang kun 'dug /kyai rdo rje'i rgyud du kha sbyor gsum las ma gsungs/ nges med du gsungs/ dper na dmigs gsal can gyi dgra gcig la bla med kyi dbang bzhi thob pa yod na bum dbang gi kha sbyor dbye ba dang / gsang gi kha sbyor dbye ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi kha sbyor dbye ba dang /dbang bzhi pa'i kha sbyor dbye ba dang / dper na rtogs ldan dbang bzhi ma thob pa la sems ngo 'phrod pa yod na de'i kha sbyor dbye ba dang / 'khor lo dang rdzas dang yig 'bru'i kha sbyor dbye ba byas nas/ khrus lung gi dmigs pa gtad/ gzas pa po'i lid+ma'i tshe lung dmigs pa rnams gtad/ rdo rje phur ba lid+ma'i dkyil du bsnun pas/ rtsa thams cad gur gyi tsho ni thag bcad pa bzhin du song bar bsam/—187—

khrag thag thams cad bye ma skam po la chu thig brgyab pa bzhin song bar bsam/khrag gi dwangs ma lcog mo'i sgong nga dang 'dra ba yod/ de'i dbus na tshe rten a dkar po yod/ de phur pa'i rtse mos blangs te bla ma yi dam gang wo zhig gi thugs kar 'phang ngo / /lus khang stong 'dra ba de la thun dang phyag mtshan rnams rim bzhin btab/ gzas pa po'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnad khyad par can yod/lus dum bur btang / de nas byin rlabs/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams la zhal bstabs kyi mchod pa gyer/ tshim zhing mnyes par bsam/ bla ma yi dam la phul bas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ dam can chos skyong la phul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ tshangs pa rnam gsum de la tshangs/ bsgral ba'i phan yon de la tshangs/ sgo dbye 'phreng sel gser skyems bden par bdar zhal bsgyur dang / zor bskul bar byas/ gas ma rnams kyi dbyangs rol gyer/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi rbod gtong dang dgra bo gsod pa bya/ sa nas blang nas 'phang tsa na/ srid pa gsum gyi nad dang dug dang 'khrul 'khor dang lha 'dre mi gsum gyi sdig pa dang / nus mthu thams cad tshang ba'i gtor ma ri rab tsam du bstim nas/ gzugs can gzugs med gang na gnas pa'i yul khams su 'phangs/de dang mnyam du las byed pho nya las mkhan sde brgyad dang bcas pa dmag dpung gi tshul du song bar bsam/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung nas brlag par bsam/gtor kha sbub/ de ltar byas pa'i rbod gtong dang dmag dang gtad mnan thams cad tshang bar bshad/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rten mnan/ phyi mig mi blta bar rkang pa g.yas pa'i yi ge'am ri mo lnga 'bri/ de mtshams gcod kyi dmigs pa — 188—

yin gyis/ de ltar mkhas rmongs thams cad la/ brgyag gtor mtshon char bsgoms nas rgyag pa 'dug ste/ rgyag lugs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa la dgra glo bur nyid du byung nas rgyag pa'i dmigs pa yin gyis/ mtshon char rgyag pa ltar nus pa thon pas bye brag gi dmigs pa yin no/ /rwa lo gsum pa tā ra nā thas zhal rgyun 'khrul med yin/ gong gi rgyag lugs de la yang / rang rang la sgom lugs mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa la sogs yod do/ /nged kyi 'di rnams sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang yod/ nang du 'ong nas tshogs dang bkra shis mtha' rgyas byed/ dkyil 'khor shul du me tog nges par 'thor/ /mkhas rnams lo rgyus phyag len btab/ /gsal bar blta bas me long yin/ /rab rib 'byed pas mig thur yin/ /rang bzo med pa'i zhal rgyun lags/ /zhes sa mo byi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la dge slong snying po mtha' yas kyis bris pa ste brag stod chos kyi pho brang du dge'o// //gcig zhus// grub mtha'i mthar thug khyad par nges don snying po kun mkhyen gyi lta ༷ba 'di ma gtogs pa'i grub mtha' khag khar gsang bar gyis shig sarba maṅga la//〈rigs 'dzin rnam snang rdo rjes zhus dag gnang ba'i dpe las bshus/ zhes zer ba 'dug kyang mi dag snyam/〉—189—

bya ba lha btsan gyi gtor bsngo dang bcas pa bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa huX/ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūX phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharma ṇaX a tu nu tu sno twa ta/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod nang du oX las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho sdiXdam pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdag dang / /rnal 'byor sgrub brtson bskyod phyir spyan 'dren gyis/ /tshur byon mchod gtor bzhes slad 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi e phya hi badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ nags sman rgyal mo sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ sman 'phral 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ 'gal rkyen bsrung ba dang / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i gtong grogs mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi sa pā rī wa ra khyuXn ma sarba ta tha ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe khyoXsarba tha khaX ut+pa te spa ra ṇa e maX ga ga na khaX gro hā dam ba ling ta ye swāhā/ lan lnga'i 'bul/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi a : ta la kha raX kha hi/ sa pas nang mchod 'bul/ khyoX gang gi —190—

rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig dang / /de 'dzin rnal 'byor tshogs rnams skyongs mdzad cing / /'gro ba kun la ma ltar byams pa yi/ /ma cig nags sman rgyal mor bstod par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / /sems can kun la bde skyid mdzod/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /'gal rkyen bsrung la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis che btsan 'khor bcas a kar+ṣa dzaX de ba shu la dri yang dzaX sa pa ri wa ra aX ku shā dzaX badz+ra a ra zhi ho/ sa ma ya stuX/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de ba hūṃ la dri yaX dzaX a kā ro/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga sa /srog gi snying po dam la phul nas kyang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas par/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po khyed la bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba/ /sogs gong bzhi/badz+ra muX gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ ga tsā ga smo swa thā naX/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya/ zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // dge'o//—191—

hoX bde stong gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las/ /thon pa'i 'dod dgu'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin/ /spros pa'i spyi 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'dis/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /dngos brgyud drin can bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa: rtsa brgyud kyis dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ tang ho bde stong jo /thon pa'i: /spros pa'i /zag med5 /rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum mnyes phyir 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ /na mo thabs dang ngu yi dam lha tshogs rnams dang bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal du bde stong ngu /thon pa'i: /spros pa'i: /zag med5 /rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ / brtse ba'i: /dngos grub /na mo thabs: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bde stong /thon pa'i: /spros: /zag med: /bka' sdod lcam dral chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /tshe ring mched lnga la —192—

sogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ brtse bas bzhes la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i gdong grogs mdzod/na mo thabs dang : chos skyongs bsrung ma dang bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du pañtsa bde stong ngu /thon /spros: /zag med: /'gro ba rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad tshim phyir bsngos/ /dgyes shing bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen yid bzhin bsgrubs/ /thabs dang jo ma gyur sems can rnams kyis longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āXlas byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oX āXhūX las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod pa'o yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/ ā ka ro sogs/ 〈'jug mi tshang 〉—193—

mkhyen pa ta ra nā tha'i gsung bzhin sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis zin bris bgyis pa bzhugs/gang zhig chos dbyings mtha' klas shes bya'i gnas kun ma lus khyab pa yi/ /nang gi ye shes rang rig gsal ba ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /smon lam rgya mtsho brtse ba'i gter gyur rtsol med lhun grub 'phrin las kyis/ /'khor 'das don mchog bde blag rtsol mdzad sangs rgyas dbang gi rgyal por 'dud/ /'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung lugs dri med lam/ /rab tu gsal ba rin chen sgron me'i blo/ /gang gi drin las rnyed 'di rje btsun mchog /mtshungs med bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya/de yang bshes pa'i 'phrin yig gi bstan bcos 'di 'chad pa la/ dang por mtshan don ni/ rgya gar skad du/ su hri da le kha/ bod skad du/ bshes pa'i 'phrin yig ces pa/ rgyal po bde spyod dang yid nye ba grogs mdza' bshes su gyur par/ rgyang ring po nas yi ger gdams pas 'phrin yig ces pa'o/ /'gyur gyi phyag 'tshal 'phags pa 'jam dpal la byas par/ gzhon nur gyur pa zhes pa'i don/ sngon byang chub kyis spyad pa spyod pa'i dus kyi sku skye ba nas skye ba thams cad du khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba rtag tu tshangs par sbyod pa kho nar —194—

gyur pa'i/ byis pa gzhon nu gtsang mar gnas pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu'i sa pa zhes bya/ gzhung don la gleng bslang ba dang / gzhung dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yon tan rang bzhin dge 'os bdag gis ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung snyad las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams mdun slad 'phags pa'i dbyangs 'di dag /cung zad gcig bsdebs khyod kyi gsan pa'i rigs/ /gang la gdam par bya ba'i yul rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa dang /shes rab gtong ba dad pa brtson 'grus che ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi rang bzhin can/ rtag tu dge bar spyod pa dang / 'os pa dang rigs pa'i bya ba la gnas pa'i rgyal po zhes bos nas/ gdams pa po klu sgrub bdag gis ni/gdams pa'i ngo bo rang bzo ma yin par bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gyis don bskyar ldab tu snyad pa las byung ba rnams gdams pa/ dgos pa rgyal po bsod nams la 'dun pa'am/ dge ba'i bsam sbyor gong du 'phel ba'i slad du/ ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul ni/ dza ti'i nang tshan gyi mi mnyam pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi nang nas sdeb sbyor 'phags pa'i dbyangs su bsgrigs shing byas pa ste sangs rgyas kyis gsungs rab rgya mtsho lta bu las/dgos don nye bar mkho ba'i don du cung zad cig bsdebs pa 'di dag rgyal po ri khyod kyi gsan par rigs so/ /gleng bslang ba'i 'phros don ni/ ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang / /bgyis pa ci 'dra'ang rung ste mkhas pas mchod/ /de bzhin bdag gi snyan ngag 'di ngan yang / /dam chos brjod la brten slad smad mi bgyi/ /sgro195—

gdams pa po ngan pa'i nyan par mi rigs so zhe na/ bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs rgyu shing phal ba las bgyis pa bzo dbyibs/ cha tshad dang mi ldan pa legs pa ci 'dra zhig byung kyang rung sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra yin pa'i phyir skye bo mkhas pa shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchod pa'i yul du byed pa de bzhin du bdag klu sgrub so so skye bor gyur pas gdams pa po ngan pa dang /rjod byed kyi tshig bdag gis snyan ngag ngan cing mi legs kyang / sangs rgyus kyi gsungs rab dam pa'i chos kyi don lhad med du brjod pa la brten pa'i slad du ste brten pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sngon du gsungs pa de kha bskyar zlos su brjod pa yin pas smad par mi bgyi zhing dang du blang bar rigs so/ /zhes kheng skyungs ba'o/ /yang 'phros don ni/ thub pa chen po'i bka' ni snyan dgu zhig /khyod kyi thugs su lta yang chung mod kyis/ /rdo thal las bgyis dgung zla'i 'od kyi ni/ /ches dkar nyid du ci ste mi bgyid lags/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa de kha las lhag po ston rgyu med na bskyar zlos su gdams par dgos pa med do zhe na/thub pa chen po'i bka' tshig ni sems la 'bab pa don bzang ba snyan dgu bzang tshad mang po zhig rgyal po khyod kyi thugs su lta sngon nas chud cing mkhyen pa yin mod kyang / slar yang gsal 'debs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rgya che ba mang po'i nang du don kha 'thor du bzhugs pa rnams phyogs su bsdebs pas 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ba'i brjed tho lta bur 'gyur bas/ dpe rdo thal gyis byugs pa'i khang pa kha dog dkar ba la/ dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni phog —196—

na ches lhag par dkar bar ci ste mi bgyid de bgyid par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /gzhung dngos la lam thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnam pa gnyis te/ dad pa dang / bag yod pa'o/ /dad pa'i chos skor gyi nang tshan nas thog mar dad pa ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa dang / /rab tu bka' stsal de dag so so yi/ /yon tan tshogs kyis rjes su dran par bgyi/ /rgyal bas 'khor rnams la/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa rnam pa drug po bsgom par gyis shig /ces bka' stsal bar mdzad pa yin cing/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan/ chos kyi phan yon/ dge 'dun gyi yon tan/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims kyi phan yon/ 'dod pa dang gzugs khams kyi lha rnams kyi gnas lus longs spyod gsum gyi yon tan/ rgyu dge ba spyad pa las byung ba dang de dag so so'i yon tan gyi tshogs ji ltar yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa dran par byed pa ni rjes su dran pa yin no/ /'dod pa dang gzugs khams kyi lha ni sngon gyi dge ba'i 'bras bu mngon shes dang ldan te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bya ba legs nyes gang byed rnams mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs na lha rnams kyang khrel bar 'gyur ro snyam/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyis ni rjes su dran nas dpang por 'jog pa yin no/ /dad pa de yang gang zag la dad pa dang / chos la —197—

dad pa gnyis su 'du ba las/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa ni gang zag skyes bu la dad pa yin/ chos gtong ba tshul khrims lha rjes su dran pa rnams ni chos la dad pa yin te chos rjes dran ni/ chos la dad pa ngo bo dang / gtong ba tshul khrims gnyis la dad pa ni nyams len rtogs pa'i chos kyi nang nas de gnyis la/ sger du dad pa yin/ lha rjes dran yang de'i rgyu dge ba la dad pas chos la dad pa'i nang du 'dus so/ /dad pa dang ldan pa'i spyod pa bshad pa las/ thog mar dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu la gnas dgos par ston pa ni/ dge ba'i las lam bcu po lus dang ni/ /ngag dang yid kyis rtag tu brten bgyi zhing / /chang rnams las bzlog de bzhin dge ba yi/ /'tsho ba la yang mngon par dges par mdzad/ /srog gcod pa/ ma byin par len pa/ 'dod pa'i log par g.yem pa ste lus kyi las gsum/rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal he ngag gi las bzhi/ rnabs sems/gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi las gsum mo/ /de ltar mi dge ba bcu yid gyis spangs shing lus ngag gi bya bas de las log par byas te mi dge ba bcu spangs pa'i las lam bcu po lus dang ni ngag dang yid kyis dus su brten cing sdig pa spang ba la gnas par byed pa dang / der ma zad chang gis myos na bag med par gyur te mi dge ba'i las la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir de rnams las kyang bzlog pa dang / dkon mchog gi dkor la sogs pa log pa'i 'tsho ba dang mi ldan pa ni dge ba'i 'tsho ba ste de dag la yang mngon par dgyes par mdzod cig /—198—

de'i rjes su sbyin pa la slob tshul la sbyin pa gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/gtong ba'i yul/ spyin pa ji ltar gtong ba'i tshul gsum ston pa ni/ longs sbyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /ge slong bram ze bkren dang bzhes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin bstsal bgyi pha rol tu/ /spyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /longs spyod rnams ni nges par mi brtan cing g.yo ba 'bral ba dang 'jig par 'gyur ba yin la/ 'jig cing 'gyur ba tsam du ma zad longs spyod bcangs pas skye ba gzhan du phan pa sogs kyang ma yin la/ nges par 'bral ba dang tshim pa med pas snying po med pa yin pa dang / longs spyod sbyin par btang na/ 'jig rten pha rol gzhan du 'byor pa bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phan yon yod pa mthong ba'i sbyin pa gtong dgos pa yin cing /sbyin pa'i yul yon tan gyi zhing dge slong sogs dang / khyim gnas chos bzhin du spyod pa bram ze dang / sdug bsngal gyi zhing bkren pa dang nad pa la sogs pa/phan 'dogs kyi zhing pha ma dang mdza' bshes drin gzo 'os pa rnams phan yon che ba'i yul gtso bor smos pa dang / sbyin pa gtong bas tshul bsam pa dang spyod pa rnam par dag pa dgos pa las/ bsam pa yul mchog rnams la gus pa dang /dman pa la snying rje phan sems kyis kun nas bslangs pa dang / spyod pa gus par gtong ba/ dus su babs par gtong ba/ ran par gtong ba ni sbyin yul dang 'phrod mthun par gtong ba'i spyin pa tshul lugs rnam dag bzhin du bstsal bar bgyi'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyin pa tshul bzhin du btang ba ni 'jig rten pha rol tu bde —199—

'bras phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i phan yon dang ldan pas gnyen gyi mchog mtshungs pa med pa yin no/ /tshul khrims la ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul dang / tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ khyod kyi tshul khrims ma nyams mod mi dma'/ /ma 'dres ma sbags ma gos bsten par mdzod/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi brten lags par gsungs/ khres ldan khyed lta bu rnams kyis tshul khrims mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bsrungs shing bsten par bgyi dgos te/ de yang ma nyams pa/ mod mi dma' ba/ ma 'dres pa/ ma sbags pa'i tshul khrims te mtshan nyid bzhi ldan no/ /de ltar yang / 'chal khrims de'i rgyus 'phan ma byung / /de gnyen po dang zhi lha brten/ /ces pa ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag rnams lag len du ma nyams par bsrung ba ni ma nyams pa'i tshul khrims so/ /lag len ma nyams par bsrungs kyang gnyen po stobs dang mi ldan pas sems nyon mongs kyis dmigs na tshul khrims kyang stobs tī pas mod dma' bar 'gyur ba'i phyir yid kyi mi dge ba 'dod chags dang gnod sems sogs sems la mi 'chang bar tshul khrims bsrung ba ni mod mi dma' ba'i tshul khrims so/ /mi sdug pa sogs ma chags pa dang / byams snying rje dang rten 'brel bsam pa la sogs pa gnyen po bsgoms pas nyon mongs dang mi 'dre bar byed pa ma 'dres pa'i tshul khrims so/ /'jig skyob kyi tshul khrims zhes bya ba/ 'tsho ba ma phyed pa'am dmag khral khur skyed chad pa sogs las thar pa'am/ tshe 'di'i grags pa bkur sti rnyed pa 'khor bsdu ba —200—

la sogs pa 'jig skyob kyis ched du tshul khrims bsrung ba ni tshe 'di'i rnam rtog gis gos pa yin pas des ma sbags pa dang / yang legs smon gyi tshul khrims zhes bya ba skye ba gzhan du lha mi'i mngon mtho'i bde ba bsgrub pa'i slad du tshul khrims bsrungs na yang 'khor ba'i bde ba la sred pa'i gos pa yin pas de dag gis kyang ma sbags par thar pa don gnyer nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims la bslab pa ni ma sbags pa'i tshul khrims te tshul khrims mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa yin la/ theg pa chen po pa rnams kyis ni bzhi ldan du ma zad rang nyid kho na thar pa don gnyer ma yin par sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral 'dod kyis kun nas bslang ba'i tshul khrims la slob pa yin no/ /'dir slob dpon blo gros chen po'i 'grel par/ bslab pa'i yan lag gcig 'dus pa nyams pa dang / mdo 'das pa mo smra bar 'chad kyang legs par ma mthong ngo / /de ltar tshul khrims bsrung ba'i yon ni/ rgyu ba'i sems can mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyang sa gzhi la brten nas skye 'phel byed/ ri nags tshal 'bab chu lo tog la sogs mi rgyu ba'i dngos po rnams kyang sa las 'byung ba bzhin du/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang tshul khrims las byung ba yin pas tshul khrims ni de kun gyi gzhi rten lags par rgyal bas gsung pa yin no/ /dad pa dang rjes su 'brel ba theg chen thun mong ma min pa'i spyod pa la rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa gnyis bshad pa ni/sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin shes rab —201—

gzhal med pha rol phyin/ /'di dag rgyus mdzad srid pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol phyin pa rgyal ba'i dbang por mdzod/ /ces pa sbyin pa gzhal du med pa mtha' yas par sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang shes rab gzhal med mtha' yas par bskyed pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar drug po 'di dag phyogs med du rgyas par mdzod cigargyas par byed lugs sngon 'gro'i dus su snying rje chen po'i bsam pas zin pa/dngos gzhi'i dus su spyin pa'i sgo sna tshogs pas spyin yul phyogs med dang dus thams cad du gtong ba nas/ shes rab kyis sgrub pa thos bsam sgom gsum sna tshogs pa dus thams cad du mtha' med par bskyed pa'i bar du rgyas par byed/rjes kyi dus su sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bas rgyas 'debs/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes thams cad du thabs mkhas kyi yan lag sbyin pa gtong ba po sbyin pa'i dngos po spyin yul rnams bden med sgyu ma lta bu 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug yan lag bzhi ldan du rgyas par byas nas srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ste/ rgya mtsho rgya che ba dang mtshungs par 'khordo ra ba'i gnas mtha' yas pa dang / gting zab pa dang mtshungs te der bying nas thon par dka' ba dang / chu srin la sogs gdug pa'i sems can gyis 'jigs pa mang ba dang mtshungs par sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa mang ba dang / rgal bar dka' ba dang mtshungs par 'khor ba las thar par dka' ste chos sgom pa ma gtogs thabs gang gis kyang thar mi thub pas de lta bu'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthar —202—

son pa rgyal ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzod ciganyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rang nyid gcig pu sgom thar tsam yin la/ sangs rgyas ni rang nyid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par ma zad sems can mtha' yas pa 'dren par mdzad pas thar lugs mthar thug pa yin no/ /'dir blo gros chen po'i 'grel chen las/ gzhan med pha rol phyin ces 'don cing / phyin drug nyan rang la med pa'i don du 'chad de/ da ni khyim pa'i rten can las dang po pa dad pa can rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i chos rnam pa gnyis bshad de/ pha ma la sogs pa gus par 'os pa rnams la mchod pa dang /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso spyong blangs pa las / dang po ni khyim na pha dang ma yongs su gus par byed pa ni tshangs pa dang bcas yin/ slob dpon dang bcas pa yin no/ /zhes grags pa ltar bshad pa ni/ gang la pha dang ma dag mchod pa yi/ /rigs de tshangs bcas slob dpon bcas pa'ang lags/ /gang pha dang ma dag la gus pas mchod par byed pa'i rigs de la ni tshangs pa dang bcas pa yin/ slob dpon dang bcas pa yin te/ dngos su phan 'dogs pa'i pha dang ma la gus par srid zhu byed pa shes pa drin gzo ba de ni/ lha rnams kyi mthar thug tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha la gus pa byed pa yang snying thag pa nas gus pa yin pas tshangs pa dang bcas pa yin/ 'jug ldog thams cad slob par byed pa'i pha dang ma gus pa de ni/ rig pa'i khyad par gzhan slob pa'i slob dpon la gus pa yang snying —203—
